name: Limoges Limestone Vintaged Finish
bodyHtml:
Embodying the classic elegance of English and French grand houses, the Limoges Limestone Vintaged Finish speaks of timeless sophistication. These limestone tiles, paired with Tora Blue Cabochons, capture the essence of historic stone floors.

The authentic undulated surface of the Limoges Limestone reveals a tactile charm that adds depth and character to any interior space. Its vintaged finish enhances the stone's natural beauty, creating an inviting atmosphere.

Crafted from a blend of limestone from the same quarry, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for a variety of indoor settings. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their enduring appeal.

Whether gracing a hallway or forming the foundation of a living room, the Limoges Limestone tiles offer a refined backdrop that complements both traditional and rustic styles. The inclusion of Tora Blue Cabochons adds a distinctive touch, though other cabochon options are compatible.

Samples of the Limoges Limestone do not include cabochons, which can be purchased separately. Bespoke finishes and formats are available upon request, allowing for tailored design solutions.

In its dry, unlaid state Limoges is a white to ivory toned limestone. Once it is installed and grouted the tone shifts, and the stone usually settles warmer and creamier than it appears dry, as the photographs from the completed project show. As the floor ages and is lived on, that process carries on maturing. As with any natural stone, hold judgement until the floor is grouted and the room is fully finished.

Made from natural limestone, these tiles are designed for internal use, particularly well suited for kitchens and hallways. Their traditional and rustic style adds character and depth to any space, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

These tiles require sealing to maintain their beauty and durability, ensuring they withstand the demands of daily life while preserving their distinctive appearance.

With a nod to the past and a place in the present, the Lacock Limestone Heritage Finish offers a refined balance of design and practicality, making it a thoughtful choice for those who appreciate the beauty of natural stone.

name: Old London Sandstone Worn & Patinated Finish
bodyHtml:
Old London Sandstone captures the essence of time-honoured craftsmanship, evoking the character of reclaimed stone with its worn and patinated finish. These flagstones are a testament to the beauty found in natural variation, offering a palette of warm brown tones that echo the charm of historic interiors.

The design thoughtfully combines stones from different beds, creating a tapestry of textures and hues reminiscent of aged slabs. This approach not only enhances the visual depth but also ensures each piece tells its own story, contributing to a cohesive yet dynamic floor.

Crafted from high-quality sandstone, these tiles are well-suited for internal use, particularly in kitchens and hallways where their rustic appeal can be fully appreciated. The worn finish adds a tactile dimension, inviting touch and interaction.

When considering installation, it's important to note that these tiles require sealing with Stone Shield only, ensuring their longevity and maintaining their distinctive appearance. This specific sealer enhances the natural colours, adding a subtle sheen that complements the stone's inherent beauty.

Old London Sandstone offers an enduring appeal, perfect for those seeking to infuse their spaces with a sense of history and authenticity. Its timeless aesthetic and practical functionality make it a refined choice for traditional and rustic settings.

Crafted from limestone, these tiles are well-suited for internal use, particularly in kitchens and hallways where their natural durability can be appreciated. Please note, these tiles require sealing to maintain their beauty and performance over time.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are well-suited for internal use, bringing their distinctive appeal to spaces like kitchens, bathrooms, and shower walls. Their stone-effect style complements both plain and traditional interiors, offering versatility without compromise.

Imagine these tiles adorning a kitchen splashback or creating a focal point in a bathroom, where their artisanal quality can be truly appreciated. Their white hue provides a neutral backdrop, allowing for creative expression through other design elements.

With no sealing required, these tiles offer a practical yet elegant solution for those seeking to infuse their spaces with a touch of Moroccan heritage. Their enduring appeal lies in their ability to blend seamlessly into a variety of settings while maintaining a characterful presence.

name: Wansdyke Terracotta
bodyHtml:
Wansdyke Terracotta tiles bring a touch of rustic elegance to any space, crafted from a unique blend of minerals that lend them exceptional durability. These Italian-made tiles are designed to withstand even the harshest winter frosts, making them a reliable choice for both indoor and outdoor settings.

The handmade finish of these tiles showcases their traditional character, with a warm red hue that adds depth and charm to floors. Their brick shape and tactile surface create a timeless appeal, perfect for those seeking a classic yet enduring design.

Made from robust terracotta, these tiles are suitable for use in a variety of spaces, from the welcoming warmth of a kitchen to the inviting ambiance of a hallway or patio. Their resilience and strength make them well-suited to both internal and external applications.

Please note, these tiles are produced as a rectangular block of two scored tiles for ease of transport and installation. A light tap along the central ridge will separate them into individual tiles, using either a dead blow mallet or another tile.

With their artisanal craftsmanship and practical design, Wansdyke Terracotta tiles offer a harmonious blend of style and functionality, requiring sealing to maintain their beauty over time.

name: Stone Glaze Ceramic British Green Gloss Brick
bodyHtml:
Stone Glaze Ceramic British Green Gloss Brick tiles capture the essence of traditional craftsmanship, marrying stoneware with a thick, hand-applied glaze. This technique brings out the vibrant, variegated tones that are the hallmark of this ancient ceramic art.

Each tile is unique, with natural variations in size and colour that invite a sense of organic beauty and individuality. These tiles encourage the creation of spaces that are as characterful as they are intriguing.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them a refined choice for walls in bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks. The glossy finish enhances their visual appeal, adding a touch of sophistication to any setting.

While sealing is not required, we recommend using a pre-grout barrier to prevent grout residue from affecting the glaze, especially when using dark or contrasting grout colours. This ensures the tiles maintain their pristine appearance.

Stone Glaze tiles offer a harmonious blend of design and practicality, allowing you to craft interiors that are both expressive and enduring.

While these tiles require sealing, their inherent beauty and practicality make them a considered choice for those seeking a balance of design and functionality. The Wychwood Limestone Tumbled Finish is a testament to thoughtful craftsmanship.

name: Enso Cobble Mosaic Strip Sand
bodyHtml:
Our Enso Mosaics are irresistibly tactile, with softly undulating surfaces designed to be experienced as much by touch as by sight. Crafted from tumbled limestone, they carry a gentle, time-worn quality that feels instinctively calm and considered.

Named after the Zen Buddhist concept of Ensō, a symbol of wholeness found within imperfection, these mosaics embrace organic irregularity. Their surfaces echo the look of crystal-clear streams flowing over pebbles, each piece subtly rounded, each edge softened, each detail becoming more characterful with time.

When lit thoughtfully, Enso Mosaics reveal their true depth. Light dances across the curves, casting dappled shadows and drawing out an organic texture that shifts throughout the day.

Suitable for interior walls and floors as well as exterior walls, they bring quiet movement and natural elegance to bathrooms, kitchens and living spaces alike. As a natural limestone product, sealing is required to protect and preserve their beauty. Variations in tone, texture and size are to be expected and celebrated, adding to the unique charm of every installation.

name: Versailles Marble Vert Honed
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the grandeur of French Baroque interiors, Versailles Vert brings an altogether more atmospheric character to the collection. This dramatic black-green marble is flecked with touches of emerald and punctuated by occasional jagged veins of white. There is an almost mineral quality to its colouring, with subtle variations that reveal themselves across the surface. Used alone, it creates a wonderfully enveloping interior; paired with lighter stones, it brings an unexpected richness to the traditional chequerboard.

Ideal for indoor walls and floors, Vert is particularly effective when used generously across a space. For wet room floors and shower trays, additional anti-slip measures are required. Pair with the other Versailles colours, or introduce Elixir and Taj Mahal, for chequerboards and more intricate compositions. Versailles marble requires sealing.

All Versailles marbles are honed to a smooth, dependable finish with a soft, understated sheen that allows the natural character of the stone to take centre stage. Each tile measures 45.7 × 45.7cm, a beautifully considered and wonderfully versatile format: substantial enough to give a floor presence, yet modest enough to sit comfortably within smaller spaces and more intricate patterns – a perfect middle ground.

Other tile formats can also be produced to order; please contact us to discuss any particular requirements you may have.

bodyHtml:
Oasis Ceramic White Gloss tiles evoke the timeless charm of Moroccan Zellige craftsmanship, offering a gleaming finish that adds a touch of elegance to any interior wall. Their glossy surface reflects light beautifully, creating a sense of depth and movement.

Designed in a classic brick shape, these tiles are perfect for creating a seamless and sophisticated look. The white gloss finish enhances their versatility, allowing them to complement a range of styles from modern to traditional.

name: Abbey Porcelain Parquet Blend
bodyHtml:
Named after the National Trust’s beautiful Lacock Abbey, just a stone’s throw from our Wiltshire home, Abbey Porcelain Dove & Ivory captures the quiet romance of time-worn floors with a thoroughly modern practicality.

Designed in small formats that echo traditional craftsmanship, these porcelain tiles celebrate the character of aged stone. A subtly textured surface brings softness underfoot, while meticulously replicated tumbled edges lend the kind of gentle irregularity you would expect to find in a centuries-old setting.

The interplay of Dove and Ivory invites creativity. Lay them in a classic chequerboard for a heritage look that feels both grounded and graphic, or choose a parquet formation to introduce rhythm and movement across the floor. However styled, they create spaces with presence and poise.

Perfect for interiors that seek to balance history with contemporary ease, Abbey Porcelain Dove & Ivory offers enduring charm, thoughtfully reimagined in porcelain.

name: Premium White Semi-Rapid Adhesive
bodyHtml:
Premium White Semi-Rapid Adhesive is expertly crafted for use with porcelain, mosaic, and natural stone. Its single-part formulation ensures a reliable bond, making it an essential choice for various tiling projects.

This adhesive stands out with its enhanced flexibility, designed to accommodate areas where slight movement or vibration may occur. Its semi-rapid setting nature allows for efficient application without compromising on performance.

With a bed thickness ranging from 3mm to 20mm, this adhesive provides versatile coverage, adapting to different installation needs. It covers approximately 4.5kg per m² at a 3mm bed thickness, ensuring efficient use of materials.

Suitable for both internal and external applications, the Premium White Semi-Rapid Adhesive is a practical solution for diverse environments. Its adaptability makes it well-suited for projects requiring a dependable and flexible adhesive.

Combining practicality with performance, this adhesive is a refined choice for those seeking reliability in their tiling endeavors. Trust in its design to support your next project with confidence.

Crafted from limestone, these tiles are suitable for both internal and external use, seamlessly transitioning from kitchen to hallway. Their robust nature ensures they stand up to the demands of everyday life, while their aesthetic remains effortlessly refined.

Whether placed in a bustling kitchen or a serene hallway, these tiles offer a versatile foundation that complements a range of design styles. Their seasoned colour palette and tactile surface invite a sense of calm sophistication into the home.

With a requirement for sealing, these tiles promise longevity and enduring appeal, marrying practicality with timeless design. Riviera Limestone Tumbled tiles are a considered choice for those seeking understated elegance.

These tiles work beautifully in spaces that embrace the 'inside-out' concept, effortlessly connecting indoor and outdoor aesthetics. Their neutral palette ensures they harmonise with a variety of design elements.

With a focus on both form and function, Buscot Limestone Etched Finish offers a timeless solution for those seeking a balance between style and practicality. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their pristine condition.

With Louvre Porcelain Blanc, enjoy the look and feel of high-end design without the need for sealing, ensuring a low-maintenance yet stylish solution for your home.

name: Long Island Marble Honed Finish
bodyHtml:
Long Island Marble Honed Finish tiles present a timeless elegance, with a classic white base and subtle grey veining that speaks to refined taste. Their honed finish accentuates the marble's natural crystalline structure, offering a sophisticated touch to any interior.

These tiles are crafted from marble, a material celebrated for its enduring beauty and versatility. Their square format makes them a versatile choice for both modern and traditional settings, allowing the natural patterns to flow seamlessly across walls and floors.

Designed for internal use, these tiles are well suited to bathrooms, kitchens, and splashbacks, where their understated charm can truly shine. Please note, they require sealing to maintain their pristine appearance over time.

In terms of installation, it's important to store these tiles in a dry area and use a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive, to prevent efflorescence. This ensures the longevity and quality of the installation.

Embodying a blend of classic and contemporary style, Long Island Marble Honed Finish tiles are a thoughtful choice for those seeking to add a touch of elegance to their space.

name: Woodland Glade Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Woodland Glade Porcelain tiles invite you into a serene landscape, capturing the essence of native foliage with their intricate patterns and soft, organic green hues. Each tile is a canvas of nature, offering a unique glimpse into the beauty of leaves, plants, and flowers.

Crafted in a hexagonal shape with a matt finish, these tiles display a blend of designs that are randomly mixed within each box. This ensures a dynamic and varied installation, bringing a touch of the wild to your interiors or exteriors.

Made from durable porcelain, Woodland Glade tiles are suitable for use on both walls and floors. They are designed for versatility, performing well in bathrooms, kitchens, patios, and more. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they offer a practical choice for spaces where safety is a consideration.

Imagine these tiles gracing a feature wall or forming the foundation of a tranquil patio, seamlessly integrating with the natural world. Their green palette and nature-inspired motifs make them well-suited to spaces that seek harmony with the outdoors.

Please note that due to production limitations, not all designs may be included within every order. Embrace the natural variation that makes each installation of Woodland Glade Porcelain tiles a unique expression of style and elegance.

name: Maroc Ceramic Bianco
bodyHtml:

The square format and slightly undulated surface of these tiles create an authentic handmade feel, reminiscent of time-honoured techniques. The glossy Bianco colour adds a refined elegance, making them a versatile choice for various interior styles.

Crafted from durable ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, gracing walls in bathrooms, kitchens, splashbacks, and even shower and wet room walls. The gloss finish enhances the light play across the surface, adding depth and interest.

With their understated yet expressive design, these tiles are well suited to spaces where a touch of tradition meets modern functionality. Pair them with natural materials or contemporary fixtures for a balanced aesthetic.

Maroc Ceramic Bianco tiles offer a quietly confident blend of style and practicality, perfect for those who appreciate the beauty of artisanal design without the need for sealing.

name: Rialto Terrazzo Veneta Honed
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless beauty of Venice, the Rialto Terrazzo Veneta Honed tiles capture the essence of this historic city. Crafted from recycled and waste marble materials, they offer a sustainable choice that doesn't compromise on style.

The honed finish of these tiles provides a smooth, matte surface that enhances their understated elegance. With a colour palette rooted in classic white, the Veneta design subtly echoes the traditional terrazzo patterns found throughout Venetian architecture.

Made from terrazzo, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited to a variety of spaces including bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways. Their PTV 22 slip rating when wet ensures a practical choice for areas where safety is a priority.

These tiles effortlessly blend into both modern and patterned settings, offering versatility in design. Whether used on walls or floors, they bring a touch of Italian sophistication to any room.

Please note, due to the technical characteristics of this material, sealing is required. For installation, we recommend using an S2 adhesive, as our Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive is not suitable for this product.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), these cobbles offer a characterful addition to your design, embodying both style and substance.

name: Protective Card
bodyHtml:
The Protective Card is an essential component for any tiling project, designed to safeguard your floors during the critical curing phase. Its grey hue blends seamlessly with a variety of interiors, ensuring a discreet presence.

Crafted for internal use, this loose-lay sheeting provides a practical solution for protecting newly tiled surfaces. It allows the floor to breathe, facilitating the natural drying process after grouting.

By enabling airflow, the Protective Card helps to ensure that your tiles cure properly, maintaining their integrity and appearance over time. This makes it a thoughtful addition to any tiling toolkit.

Whether you're working on a kitchen, bathroom, or utility space, this protective layer is a reliable choice for maintaining the quality of your work. It's designed to be used with ease, offering peace of mind during the finishing stages of your project.

Incorporating the Protective Card into your tiling process is a simple yet effective way to uphold the craftsmanship of your installation. Trust in its purpose-driven design to support your project from start to finish.

name: Folio Marble Honed Finish
bodyHtml:
Folio is a bone marble, cream bone, with lighter bone highlights running through it. The veining is calcite grey, and there are fine gold spider veins threading across some of the pieces. Honed to a soft, low sheen, it has a smooth surface that feels warm underfoot and sits comfortably in older houses and in newer, quieter architecture.

Folio is quarried rather than manufactured, so it varies. Tone shifts from piece to piece, the grey calcite runs heavier in some than others, and the gold spider veining appears more in some pieces than others. That movement is what gives a Folio floor its depth. As with any marble, it needs blending as it is laid, and that is an artistic job rather than a mechanical one. Tiles are supplied loose, so lay several out together, look at them dry, and spread the lighter and heavier pieces across the whole room rather than letting them gather in one area. No marble looks its best until it is grouted, sealed and the room is finished. Judge it then, not part way through.

Folio is supplied unsealed and will need sealing before and after grouting to keep it looking its best. It is for internal use, on walls and floors, and works in bathrooms, showers and wet rooms, kitchens and hallways.

Complementary slabs for bespoke work

We hold Folio in slab form alongside the tiles, so worktops, vanity tops, shower trays, window sills, thresholds and step treads can all be cut in Folio to sit with the floor. It is the same marble, but the tiles and the slabs are cut from different blocks and produced at different times, so the slab complements the tile rather than matches it. Our Projects Division handles the templating, fabrication and finishing. See the Folio Marble slab, or speak to us about Folio bespoke and we'll talk it through.

name: Pumice Porcelain Off White
bodyHtml:

Crafted with a highly textured finish, these tiles are soft underfoot, offering both visual and tactile appeal. The full-body porcelain design ensures that the intricate pattern runs throughout the tile, meaning chips or scrapes remain inconspicuous.

Made from 40% recycled material, these tiles reflect a commitment to sustainable design. They are suitable for internal use, with a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, providing peace of mind in both kitchens and bathrooms.

Whether adorning walls or floors, Pumice Porcelain tiles are well suited to spaces like hallways, kitchens, and bathrooms. Their terrazzo effect adds character and depth, making them a refined choice for those seeking a blend of tradition and modernity.

With their thoughtful design and practical benefits, Pumice Porcelain Off White tiles offer a harmonious balance of style and functionality, ensuring they remain a timeless addition to any home.

bodyHtml:

The subtle tonal variations and antique-inspired finish give these flagstones a characterful presence, making them a refined choice for both traditional and contemporary settings.

Crafted from limestone, they are designed for both indoor and outdoor use, bringing a cohesive flow from kitchens and hallways to patios. The velvet finish adds a tactile quality that enhances their appeal.

These tiles are well-suited to spaces that appreciate natural materials, offering a seamless blend of style and practicality. Their versatility makes them an excellent fit for a variety of design schemes.

For optimal performance, sealing is required, ensuring that their beauty endures over time. Romaine Limestone Velvet Finish tiles are a testament to considered design and enduring quality.

name: Buscot Limestone Parquet Tumbled & Etched Finish
bodyHtml:
Buscot Limestone Parquet tiles bring a touch of rustic charm with their tumbled and etched finish, creating a surface that feels both timeworn and inviting. The gentle rounding of the edges adds character, making these tiles a thoughtful choice for those who appreciate subtle detailing.

The tumbled finish softens the edges, while the etched surface provides a slightly bleached appearance, lending a cohesive look that suits both traditional and contemporary settings. This dual finish not only enhances visual appeal but also ensures a seamless transition from indoor to outdoor areas.

Crafted from durable limestone, these tiles are well-suited for both internal and external applications, including kitchens, hallways, patios, and even poolside areas. The etched finish also offers a practical benefit by reducing the risk of slipping, making them an ideal option for spaces where safety is a priority.

These tiles invite versatility in styling, effortlessly complementing a range of design schemes. Whether paired with modern furnishings or classic decor, they add a layer of warmth and texture that enriches any environment.

With their enduring appeal and practical features, Buscot Limestone Parquet tiles are a refined choice for those seeking a balance of style and functionality. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their beauty and longevity.

name: Bergamo Limestone Lightly Seasoned Finish
bodyHtml:
Bergamo Limestone in the lightly seasoned finish combines timeless appeal with distinctive texture. The stone is lightly sandblasted before tumbling, creating a subtle orange peel effect — think of it as a stonewashed, naturally bleached character that softens fossilisation and variation across the surface.

The result is a more consistent, refined appearance than raw limestone, yet retains the texture and depth that makes natural stone special. This finish is ideal for interiors seeking sophisticated surfaces with genuine tactile qualities. The soft, warm cream tones work beautifully in contemporary and traditional spaces alike, bringing understated elegance and practical durability to any room.

Available in a variety of formats, Bergamo Limestone adapts to any design vision. The square 40x40 format pairs exceptionally well with other stones in that size from our collection, allowing you to create striking checkerboard designs that add visual interest and contemporary character to floors and walls.

name: Preen Porcelain Mosaic Blush
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the delicate beauty of bird feathers, Preen Porcelain Mosaic Blush tiles bring a touch of nature's elegance into your home. Their design captures the intricate veining found in real feathers, creating a three-dimensional effect that adds depth and interest to any space.

The gloss finish enhances the bright, metallic tones, offering a captivating sheen that plays with light and shadow. This mosaic format allows for a dynamic visual experience, perfect for those looking to make a statement with their interior walls.

Crafted from porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them a refined choice for splashbacks and feature walls. The crackle glaze finish adds a layer of texture and intrigue, inviting closer inspection and admiration.

Well suited to modern interiors, these tiles can transform a simple wall into a focal point, bringing a sense of artistry and craftsmanship to your design scheme. Pair them with neutral tones or contrasting colours for a striking effect.

Please note, these tiles require sealing with Crackle Glaze Protector to maintain their unique finish. This ensures their longevity and preserves their beautiful appearance over time.

Made from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, suitable for both walls and floors. With an R9 slip rating, they provide a practical choice for areas where safety is a concern, such as bathrooms and kitchens.

Whether you're looking to create a cohesive flow throughout an open-plan space or define specific zones, Franklin Porcelain Light tiles offer versatility and style. Their light brown hue complements a range of colour palettes, making them a thoughtful addition to any design scheme.

These tiles are an elegant choice for those who appreciate the timeless appeal of wood, combined with the practicality of porcelain. With no sealing required, they offer a low-maintenance solution that doesn't compromise on aesthetic appeal.

Whether adorning the walls and floors of a bathroom, shower, or kitchen, or enhancing a patio, Mermaid's Garden tiles bring a touch of nature's elegance to any setting. Pair them with our Signature Hexagons for a cascading effect or let them stand alone for a bold statement.

With their combination of artistic design and practical features, Mermaid's Garden tiles offer a refined choice for those seeking to infuse their spaces with character and charm.

name: Long Island Marble Tumbled Finish
bodyHtml:
Long Island Marble Tumbled Finish tiles bring an air of timeless elegance with their classic white surface and soft grey veining. The tumbled finish imparts an aged, lived-in appearance, making these tiles a refined choice for both traditional and modern interiors.

Crafted from durable marble, these tiles are designed for internal use, gracing walls and floors with a subtle yet striking presence. Their square shape and tumbled texture add depth and character, creating a serene backdrop in any space.

While these tiles are a beautiful addition to bathrooms, kitchens, and splashbacks, it's important to note that they are prone to efflorescence. To mitigate this, store them in a dry area and use a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive.

For a classic aesthetic, consider pairing Long Island with Kendal marble to craft a chequerboard pattern that exudes sophistication and charm. This combination enhances the visual appeal and creates a harmonious flow throughout the room.

With their enduring appeal and understated elegance, Long Island Marble Tumbled Finish tiles offer a perfect balance of design and practicality, ensuring they remain a cherished feature in your home for years to come.

name: Franklin Porcelain Pearl

Crafted in a generous 19.5 x 120cm plank format, these tiles provide a seamless flow across spaces, enhancing the sense of continuity in open-plan areas. The satin finish adds a touch of understated elegance, making it a versatile choice for diverse design schemes.

Made from durable porcelain, Franklin Porcelain Pearl is designed for internal use, suitable for both walls and floors. With an R9 slip rating, these tiles offer a practical solution for high-traffic areas, ensuring safety without compromising on style.

Whether adorning the floors of a bustling kitchen or the walls of a serene bathroom, these tiles serve as a refined backdrop, allowing for creative expression through furniture and decor. Their neutral pearl hue harmonises effortlessly with a variety of colour palettes.

With no sealing required, Franklin Porcelain Pearl combines ease of maintenance with aesthetic appeal, making it a considered choice for those seeking both form and function in their interiors.

name: Wychwood Limestone Paving Tumbled & Etched Finish
bodyHtml:
Wychwood Limestone Paving brings a touch of nature's palette to your outdoor spaces, with its rich blend of earthy, autumnal hues. These flagstones transition from fawn-brown to cream, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

The tumbled and etched finish of these limestone pavers lends them a timeless, softly aged appearance. This extra etching process enhances their suitability for external use, ensuring they stand the test of time while maintaining their rustic charm.

Crafted from limestone, these pavers are designed for outdoor applications, making them an excellent choice for patios and swimming pool surrounds. They are endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), a testament to their quality and appeal.

These pavers seamlessly integrate into traditional and rustic settings, offering a natural complement to garden landscapes. Their understated elegance allows them to harmonize effortlessly with a variety of outdoor designs.

For best results, these limestone pavers require sealing. Their enduring appeal and practical benefits make them a refined choice for enhancing your outdoor environments with both style and substance.

bodyHtml:

Menara Cotto Arches are well suited to spaces such as bathrooms, kitchens and hallways. Their timeless appeal and subtle colour palette make them a fitting choice for both contemporary and traditional settings.

With a focus on both aesthetics and practicality, these tiles offer a refined way to introduce Moroccan flair into your home. Their enduring design ensures they remain a cherished feature for years to come.

name: Butler Porcelain Marquina
bodyHtml:
The Butler Porcelain Marquina tiles draw inspiration from the timeless elegance of monochrome floors, a style cherished since ancient times. Their striking marble effect captures the eye, offering a modern twist on a classic aesthetic.

Crafted in a square format, these tiles feature a sophisticated matt finish that enhances their marble graphic. The interplay between the crisp white Calacatta and the deep, opulent Marquina creates a dramatic chequerboard pattern when paired together, yet they hold their own as standalone pieces.

Made from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them a refined choice for spaces like kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they provide a practical solution for areas prone to moisture.

To achieve the desired chequerboard effect, it is important to note that these non-rectified tiles require a 3mm grout joint. This detail ensures precision in installation, allowing the pattern to truly shine.

With no sealing required, Butler Porcelain Marquina tiles offer a blend of style and practicality, bringing a touch of classic elegance to any interior setting.

name: Antwerp Granite Cobbleheads
bodyHtml:
Some materials come with a story already written, and Antwerp Granite Cobbleheads carry centuries within them.

Reclaimed from streets across Western Europe, these granite cobbles have been shaped by time. Their surfaces are gently worn, edges softened by years of footsteps, wheels and weather, creating a beautifully lived in character that cannot be replicated. The palette is equally rich, moving effortlessly from warm greige to soft grey, with green grey tones and the occasional blush of pink adding depth and variation throughout.

Cut down from traditional full cobble depth, these cobbleheads offer a more considered, efficient format, allowing for greater yield while remaining practical to transport and install. The result is a surface that feels steeped in history, yet entirely at home in contemporary design.

Outdoors, they bring texture and rhythm to pathways and terraces, form striking inlaid rugs within larger paved areas, or define spaces with quiet confidence. With the correct substrate and installation, they are equally suited to domestic driveways, where their strength and durability come into their own.

As a natural granite, they are exceptionally hardy, built to withstand the demands of everyday life. Sealing is recommended to help maintain their appearance over time and is particularly advised in areas exposed to heavier use, such as outdoor kitchens or barbecue spaces.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, making them versatile for various spaces such as bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios. They also feature a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet, ensuring safety without compromising on style.

Imagine these tiles gracing your walls or floors, adding depth and character to your environment. Whether paired with coordinating borders or used solo, they offer endless possibilities for personalisation and design.

Embrace the opportunity to create a truly unique space with the Aventuras Porto Olive tiles, a blend of heritage and modern design that speaks to both tradition and innovation.

Designed for indoor use, these tiles are well suited for bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, splashbacks, and feature walls. Their porcelain construction ensures durability and a long-lasting performance in high-moisture areas.

Whether used to create a striking feature wall or an inviting splashback, these tiles add a sense of drama and elegance to modern and patterned design schemes. Their bold colour and unique shape make them a standout choice for those looking to make a statement.

Please note, these tiles require sealing with Crackle Glaze Protector to maintain their beautiful finish. A considered choice for those who appreciate the blend of artistry and practicality.

Crafted for indoor use, these click tiles are designed for practicality and ease. With an R9 slip rating, they offer a safe and stylish flooring option for bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways. The gloss finish further ensures a low-maintenance surface that retains its beauty over time.

The neutral grey palette of the Pisa Minérale tiles makes them a versatile foundation for various design schemes. Whether you lean towards contemporary or traditional styles, these tiles provide a subtle backdrop that complements your aesthetic vision.

Embrace the understated elegance and practicality of the Pisa Minérale Pure Gloss Click Tile, a choice that combines design integrity with everyday functionality.

name: Maroc Ceramic Bordeaux

With their traditional yet versatile style, these tiles can be used to create a striking chequerboard pattern or a more understated plain wall. They bring a sense of warmth and character to any space, effortlessly blending with a variety of design schemes.

Maroc Ceramic Bordeaux is a refined choice for those seeking to introduce an artisanal effect into their home, offering a balance of beauty and practicality without the need for sealing.

Carter Ceramic Milk tiles bring a touch of artisanal charm to any space, capturing the essence of traditional glazed ceramics. Their glossy finish and creamy hue create a serene backdrop, ideal for adding subtle sophistication to your interiors.

These tiles measure 7.5 x 30cm and are designed with versatility in mind. Their brick shape allows for a variety of layout options, whether you prefer the timeless appeal of a brick bond or the contemporary flair of a herringbone pattern.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are perfect for internal walls, making them a refined choice for bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and splashbacks. The glossy surface enhances the light in a room, providing a luminous effect that brightens up any area.

With their understated elegance, Carter Ceramic Milk tiles complement both modern and traditional settings. Pair them with other neutral tones for a cohesive look or use them as a gentle contrast against bolder colours.

These tiles offer a beautiful balance of design and practicality, requiring no sealing and ensuring easy maintenance. Their timeless appeal ensures they will remain a cherished feature in your home for years to come.

name: Burley Minérale Plank Click Tile
bodyHtml:
Embrace the timeless appeal of wood with the Burley Minérale Plank Click Tile, a harmonious blend of classic design and modern practicality. These tiles capture the essence of honey-brown oak, offering a warm and inviting backdrop for any interior space.

With subtle linear wood veining, the Burley tiles present a refined wood effect that adds depth and character to your floors. The realistic light texture enhances their natural appearance, making them indistinguishable from genuine wood planks.

Crafted in a convenient click tile format, these tiles are designed for ease of installation, providing a seamless finish. The textured surface not only elevates the aesthetic but also contributes to their R9 slip rating, ensuring safety in various settings.

Ideal for internal use, these tiles are well-suited to kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways, where their warm tones can create a cohesive and welcoming atmosphere. Their versatile nature allows them to complement a range of design styles, from contemporary to traditional.

Burley Minérale Plank Click Tiles offer an elegant solution for those seeking the look of wood with the durability and practicality of modern materials. Their enduring charm and functional design make them a thoughtful choice for any home.

name: Palm Springs Porcelain Italiana Fluted
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the iconic city of Palm Springs, these Italiana Fluted tiles capture the essence of modern elegance with a nod to natural beauty. Their marble effect brings a touch of sophistication to any space, echoing the clean lines and serene atmosphere of their namesake.

These tiles boast a fluted design, offering a textural dimension that enhances their visual appeal. The satin finish adds a subtle sheen, creating a refined backdrop that plays with light and shadow. Their rectangular shape allows for versatile installation, whether used as a feature wall or a splashback.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them a practical choice for bathrooms, kitchens, and wet rooms. Their resilience ensures they maintain their beauty over time without the need for sealing, simplifying maintenance.

Incorporate these tiles into a variety of settings, from contemporary bathrooms to stylish kitchen splashbacks. Their understated marble effect complements both modern and traditional design schemes, offering endless possibilities for creative expression.

With their blend of style and practicality, Palm Springs Porcelain Italiana Fluted tiles bring a touch of California cool to your interiors, effortlessly combining form and function.

Whether you're looking to create a feature wall or a subtle backdrop, these tiles offer endless possibilities. Pair them with neutral tones for a calming effect or mix with other colours from the Carter range for a bolder statement.

name: Brewhouse Porcelain Rectangle
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the historic brewhouse at Moseley Old Hall, the Brewhouse Porcelain Rectangle tiles capture the essence of aged terracotta with a modern twist. These tiles evoke a sense of time-honoured tradition, making them a refined choice for those seeking a rustic yet sophisticated aesthetic.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles feature a textured finish that enhances their stone effect, offering a tactile experience underfoot. Their rectangular shape adds a structured elegance to any setting, while the warm red tones provide a welcoming ambiance.

Designed for both indoor and outdoor use, these tiles are as practical as they are beautiful. With a slip rating of R12 and a non-porous surface, they are well suited for bathrooms, kitchens, and even patio areas, ensuring safety and ease of maintenance.

Whether you're envisioning a farmhouse kitchen or a classic bathroom scheme, these tiles offer versatility and charm. Their ability to seamlessly blend into various design styles makes them a thoughtful addition to any space.

Brewhouse Porcelain Rectangle tiles embody a balance of design and functionality, offering a timeless appeal that is both enduring and accessible. Their characterful presence promises to enrich any environment with understated elegance.

With their soothing palette and polished finish, these tiles provide a harmonious blend of design and functionality, ideal for those seeking to infuse their space with understated elegance.

Chatham Porcelain Natural tiles are well-suited to modern and traditional settings alike. Their warm tones add a homely touch to contemporary spaces, while seamlessly integrating with more classic designs.

Effortlessly blending design and practicality, these tiles provide a characterful foundation for any project. Their natural elegance and versatility make them a thoughtful choice for those seeking enduring appeal.

Rio Porcelain tiles embody a balance of design and practicality, offering a natural feel that enriches any environment. With no sealing required, they are a low-maintenance option that doesn't sacrifice elegance.

name: Amaya Limestone Tumbled Finish
bodyHtml:
Amaya Limestone Tumbled Finish tiles bring a subtle elegance to any interior space. With their cool grey tones, these tiles effortlessly bridge the gap between modern and traditional design, offering a timeless appeal that complements a variety of styles.

The tumbled finish of these limestone tiles introduces a sense of understated texture, enhanced by occasional darker clouding and light speckled fossils. This natural variation adds depth and character, creating a surface that feels both refined and inviting.

Crafted from quality limestone, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them a practical choice for both wall and floor applications. They are well suited to areas such as bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways, where their durability and aesthetic appeal can truly shine.

Envision these tiles in a chequerboard pattern or laid in a more traditional format, where their cool tones and tactile finish can enhance the overall ambiance of the room. Their versatility allows them to adapt seamlessly to a range of interior designs.

Please note, sealing is required to maintain the natural beauty and longevity of the limestone. Amaya Limestone Tumbled Finish tiles offer a calm and considered choice for those seeking a harmonious blend of style and practicality.

name: Vieux Bourgogne Limestone Artisan Antiqued Finish
bodyHtml:
Vieux Bourgogne Limestone in an Artisan Antiqued Finish captures the essence of aged elegance. These tiles evoke a sense of history, reminiscent of reclaimed stone with their unique, hand-worked appearance.

The Artisan Antique Finish represents an advanced evolution of the popular Weathered finish. Beginning with the same limestone base, our artisans take the weathered stone further through additional hand-working techniques. The surface undergoes careful grinding, followed by honing and polishing stages, intensifying the time-worn appearance of aged flagstones and creating an even more authentic patina of age and character.

Crafted from limestone, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for kitchens and hallways. Their natural finish adds a tactile quality that complements their visual appeal.

These tiles are perfect for spaces that embrace a traditional or rustic style, offering a seamless blend of old-world character and modern craftsmanship. Their enduring design makes them a thoughtful choice for heritage-inspired interiors.

With their authentically antiqued finish, these tiles provide both visual interest and practical utility, requiring sealing to maintain their beauty over time.

name: Blandford Limestone Honed Finish
bodyHtml:
The Blandford Limestone Honed Finish tiles present a serene canvas with their soft, pale beige tones. These flagstones are adorned with minute fossils, offering a glimpse into nature's artistry while maintaining a uniform appearance.

The honed finish enhances their understated elegance, making them a versatile choice for both modern and traditional settings. Their subtle texture and timeless appeal allow them to blend seamlessly into a variety of design schemes.

Crafted from limestone, these tiles are designed for internal use, particularly well-suited for kitchens and hallways. Please note, they require sealing to maintain their pristine condition and performance over time.

While their neutral palette serves as a perfect backdrop, the presence of efflorescence is a possibility. To mitigate this, it is recommended to store the tiles in a dry area and use a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive.

With their refined finish and natural charm, the Blandford Limestone tiles offer a quietly confident addition to any interior space, balancing both design and practicality.

name: Preen Porcelain Mosaic Verdigris
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the delicate beauty of bird feathers, Preen Porcelain Mosaic Verdigris brings a sense of elegance to any space. These tiles feature a three-dimensional effect that mirrors the intricate veining found in nature, creating an interior that's both unique and captivating.

The glossy crackle glaze finish enhances the vibrant verdigris tones, adding depth and a touch of metallic sheen. This artisanal quality is achieved through a raku-style reactive glaze, giving each tile a distinct character with variations in colour intensity and tonal evenness.

Crafted from porcelain, these mosaics are designed for indoor use, making them a refined choice for splashbacks and feature walls. The tiles' dynamic surface and shimmering hues invite a play of light, transforming walls into a canvas of movement and texture.

It's important to note that due to the small-batch production process, considerable variation between batches is expected. The glaze pools and breaks unpredictably, resulting in a unique rim effect around the edges of each tesserae.

For optimal performance, these tiles require sealing with Crackle Glaze Protector. This ensures their beauty is preserved while maintaining their striking visual appeal.

name: Winchester Porcelain Paving Textured
bodyHtml:
The Winchester Porcelain Paving Textured tiles bring the timeless beauty of limestone to your outdoor spaces. With their realistic veined print and a versatile fawny-beige hue, they create a welcoming atmosphere for patios and terraces.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed to withstand the elements, making them an excellent choice for external applications. Their textured finish not only enhances the stone effect but also provides an R11 slip rating, ensuring safety in wet conditions.

These tiles are endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), a testament to their quality and suitability for garden settings. They require no sealing, offering a low-maintenance solution for busy outdoor areas.

Imagine these tiles gracing the floor of your swimming pool surround or patio, seamlessly blending with natural landscapes. Their understated elegance complements a variety of outdoor furniture and plantings, allowing for creative freedom in your design.

Winchester Porcelain Paving Textured tiles offer a refined balance of aesthetics and practicality, making them a thoughtful choice for enhancing your outdoor living spaces.

These tiles feature a glossy finish that enhances their iridescent quality, creating a dynamic visual effect reminiscent of naturally aged surfaces. Their brick shape lends itself to a variety of design possibilities.

Perfect for bathrooms, kitchens, and splashbacks, these tiles integrate seamlessly into both modern and traditional settings. Their versatile design allows for creative expression in any room.

With no sealing required, Foundry Porcelain Bianco tiles offer a practical yet stylish solution for those seeking to infuse their interiors with a touch of historical elegance.

The tiles feature a textured finish that captures the essence of natural wood, offering a tactile experience that enhances both visual and physical spaces. Their white hue adds a sense of lightness, making them versatile for various design aesthetics.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for indoor use, effortlessly gracing walls and floors with their refined presence. With an R9 slip rating, they provide a practical solution for areas where safety is paramount.

Ideal for bathrooms, showers, and wet rooms, Kinfolk Porcelain White tiles also make a striking statement as a feature wall or splashback. Their understated charm allows them to complement both modern and traditional settings.

With no need for sealing, these tiles offer a balance of beauty and practicality, making them a thoughtful addition to any interior space. Their design-led approach ensures they remain a timeless choice for discerning homeowners.

name: Franklin Porcelain Dark
bodyHtml:
Franklin Porcelain Dark captures the essence of natural timber with its wood-effect design, offering a sophisticated touch to any interior. The dark tones and swirling knots create a sense of depth and character, making these tiles a refined choice for those who appreciate the beauty of nature.

Crafted in a generous 19.5 x 120cm plank format, these tiles bring a seamless, organic flow to spaces. The satin finish adds a subtle sheen, enhancing the realistic wood grain and knots that grace each piece. Whether installed across a wide expanse or used to define specific zones, they offer a cohesive aesthetic.

Made from durable porcelain, Franklin Porcelain Dark is designed for internal use, suitable for both walls and floors. Its R9 slip rating ensures a practical choice for various areas within the home, including bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways. With no sealing required, maintenance is straightforward, allowing the natural beauty to shine through effortlessly.

These tiles are equally at home in contemporary settings or more traditional schemes, offering versatility in design. Their rich, dark colour palette complements a wide range of materials and finishes, providing a solid foundation for creative expression.

Franklin Porcelain Dark is a thoughtful blend of design and functionality, offering an enduring appeal that enhances the ambiance of any room. Its timeless wood-effect design is a testament to the art of subtlety and sophistication.

Imagine these tiles gracing a bathroom, where their understated tones complement a variety of fixtures and fittings. Their timeless appeal ensures they fit seamlessly into both contemporary and classic settings.

Domus Marble Honed Finish tiles offer a perfect balance of aesthetic charm and practical functionality, making them a thoughtful addition to any interior design project.

The surface is dappled with darker fossil accents, adding a layer of visual interest and depth. This subtle variation in tone sets this batch apart, offering a unique twist on one of our best-selling limestone selections.

Crafted from limestone, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them a refined choice for both walls and floors. The tumbled finish enhances their rustic appeal, while the natural stone composition ensures durability.

Well suited to kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways, they seamlessly integrate into traditional and rustic settings, providing a cohesive and considered aesthetic. Their warm tones complement a variety of interior palettes, creating a harmonious flow throughout your home.

Please note, these tiles require sealing to maintain their beauty and performance over time. With thoughtful care, they will continue to enrich your space with their characterful presence.

name: Sculpture Grande Porcelain Calacatta Maximus
bodyHtml:

Crafted in an extra-large format, these tiles are designed to minimise grout lines, creating a seamless and expansive look. The brushed finish adds a tactile dimension, enhancing the visual depth of the Calacatta Maximus pattern.

Made from premium porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for indoor use, particularly in bathrooms, kitchens, and wet rooms. Their PTV 24 slip rating when wet ensures a practical choice for both wall and floor applications, combining style with safety.

The white hues and marble effect of these tiles make them a versatile addition to various design schemes, whether you're aiming for a minimalist aesthetic or a more opulent setting. They effortlessly blend with different interior styles, providing a timeless backdrop.

With Sculpture Grande Porcelain Calacatta Maximus, you can achieve a balance of elegance and functionality, bringing a touch of sophistication to your living spaces.

name: Brompton Porcelain Borough
bodyHtml:
Embrace the timeless allure of the Victorian era with the Brompton Porcelain Borough tiles. These tiles effortlessly capture the essence of period design, making them a refined choice for those seeking to infuse their spaces with historical charm.

Featuring a traditional patterned design, these tiles offer a distinctive character that resonates with the elegance of yesteryear. Their matt finish and square shape create a harmonious balance, allowing the pattern to take centre stage whether used on walls or floors.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for high-traffic areas, both indoors and outdoors. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they provide a practical solution for spaces such as bathrooms, kitchens, and patios, ensuring safety without compromising on style.

Imagine these tiles gracing a conservatory floor or forming a striking feature in a hallway. Their versatility extends to creating captivating pathways and courtyards, seamlessly connecting indoor and outdoor environments.

Please note, these products are unrectified, and size differences may occur when mixing two colours. This characteristic adds to their authentic appeal, reinforcing their heritage-inspired design.

name: Ashurst Minérale Plank Click Tile
bodyHtml:
The Ashurst Minérale Plank Click Tile brings a warm, wood-effect aesthetic to your interior spaces. Its rich brown tones are interspersed with rustic colour variations, creating an inviting atmosphere that resonates with natural charm.

These tiles feature darker swirling veins and knots, adding depth and character to the design. The textured finish enhances the tactile experience, making them a thoughtful choice for those who appreciate subtle details.

Crafted for internal use, these click tiles are well-suited to floor applications in areas such as bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways. With an R9 slip rating, they offer a practical solution without compromising on style.

Imagine these tiles in a sophisticated hallway or a cosy dining room, where their calming presence can set the tone for the entire space. Their wood-effect design complements a variety of interior styles, from contemporary to traditional.

With no sealing required, the Ashurst Minérale Plank Click Tile combines ease of maintenance with enduring appeal, making it a refined addition to any home.

name: Preen Porcelain Mosaic White
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the delicate elegance of bird feathers, Preen Porcelain Mosaic White tiles present a captivating three-dimensional effect. Their design emulates the intricate veining found in nature, bringing a sense of refined artistry to any space.

These tiles boast a beautiful gloss finish that enhances their bright, metallic tones, creating a luminous effect that adds depth and interest to interiors. The crackle glaze finish contributes to their unique character, making them a standout choice for design-led projects.

Crafted from porcelain, these mosaics are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for splashbacks and feature walls. Their modern style and patterned design offer versatility in contemporary and traditional settings alike.

Preen tiles invite creativity, allowing you to craft spaces that feel both personal and distinctive. Their understated elegance makes them an ideal backdrop for a variety of design schemes, effortlessly enhancing the aesthetic of any room.

Please note, these tiles require sealing with Crackle Glaze Protector to maintain their finish and longevity. This ensures their beauty and performance remain uncompromised over time.

bodyHtml:

Crafted with a textured surface, these tiles are designed to be both visually captivating and gentle underfoot. The full-body porcelain construction ensures that the intricate pattern runs throughout, making chips and scrapes less noticeable over time.

Made from 40% recycled material, these tiles are a thoughtful choice for environmentally conscious design. They are suitable for internal use, offering a practical slip rating of PTV+36 when wet, ensuring safety in high-traffic areas.

Ideal for walls and floors, Pumice Porcelain Camel tiles complement spaces such as kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways. Their stone effect adds depth and character, seamlessly integrating into both contemporary and traditional settings.

With their blend of durability and design, these tiles provide a refined solution for those seeking a balance between aesthetic appeal and everyday functionality.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for indoor use, making them well-suited for bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and splashbacks. Their durable nature ensures they withstand the rigours of daily life while maintaining their visual appeal.

Whether you're envisioning a serene bathroom retreat or a vibrant kitchen splashback, the Seaton Ceramic Sea Cabbage tiles provide a versatile backdrop. Their understated elegance complements a range of interior styles, offering endless design possibilities.

With their effortless blend of practicality and style, these tiles invite you to explore the beauty of coastal-inspired design in your home. A refined choice for those seeking a touch of the sea's allure.

name: Amaya Limestone Tumbled Cabochons
bodyHtml:
The Amaya Limestone Tumbled Cabochons bring a touch of character to any floor, offering a versatile design that fits seamlessly into both traditional and contemporary settings. These smaller tiles are designed to nestle between larger stones, creating a dynamic pattern that draws the eye.

Crafted from slate with a tumbled finish, these cabochons offer a tactile surface that enhances their natural appeal. Measuring 10 x 10cm, they can be used to accentuate larger tiles, adding depth and interest to your space.

While ideal for internal use, particularly in kitchens and hallways, it's important to note that these tiles require sealing to maintain their beauty over time. The tumbled finish provides a refined yet rustic texture, perfect for those seeking a touch of the traditional.

To prevent efflorescence, it's recommended to store these tiles in a dry area and use a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive, during installation.

With their understated elegance, Amaya Limestone Tumbled Cabochons offer a thoughtful choice for those looking to enhance their floors with a subtle yet distinctive design element.

The polished finish of these rectangular tiles enhances their modern marble effect, capturing light and adding a subtle sheen to walls and floors. This refined surface treatment allows the rich malachite colour to shine, evoking the beauty of natural stone.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well suited to bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and feature walls. The material's resilience ensures long-lasting performance without the need for sealing.

Whether used to create a striking feature wall or to envelop a room in calming green, these tiles bring a touch of the outdoors inside. Pair them with neutral tones or contrasting textures for a design that feels both grounded and sophisticated.

Rainforest Porcelain Malachite tiles offer a harmonious blend of design and practicality, inviting you to enjoy their enduring appeal in your home.

Perfectly at home around swimming pools and patios, these tiles bring a touch of understated sophistication to any outdoor setting. Their neutral palette complements a variety of design styles, from modern to traditional.

With a focus on both form and function, Trafalgar Sandstone Etched combines aesthetic appeal with practical performance, making it a timeless addition to your exterior design.

name: Wightwick Ceramic Emerald
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the artistry of William Frend De Morgan, the Wightwick Ceramic Emerald tiles capture the essence of 19th-century craftsmanship. These tiles draw from the rich heritage of Wightwick Manor, where De Morgan's original works can still be admired.

Their jewel-like emerald tones and textured gloss finish create a captivating visual effect, reminiscent of the reactive metallic glazes that De Morgan mastered. Each tile offers a unique iridescent variation, adding depth and interest to any wall.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an excellent choice for bathrooms, splashbacks, and feature walls. Their glossy finish enhances the play of light, creating a dynamic and engaging surface.

Whether in a modern or traditional setting, these tiles bring a touch of history and elegance to your space. They work beautifully as a statement piece or as a complement to other design elements.

With their enduring appeal and nod to historical artistry, the Wightwick Ceramic Emerald tiles offer a refined yet expressive addition to your interiors, celebrating both design and practicality.

name: Brompton Porcelain Greenwich
bodyHtml:
The Brompton Porcelain Greenwich tiles invite a touch of Victorian charm into your home. With a traditional pattern that echoes the elegance of a bygone era, these tiles are a refined choice for those seeking to create a distinctive atmosphere.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these square tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their timeless appeal. Their intricate design is brought to life in a rich green hue, making them a captivating choice for both walls and floors.

Designed for versatility, the Brompton Porcelain Greenwich tiles are suitable for both internal and external applications. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they offer practical performance without compromising on style.

Whether used in a hallway, kitchen, or patio, these tiles create a striking feature that draws the eye. Their Victorian-inspired pattern works beautifully in conservatories and outdoor rooms, adding depth and interest to any space.

Please note, these tiles are unrectified, which may lead to size variations when mixing two colours. This characteristic adds to their authentic charm, ensuring each installation is unique.

With their blend of aesthetic appeal and practical functionality, Buscot Limestone Klinkers provide a refined choice for those seeking to elevate their outdoor spaces with a touch of heritage and craftsmanship.

name: Maroc Ceramic Khaki
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the rich heritage of Moroccan Zellige tiles, Maroc Ceramic Khaki offers a contemporary nod to traditional craftsmanship. With its deep, glossy khaki hue, these tiles evoke a sense of artisanal charm.

The subtle tonal variations and slightly undulated surface of these tiles create an authentic handmade feel, capturing the essence of time-honoured techniques. Their square format and gloss finish enhance the play of light, adding depth and character to any setting.

Crafted from durable ceramic, Maroc Ceramic Khaki is designed for internal use, making it a refined choice for walls in kitchens, bathrooms, and splashbacks. The tiles do not require sealing, ensuring ease of maintenance and lasting appeal.

These tiles effortlessly complement both traditional and modern interiors, offering a versatile solution for those seeking to introduce a touch of Moroccan elegance. Whether used in a shower room or as a kitchen splashback, they bring warmth and texture to the space.

A testament to thoughtful design and practicality, Maroc Ceramic Khaki tiles provide a timeless backdrop that celebrates the beauty of artisanal craftsmanship while meeting the demands of contemporary living.

name: Long Island Marble Herringbone Mosaic
bodyHtml:
The Long Island Marble Herringbone Mosaic offers a timeless elegance with its classic white marble interwoven with subtle grey veining. This mosaic brings a touch of sophistication to any space, making it a refined choice for both traditional and modern interiors.

The intricate herringbone pattern is pre-mounted on a mesh backing, ensuring easy installation and a seamless finish. Each piece showcases the natural beauty of marble, creating a surface that is both visually striking and tactile.

Crafted for internal use, these mosaics are well-suited for bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways, where their natural finish enhances the room's ambiance. Their versatility allows them to grace both walls and floors with equal poise.

It's important to note that these mosaics are prone to efflorescence. To mitigate this, store them in a dry area and use a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive, during installation.

With their understated charm and enduring appeal, the Long Island Marble Herringbone Mosaic is a thoughtful addition to any design scheme, effortlessly bridging the gap between classic and contemporary aesthetics.

name: Lyndhurst Minérale Plank Click Tile
bodyHtml:
Embrace the serene beauty of Scandinavian design with the Lyndhurst Minérale Plank Click Tile. These tiles capture the essence of limewashed oak, featuring a pale beige background enriched by darkly contrasting knots and markings that evoke a natural, rustic charm.

The wood effect design of these tiles is both authentic and understated, offering a textured finish that adds depth and character to any room. The plank format enhances the organic feel, creating a seamless flow across your floors.

Crafted for indoor use, these tiles are well-suited for kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways. With a slip rating of R9, they provide a practical choice for areas where safety is a priority, without compromising on style.

Installation is straightforward thanks to the click system, making these tiles an accessible option for those seeking the look of real wood with the ease of maintenance that comes with modern materials. No sealing is required, ensuring a hassle-free experience.

The Lyndhurst Minérale Plank Click Tile is a thoughtfully designed solution for those who appreciate the beauty of natural wood, combined with the durability and convenience of contemporary tile technology.

Fondant Ceramic Ecru tiles blend seamlessly into both modern and traditional interiors, offering versatility in design. Their subtle texture and natural feel make them a thoughtful addition to any space.

With their harmonious balance of form and function, these tiles provide a quiet sophistication that complements a wide range of interior styles, inviting a touch of warmth and character into your home.

name: Osterley Porcelain White Square
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the storied floors of Osterley Park, these tiles capture the essence of a classic chequerboard pattern, echoing the elegance of time-worn limestone. A nod to history, they offer a timeless appeal that resonates with both traditional and contemporary settings.

Crafted from porcelain, the Osterley Porcelain White Square tiles present a textured finish that enhances their stone effect, providing an authentic look without the maintenance demands of natural stone. Their square shape lends itself to a variety of layouts, allowing for creative expression in any space.

Designed for versatility, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, making them an excellent choice for kitchens, bathrooms, hallways, and patios. With an R11 slip rating, they offer reliable traction even in wet conditions, ensuring safety alongside style.

These tiles are unrectified, meaning slight size variations may occur, particularly when mixing colours. This characteristic adds to their charm, offering a more organic and varied installation that celebrates the beauty of imperfection.

With no sealing required, the Osterley Porcelain White Square tiles seamlessly blend practicality with aesthetic appeal, making them a considered choice for those who appreciate enduring design.

name: Cuba Porcelain Como
bodyHtml:
Embrace the spirit of the Caribbean with Cuba Porcelain Como tiles, where artisanal charm meets modern design. These tiles evoke a sense of craftsmanship with their distinctive geometric patterns and handmade appearance.

The Como colourway offers a subtle grey palette, allowing the intricate designs to take centre stage. Each square tile is a canvas of pattern, creating a dynamic visual effect when laid across a surface.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles boast a matt, textured finish that enhances their tactile appeal. They are designed for both indoor and outdoor use, making them a versatile choice for spaces like bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and patios.

Thanks to their PTV+36 slip rating when wet and R10 classification, these tiles provide a practical solution for areas prone to moisture. Their textured surface ensures safety without compromising on style.

Whether adorning a wall or underfoot, Cuba Porcelain Como tiles bring a touch of the exotic to any setting, blending seamlessly into both contemporary and traditional interiors.

Crafted from ceramic, Hammam Ceramic Bone tiles are designed for internal use, particularly well-suited to bathrooms, splashbacks, and shower or wet room walls. Their satin surface offers a refined texture that complements the understated elegance of the design.

Envision these tiles gracing your bathroom walls, where their warm, neutral tones can effortlessly blend with both contemporary and traditional decor. Their timeless appeal ensures they remain a stylish choice for years to come.

With no sealing required, these tiles provide a practical yet beautiful solution for your interior design needs, marrying functionality with a touch of Moroccan-inspired luxury.

These tiles are well suited to a variety of settings, from bathrooms and kitchens to hallways and patios. Their classic black hue offers a timeless appeal, effortlessly complementing both traditional and contemporary interiors.

Embrace the enduring appeal of Italian design with these tiles, where artistry meets functionality. Sardinia Porcelain Dragonetti tiles invite a touch of heritage into contemporary spaces, balancing beauty with practicality.

bodyHtml:

Designed for indoor use, these terrazzo tiles are well-suited to spaces such as kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways. They possess a slip rating of PTV 22 when wet, ensuring a practical yet refined flooring option.

These tiles offer versatility in both wall and floor applications, allowing for a seamless flow of design throughout your home. Their modern and patterned style complements a variety of interior aesthetics.

Whether framing a pool or defining a patio, Buscot Limestone Coping complements a range of styles with its rustic yet refined presence. Its beige tones lend a warm, inviting feel to any area it graces.

While sealing is required to maintain its integrity, the enduring appeal of this limestone coping ensures it remains a cherished feature in your design landscape.

name: Hoxton Porcelain Amber Matt
bodyHtml:

A soft crystalline lattice pattern moves subtly across the surface, lending depth and texture without overwhelming. Warm, creamy tones sit at its core, timeless in feel and quietly grounding, making it a natural choice for spaces that favour understated elegance.

Suitable for interior walls and floors, and with no sealing required, these tiles offer a considered balance of practicality and design, bringing warmth, texture and an effortless sense of refinement to the spaces they shape.

name: Wightwick Ceramic Ink
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the historic tiles of Wightwick Manor, the Wightwick Ceramic Ink tiles pay homage to the artistry of William Frend De Morgan. Known for reviving the lost art of reactive metallic tile glazing, De Morgan's influence is evident in these tiles' rich, jewel-like tones.

These tiles feature a textured gloss finish that captures the light beautifully, creating an iridescent effect that adds depth and intrigue to any space. The ink-blue hue is both striking and versatile, making it a refined choice for various design schemes.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited to bathrooms, splashbacks, and feature walls. The gloss finish enhances their visual appeal while ensuring they are easy to maintain.

Whether used in a modern setting or a more traditional interior, these tiles bring a touch of historical elegance to the walls they adorn. Their patterned and metro style complements a range of decorative choices, allowing for creative expression in any room.

With no sealing required, the Wightwick Ceramic Ink tiles offer a seamless blend of design and practicality, ensuring they remain a timeless addition to your home.

bodyHtml:

The glossy finish of these tiles enhances their soft parchment colour, creating a subtle play of light across surfaces. Their versatile design allows for creative installations, whether you prefer a classic layout or a more inventive pattern.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an ideal choice for bathroom walls, shower areas, and splashbacks. Their glazed surface ensures easy maintenance, adding practicality to their aesthetic appeal.

These tiles complement both traditional and modern settings, offering a refined backdrop that pairs effortlessly with a variety of styles. Consider using them to add a touch of elegance to kitchens or to create a serene atmosphere in bathrooms.

With Avebury Ceramic Parchment, you achieve a balance of design and function, where the beauty of classic architecture meets the needs of contemporary living.

Imagine these tiles in a serene bathroom setting, or as a sophisticated backdrop in a bustling kitchen. Their versatile design complements a range of interior styles, from modern to more traditional schemes.

With Wychwood Claire, experience the perfect balance of design and functionality, offering a timeless appeal that quietly elevates your space.

Crafted in a warm cotto hue, these tiles feature a matt finish that beautifully captures the essence of traditional stone. Available in both rectangular and square shapes, they create a dynamic chequerboard pattern or a seamless stone effect, depending on your preference.

Made from durable porcelain, Hacienda tiles are designed for internal use, providing a practical yet stylish option for walls and floors. With an R10 slip rating, they offer a reassuring grip, making them suitable for bathrooms, splashbacks, and shower walls.

These tiles are well-suited to a variety of spaces, bringing a touch of rustic elegance to bathrooms and wet rooms. Their stone effect complements both contemporary and traditional settings, allowing for versatile design applications.

With their enduring appeal and thoughtful design, Hacienda Porcelain Cotto tiles offer a refined balance of style and functionality, perfect for those seeking a timeless interior aesthetic.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for indoor use, making them a practical choice for walls and floors alike. They require no sealing, ensuring a low-maintenance solution for busy areas.

Perfectly suited to bathrooms, kitchens, and feature walls, these tiles can transform a space with their modern marble effect. Consider pairing them with complementary flat tiles or rounded beading for a cohesive look.

With their blend of style and practicality, Palm Springs Porcelain Cerulean Fluted tiles offer a refined choice for those looking to infuse their interiors with a touch of Californian charm.

Whether used as a splashback or a feature wall, these tiles effortlessly complement both modern and traditional interiors. Their forest green hue adds a natural vibrancy, enhancing the ambiance of any space they inhabit.

With their tactile finish and enduring design, Bamboo Lustre Porcelain Mosaic Forest tiles offer a harmonious blend of style and functionality. They are a testament to thoughtful design, providing a beautiful backdrop to everyday life.

Whether used in expansive garden spaces or intimate courtyards, these tiles bring a touch of the Cotswolds to your outdoor environment. They pair seamlessly with natural landscapes, enhancing the beauty of any exterior space.
