name: Spitalfields Ceramic Retro Star White
bodyHtml:

Each tile measures 45 x 45cm and features a clever pre-scored line, allowing for easy grouting to create the illusion of four smaller tiles. This thoughtful design detail simplifies installation while maintaining an intricate appearance.

Crafted from ceramic with a matt finish, these tiles are well-suited for internal use on both walls and floors. They offer a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet, ensuring safety without compromising on style.

The Retro Star White pattern brings a touch of traditional elegance to kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways. Its understated white hue harmonizes effortlessly with various interior styles, providing a versatile backdrop for your design vision.

Balancing aesthetic appeal with practicality, the Spitalfields Ceramic Retro Star White tiles are a refined choice for those seeking to infuse their spaces with a sense of timeless sophistication.

name: Rialto Terrazzo Ballerin Honed
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless elegance of Venice, the Rialto Terrazzo Ballerin Honed tiles capture the essence of Italian artistry. These tiles, with their subtle pink hues, pay homage to the rich terrazzo tradition that adorns the historic city's architecture.

Crafted from recycled and waste marble materials, these tiles offer a sustainable option for those seeking both beauty and environmental consciousness. The honed finish adds a refined touch, enhancing the natural patterns and colours inherent in terrazzo.

Designed for internal use, these tiles are suitable for walls and floors in spaces such as bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways. Their PTV 22 slip rating when wet ensures practicality without compromising on style.

name: Cuba Porcelain Mint Green Field
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the vibrant spirit of the Caribbean, Cuba Porcelain Mint Green Field tiles bring a touch of artisanal charm to any space. Their mint green hue evokes a sense of freshness and tranquility, making them an inviting choice for both modern and traditional interiors.

These tiles feature unique geometric patterns that create visual interest and depth. The square format enhances their versatility, allowing for a variety of layout possibilities that can transform walls and floors into dynamic canvases.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for both internal and external use, offering a textured finish that is both practical and aesthetically pleasing. The matt surface not only adds to their tactile appeal but also provides a slip-resistant quality, rated PTV+36 when wet, ensuring safety in wet areas.

Whether adorning a bathroom, shower, wet room, or patio, these tiles effortlessly blend into their surroundings, offering a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor spaces. Their understated elegance makes them a fitting choice for a variety of settings.

With no sealing required, Cuba Porcelain Mint Green Field tiles offer a low-maintenance solution that doesn't compromise on style or functionality, making them a thoughtful addition to any design scheme.

name: Orleans Ceramic Matt
bodyHtml:

Crafted in a larger format with a prescored grout joint, these tiles cleverly create the illusion of smaller tiles, offering a cost-effective solution without compromising on style. The matt finish enhances their understated appeal, adding a subtle texture to walls and floors.

Made from durable ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them a practical choice for kitchens, bathrooms, and wet rooms. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they provide added safety in areas prone to moisture.

The grey tones of the Orleans tiles offer a versatile palette that complements both modern and traditional interiors. They invite creativity, allowing you to pair them with a variety of colours and materials for a cohesive design.

With their blend of vintage character and contemporary practicality, Orleans Ceramic Matt tiles are a refined choice for those seeking to add depth and interest to their home. Their enduring design ensures they remain a timeless addition to any room.

The etched surface of these tiles not only enhances their visual appeal but also provides a practical advantage. The texture ensures a secure footing, making them particularly well-suited for areas around swimming pools and other busy outdoor environments.

Crafted from limestone, these tiles are designed for both internal and external use, offering versatility in application. The etched finish subtly mutes the stone's tones, adding depth and a refined touch to any setting.

Whether gracing a patio or lining a poolside, Wychwood Limestone Paving effortlessly complements a variety of outdoor settings. Its timeless appeal and understated elegance make it a thoughtful choice for those seeking both function and style.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), this paving requires sealing to maintain its beauty and durability. A refined option for enhancing your outdoor spaces with natural charm.

name: Rialto Terrazzo San Marco Honed
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless allure of Venice, Rialto Terrazzo San Marco Honed tiles capture the essence of this iconic city. These tiles echo the vibrant spirit of Venetian landmarks, offering a design that is both classic and contemporary.

Crafted from recycled and waste marble materials, these terrazzo tiles are as sustainable as they are beautiful. The honed finish provides a smooth, matte surface that enhances the intricate patterns and multi-coloured tones, making each tile a unique piece of art.

Designed for internal use, these tiles are well suited to bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways. With a slip rating of PTV 22 when wet, they offer a practical choice for spaces where safety is paramount. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their enduring appeal.

Rialto Terrazzo San Marco Honed tiles bring a touch of Italian elegance to walls and floors, seamlessly integrating into both modern and traditional interiors. Their versatile nature allows them to complement a variety of design schemes effortlessly.

With a focus on sustainability and style, these tiles offer a refined solution for those seeking to infuse their spaces with character and charm. Embrace the beauty of terrazzo with a product that respects both tradition and the environment.

The stick-like mosaic design creates a dynamic visual texture, enhanced by the glossy finish that captures and reflects light beautifully. This unique pattern offers a captivating play of shadows and highlights, reminiscent of aged metallic glazes.

Crafted from porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, ensuring durability and ease of maintenance. The gloss finish adds a layer of sophistication, while the verdigris colour palette brings a subtle depth to any setting.

Perfectly suited for bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and feature walls, these tiles offer versatility across modern and traditional interiors. Their distinctive character can transform a simple splashback into a statement piece.

With no sealing required, Bamboo Porcelain Mosaic Verdigris tiles combine practicality with aesthetic appeal, providing a stylish solution for those looking to infuse their spaces with a touch of nature-inspired elegance.

Ideal for bathrooms, splashbacks, and shower walls, these tiles bring a touch of rustic elegance to any interior. Their stone effect style adds depth and character, effortlessly blending with both contemporary and classic design schemes.

Hacienda Porcelain Sandstone tiles embody a balance of aesthetic appeal and practical functionality, offering an enduring solution for those seeking the warmth and texture of natural stone without the need for sealing.

bodyHtml:
The Wychwood Limestone Tumbled & Etched Double Pencil Coping brings a touch of nature's palette to your space with its rich, earthy tones. These hues evoke the warmth of autumn, making them a versatile choice for various settings.

Crafted from limestone, these copings feature a tumbled and etched finish that enhances their rustic charm. The double pencil profile adds a subtle sculptural element, creating a refined edge that complements traditional and rustic styles.

Designed for both internal and external use, these copings are particularly suited to outdoor environments, thanks to the additional etching process. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their beauty and durability over time.

Whether framing a swimming pool, patio, or enhancing a kitchen or hallway, these copings offer a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor spaces. Their natural texture and colour variation bring depth and interest to any project.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), the Wychwood Limestone Tumbled & Etched Double Pencil Coping is a testament to quality and thoughtful design, balancing aesthetic appeal with practical application.

name: Aquitaine Limestone Seasoned Finish
bodyHtml:
Embodying a rustic charm, the Aquitaine Limestone Seasoned Finish tiles bring a touch of vintage elegance to your space. With their moody grey and charcoal hues, they capture the timeless beauty of French limestone, making them a refined choice for both urban and country design schemes.

The large format and seasoned finish of these tiles create a striking visual impact, enhancing the architectural character of any interior. Their tactile surface adds depth and interest, inviting a sense of heritage into kitchens and hallways.

Crafted from natural limestone, these tiles are designed for internal use, offering a durable and stylish solution for floor applications. Please note, they require sealing to maintain their beauty and longevity.

Efflorescence can occur with these tiles, so it's essential to store them in a dry area and use a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive, to minimize this effect.

With their understated elegance and practical design, Aquitaine Limestone tiles are well-suited to traditional interiors, offering a blend of style and functionality that stands the test of time.

The combination of traditional and modern styles makes them versatile for a range of interiors, whether you're aiming for a classic or contemporary look. Their brick shape and patterned design add both structure and interest to a space.

Wightwick Ceramic Azure tiles are a refined choice for those seeking to incorporate a piece of design history into their home, blending practicality with artistic flair.

bodyHtml:
With a nod to modern design, the Lily Pad Porcelain Admiral tiles bring a fresh, contemporary feel to any space. Their hexagonal shape and deep blue hue create a striking visual impact, making them a standout choice for those who appreciate bold, geometric patterns.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their sophisticated appeal. The machine-made precision ensures uniformity, while the pattern adds a dynamic layer of interest, effortlessly drawing the eye.

Designed for versatility, the Lily Pad Porcelain Admiral tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications. Their robust construction and slip-resistant properties make them a practical choice for high-traffic areas like kitchens, bathrooms, and even patios.

Whether used as a feature wall or a stylish splashback, these tiles offer endless possibilities for creative expression. Their rich colour and pattern complement a range of interior styles, from sleek modern spaces to more eclectic environments.

With minimal maintenance required, these tiles promise both beauty and functionality, making them a refined addition to any project. Their enduring design ensures they remain a timeless element in your home.

name: Riverside Wall Ceramic Linear Perla
bodyHtml:
Riverside Wall Ceramic Linear Perla tiles bring a sophisticated touch to any space with their modern stone effect and elegant satin finish. These tiles are designed to create striking feature walls, offering a serene palette of cool grey tones that evoke a sense of calm and refinement.

The linear format of these tiles adds a contemporary edge, making them a versatile choice for various interior styles. Their understated design allows them to seamlessly integrate into kitchens, bathrooms, and wet rooms, providing a subtle yet impactful backdrop.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are intended for internal use, making them ideal for splashbacks and feature walls. The satin finish enhances their tactile quality, adding depth without overwhelming the space. No sealing is required, ensuring easy maintenance and longevity.

While Riverside Wall tiles complement the Riverside collection, it's important to note that they are not an exact match due to manufacturing variations. This distinction adds to their unique character, allowing for creative pairings and design possibilities.

Incorporating Riverside Wall Ceramic Linear Perla tiles into your design scheme promises a balance of modern aesthetics and practical functionality, making them a considered choice for those seeking both style and substance.

name: Sloane Limestone Honed Finish
bodyHtml:
The Sloane Limestone Honed Finish tiles evoke the timeless elegance of native Portland stone, with their subtle pale-grey flecks adding a touch of sophistication to any interior. These tiles are designed to enhance the natural beauty of living spaces, whether bathed in natural light or under the glow of ambient lighting.

Crafted from high-quality limestone, these tiles feature a honed finish that lends a smooth, refined surface. Their understated design makes them a versatile choice for both walls and floors, creating a seamless flow throughout your home.

While these tiles are well-suited for indoor use, it is important to note that they require sealing to maintain their appearance and durability. The honed finish provides a tactile surface that is both inviting and practical for everyday living.

Imagine these tiles gracing the floors of your bathroom or the walls of your living room, where their natural tones bring warmth and character to your surroundings. They pair beautifully with a variety of design elements, from modern minimalism to classic elegance.

Please be aware that this product is prone to efflorescence. To mitigate this, store the tiles in a dry area and consider using a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive, for installation.

name: Glendurgan Ceramic Exotic Warm Grey
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the lush flora of Glendurgan Garden in Cornwall, the Glendurgan Ceramic Exotic Warm Grey tiles capture the serene beauty of nature with their muted tones and delicate brush strokes. These tiles offer a subtle nod to the exotic ferns and flowers that thrive in the garden's unique microclimate.

The rectangular format and matt finish of these ceramic tiles create a refined backdrop, allowing the intricate pattern to emerge gracefully. Their understated charm makes them a versatile choice for both modern and traditional interiors, effortlessly bridging different design styles.

Crafted from high-quality ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an excellent option for bathrooms, showers, and wet rooms. The matt surface adds a tactile quality, enhancing the overall sensory experience of the space.

Whether used as a feature wall or to bring a touch of nature indoors, these tiles complement a variety of settings. Their exotic warm grey palette provides a calming influence, making them well-suited to spaces that seek tranquility and elegance.

With no sealing required, these tiles offer a practical yet aesthetically pleasing solution for those looking to infuse their interiors with a hint of natural beauty. A thoughtful choice for any design-conscious homeowner.

name: Maroc Ceramic Powder Blue
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the rich heritage of Moroccan Zellige tiles, Maroc Ceramic Powder Blue brings a touch of artisanal craftsmanship to your interiors. These tiles capture the essence of traditional design with a contemporary twist.

Their powder blue hue is enhanced by a deep, glossy finish that reflects light beautifully, creating a sense of depth and movement. The slightly undulated surface adds to their authentic handmade feel, offering a tactile experience that delights the senses.

Crafted from durable ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an excellent choice for bathroom and kitchen walls, as well as splashbacks and wet room areas. Their gloss finish ensures easy cleaning and maintenance.

Maroc Ceramic Powder Blue tiles lend themselves to a variety of design schemes, whether you're aiming for a traditional look or a more modern aesthetic. Their understated elegance makes them a versatile option for any space.

With their blend of historical inspiration and practical design, these tiles offer a refined choice for those seeking to add a touch of character to their home. Experience the timeless appeal of Moroccan artistry with a product that is both beautiful and functional.

Crafted from durable porcelain, the tiles feature a satin finish that adds a gentle sheen, enhancing their understated charm. The hexagonal shape creates a captivating visual rhythm, perfect for those who appreciate a blend of simplicity and sophistication.

Designed for indoor use, these tiles are well-suited to both wall and floor applications. With an R9 slip rating, they provide a practical choice for areas prone to moisture, such as bathrooms and kitchens.

Whether used as a feature wall or a splashback, the Mono Hex Porcelain Mosaic Blanc tiles offer versatility in styling. Their crisp white hue complements a range of colour palettes, allowing for creative expression in design.

These tiles invite you to explore the possibilities of modern interiors, where form and function coexist seamlessly. A choice that embodies both aesthetic appeal and practical performance.

name: Stucco Porcelain Textured Green
bodyHtml:
Stucco Porcelain Textured Green tiles bring the timeless appeal of plaster-effect walls into your home with a modern twist. These tiles are designed to capture the essence of artisanal plasterwork, offering a rich and inviting texture that adds depth to any space.

Their square format and textured finish create a velvety surface that plays with light, enhancing the warm green tones. This combination makes them a versatile choice for colour-blocking or creating a feature wall that draws the eye.

Crafted from full-bodied porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for both wall and floor applications. With an R10 slip rating, they offer a practical solution for areas prone to moisture, such as bathrooms and kitchens, without compromising on style.

These tiles are perfect for internal use, making them an excellent choice for bathrooms, shower rooms, and kitchens. Their textured surface and warm tones provide a contemporary backdrop that complements a variety of design schemes.

With no sealing required, Stucco Porcelain Textured Green tiles offer a low-maintenance yet stylish option for those looking to introduce a touch of modern elegance to their interiors.

name: Provence Paving Porcelain Talco
bodyHtml:
Provence Paving Porcelain Talco captures the essence of time-worn stone, bringing a sense of enduring charm to outdoor spaces. With a nod to traditional aesthetics, these tiles evoke the warmth and character of aged surfaces.

The textured finish of these porcelain tiles enhances their stone-effect appearance, offering a tactile experience that complements their visual appeal. Their subtle cream hue, Talco, adds a gentle touch of elegance to any setting.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for both internal and external use, making them a versatile choice for a variety of environments. With an R11 slip rating, they provide assured footing, even in wet conditions.

Whether gracing the edge of a swimming pool or forming the foundation of a patio, these tiles integrate seamlessly into outdoor landscapes. Their timeless design is equally suited to contemporary and traditional schemes.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), Provence Paving Porcelain Talco combines practical performance with aesthetic appeal, offering a refined solution for outdoor living spaces.

name: Monza Minérale Pure Matt Click Tile

Crafted with a matt finish, the Monza tiles present a subtle yet engaging surface that enhances the natural beauty of their marble effect. Their rectangular shape and click installation system make them a practical choice for any interior space.

Made from durable materials, these tiles are designed for internal use, providing a reliable flooring solution for bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways. Their R9 slip rating ensures a level of safety without compromising on style.

These tiles are well suited to spaces that embrace a contemporary or classic design, effortlessly complementing a range of interior styles. They bring a touch of elegance to high-traffic areas, marrying form and function seamlessly.

Easy to install and maintain, the Monza Minérale Pure Matt Click Tile is a thoughtful choice for those seeking beauty and practicality in equal measure. A timeless addition to any home.

name: Brompton Porcelain Kew
bodyHtml:
Infuse your space with the timeless elegance of the Brompton Porcelain Kew tiles. Echoing the intricate patterns of the Victorian era, these tiles bring a touch of period charm to both contemporary and traditional settings.

Crafted from durable porcelain with a matt finish, these square tiles feature a classic pattern that adds visual interest and depth to any area. Their design is well-suited for creating feature walls or floors, making an impression in hallways, kitchens, and conservatories alike.

These tiles are versatile, designed for both internal and external use. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet, they offer a practical choice for high-traffic areas such as patios and pathways, ensuring safety without compromising on style.

Whether employed in a bathroom, kitchen, or outdoor room, Brompton Porcelain Kew tiles seamlessly blend functionality with aesthetic appeal. Their traditional design complements a variety of spaces, offering a curated look that feels both considered and inviting.

Please note, these tiles are unrectified, which may result in slight size variations, especially when mixing two colours. This characteristic adds to their unique charm, ensuring each installation is distinct.

name: Hoxton Porcelain Linen Matt
bodyHtml:
A softer expression of natural quartzite, Hoxton Porcelain Linen Matt translates the beauty of the original stone into a porcelain format designed for effortless, everyday living.

A delicate crystalline lattice pattern drifts across the surface, adding gentle movement and a sense of depth. The Linen tone introduces a lighter, airy warmth, creating a calm and quietly uplifting foundation that sits comfortably within both classic and contemporary interiors.

Made for thoughtful layering, these tiles pair seamlessly with the Amber and Four Seasons colourways, where plain and decorative pieces can be combined to build contrast and subtle drama. For a more cohesive material story, they can also be used alongside the natural version of this quartzite, crafted from slab in our bespoke workshop, allowing for a continuous and considered flow throughout a space.

Suitable for interior walls and floors, and with no sealing required, these tiles offer a balance of practicality and refined design, bringing light, texture and an understated elegance to the spaces they shape.

name: Victorian Style™ Porcelain Finchley Pattern Cotton White
bodyHtml:
Echoing the grandeur of the Victorian era, the Victorian Style™ Porcelain Finchley Pattern Cotton White tiles bring a touch of heritage to any space. Their intricate design captures the essence of traditional mosaic floors, offering a timeless appeal in a convenient prescored format.

These tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their classic aesthetic while providing a subtle texture. The Finchley pattern, with its bold yet refined detailing, adds character and depth, making it a captivating choice for both contemporary and period-inspired interiors.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both internal and external applications. With a medium slip risk rating of R10, they are well-suited for areas like kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways, though they should be kept clean to maintain their slip resistance.

Perfect for creating striking feature floors or walls, these tiles can transform kitchens, bathrooms, and even patios into spaces of enduring style. For optimal results, consider pairing them with complementary materials that highlight their intricate design.

Please note, we recommend using our Sarsen Home Porcelain Pre-Grout Barrier to prevent grout stains on the tile surface. These tiles do not require sealing, ensuring a straightforward installation process.

name: Brompton Porcelain Clarence
bodyHtml:
The Brompton Porcelain Clarence tiles capture the essence of Victorian design, offering a touch of period charm to both indoor and outdoor spaces. With their traditional patterned style, they evoke the elegance of a bygone era while remaining relevant in contemporary settings.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their timeless appeal. Their square format and rich red tones make them a striking choice for hallways, kitchens, and conservatories, creating a seamless flow from one space to the next.

Designed for versatility, the Brompton Porcelain Clarence tiles are suitable for both internal and external use, making them ideal for patios and pathways. Their anti-slip properties, rated PTV+36 when wet and R10, ensure safety in high-traffic areas.

Whether used on walls or floors, these tiles offer a thoughtfully curated feature that adds depth and interest to any room. They are particularly well-suited to bathrooms, kitchens, and outdoor rooms, where their Victorian flair can truly shine.

Please note that these tiles are unrectified, which may result in size variations when mixing different colours. This characteristic adds to their authentic charm, creating a unique and characterful installation.

bodyHtml:

Crafted from durable ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them a refined choice for bathroom and kitchen walls. Their Zellige effect style is both timeless and versatile, ensuring they remain a staple in your design palette.

Ideal for splashbacks, shower walls, and wet rooms, Maroc Ceramic Mint tiles introduce a touch of elegance and warmth. Their mint colour brings a refreshing element to traditional and contemporary settings alike.

With no sealing required, these tiles offer a practical yet stylish solution for those seeking to incorporate a touch of Moroccan artistry into their home. Their enduring design ensures they will be cherished for years to come.

name: Trusloe Limestone Seasoned Bullnose Coping
bodyHtml:
Trusloe Limestone Seasoned Bullnose Coping captures the essence of time-worn elegance. This ultra-hard limestone is perfect for those seeking a touch of heritage in both interior and exterior settings.

Each slab is meticulously seasoned to enhance its natural undulations, resulting in a finish reminiscent of a period property. The subtle texture and seasoned finish add a layer of character, making it a refined choice for traditional and rustic designs.

Crafted from durable limestone, these copings are suitable for use in kitchens, hallways, swimming pools, and patios. The material's inherent strength ensures longevity, while the seasoned finish provides a tactile experience underfoot.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), this product is well-suited to both indoor and outdoor applications. Its versatile nature allows it to seamlessly blend into a variety of spaces, enhancing their aesthetic appeal.

While these copings require sealing to maintain their beauty, their enduring appeal and thoughtful design make them a worthy addition to any project. A timeless choice that balances practicality with style.

name: Kimmeridge Limestone Etched Finish
bodyHtml:
The Kimmeridge Limestone Etched Finish brings a modern touch to any interior space with its clean, uniform grey tones. The etching process subtly bleaches the stone, creating a distinctive look that stands apart from other finishes.

These tiles are crafted with a textured surface that provides a good grip, making them particularly suited for wet areas and bustling homes. The etched finish not only enhances the aesthetic appeal but also offers practical benefits.

Made from natural limestone, these tiles are designed for internal use and are well suited to kitchens and hallways. Please note that sealing is required to maintain their appearance and performance over time.

While the Kimmeridge Limestone Etched Finish is a refined choice for various settings, it is important to store these tiles in a dry area to prevent efflorescence. Using a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, like our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive, is recommended.

Embodying both style and function, these tiles offer a sophisticated solution for those seeking a balance of elegance and durability in their flooring.

name: Victorian Style™ Porcelain Finchley Pattern Terracotta
bodyHtml:
Step back in time with the Victorian Style™ Porcelain Finchley Pattern Terracotta tiles, where bold patterns meet the timeless elegance of the Victorian era. These tiles capture the intricate beauty of traditional mosaic designs, offering a contemporary twist with their prescored format for effortless installation.

The Finchley Pattern showcases a rich terracotta hue, brought to life with a matt finish that exudes understated sophistication. Once laid, these tiles evoke a sense of heritage and craftsmanship, making them a standout choice for those seeking to infuse their spaces with character and warmth.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for both indoor and outdoor use, bringing versatility to kitchens, bathrooms, hallways, and even patios. With a slip rating of R10, they offer a medium slip resistance, though they should be kept clean to maintain their anti-slip properties.

Envision these tiles gracing your hallway or kitchen, where their Victorian charm can truly shine. Pair them with neutral tones for a balanced look or contrast with bold colours to create a striking statement.

Please note, to preserve the pristine appearance of these tiles, we recommend using our Sarsen Home Porcelain Pre-Grout Barrier to prevent grout stains. These tiles do not require sealing, ensuring a hassle-free experience.

name: Brit Stone Pennant Porcelain Paving
bodyHtml:
Brit Stone Pennant Porcelain Paving brings a touch of understated elegance to outdoor spaces. With its soft mid-grey tones, this paving evokes a natural, warming ambience that seamlessly integrates with the surrounding environment.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these paving stones feature a textured finish that beautifully mimics the look of traditional stone. Their rectangular shape adds a sense of order and sophistication, making them a versatile choice for various design schemes.

Designed for external use, Brit Stone Pennant is well-suited for patios and swimming pool areas. Its R11 slip rating ensures a safe and secure surface, even in wet conditions, providing peace of mind for outdoor gatherings.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), these paving stones are a testament to quality and style. They require no sealing, offering a low-maintenance solution for those who appreciate both beauty and practicality.

Whether you're creating a serene garden retreat or a lively entertainment area, Brit Stone Pennant Porcelain Paving offers a refined foundation that complements a range of outdoor settings.

These mosaics feature a lightly aged-effect porcelain that creates a soft, inviting finish. The basketweave pattern adds visual interest, making them a striking choice for both contemporary and traditional interiors.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, offering a matt finish that enhances their marble effect. With an R10 slip rating, they provide a practical solution for areas where safety is a priority.

Well suited to bathrooms, kitchens, and feature walls, these tiles offer versatility in design. Their subtle Oro colour complements a range of palettes, allowing for creative expression in any room.

A refined choice for those seeking a balance of style and functionality, the East Village Basketweave Mosaic Oro tiles are a testament to thoughtful design and enduring appeal.

name: Sardinia Porcelain Masseria
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the charming designs of historic Italian hotels, restaurants, and palaces, Sardinia Porcelain Masseria tiles pay homage to the renowned 'Maiolica' style. These tiles beautifully capture the essence of finely handpainted art, showcasing vibrant Mediterranean tones that evoke a sense of timeless elegance.

The square format and satin finish of these tiles create a harmonious blend of traditional and rustic aesthetics. Their intricate patterning and multi-coloured palette bring depth and character to any space, reminiscent of the artistic craftsmanship found in Italy's most treasured locales.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for internal use, gracing both walls and floors in bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and kitchens. With an R10 slip rating, they offer a practical choice for areas where safety is paramount.

Envision these tiles as a striking feature in your home, where their rich design can complement a variety of interior styles. Pair them with darker grouts, such as pearl grey, to enhance their intricate details and maintain their visual impact.

Please note, due to the nature of these tiles, a light grout colour is not recommended. A darker grout will better preserve the integrity and aesthetic appeal of the design.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are intended for internal use, making them a practical choice for spaces that require easy maintenance and durability. Their smooth surface is both elegant and functional, ideal for areas prone to splashes and spills.

Whether you're looking to complement a modern aesthetic or add a touch of tradition, Shoreline Ceramic Shallow Water tiles offer versatility. Their classic blue hue pairs effortlessly with a range of colour schemes, enhancing both contemporary and traditional interiors.

Embrace the timeless appeal of these tiles, where design meets practicality. Perfectly suited for creating serene, stylish spaces, they invite the calming influence of the coast into your home.

Whether you're looking to create a statement feature wall or a subtle splashback, the Petite Porcelain Gloss White tiles offer versatility and style. Their brick shape lends itself to a variety of layouts, from classic to contemporary.

With no sealing required, these tiles combine practicality with aesthetic appeal, ensuring a low-maintenance yet visually captivating addition to your interior design.

name: Hoxton Porcelain Four Seasons Brushed
bodyHtml:
A quiet nod to nature, reimagined for modern living. Hoxton Porcelain Four Seasons takes the beauty of natural quartzite and refines it into a more versatile porcelain format, offering all the character with added ease.

Across the surface, a light crystalline lattice pattern unfolds, bringing gentle movement and texture. Warm, creamy tones sit at its heart, timeless and inviting, creating a foundation that feels both considered and effortlessly liveable.

Designed to be layered and explored, these tiles pair beautifully with the Linen and Amber colourways, where pattern and tone come together to create moments of contrast and quiet drama. For a more cohesive story, they can also be combined with the natural version of this material, crafted from slab in our bespoke workshop, allowing spaces to flow with a sense of continuity and depth.

Suitable for use on floors, except in wet areas, these tiles offer a considered balance of practicality and design, bringing a softly expressive finish to interiors that value both detail and durability.

name: Pavilion Porcelain Marine Blue
bodyHtml:
Pavilion Porcelain Marine Blue tiles capture the essence of Victorian-era seaside holidays, recalling the drama of crashing waves and the nostalgia of coastal piers. Their bold, natural tones invite memories of towering cliffs and playful seaside scenes.

These tiles feature a cleverly pre-scored surface, creating a mosaic-like pattern of triangles and squares. This intricate design pays homage to the iconic floors of the Victorian age, offering a modern twist on a time-honoured style.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, gracing both walls and floors with ease. Their textured finish not only enhances their visual appeal but also provides a PTV+36 slip rating when wet, ensuring practicality alongside beauty.

Well suited to bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways, these tiles bring a touch of heritage to contemporary and traditional spaces alike. Their marine blue hue adds depth and character, making them a versatile choice for various design schemes.

With their blend of historical inspiration and modern functionality, Pavilion Porcelain Marine Blue tiles offer a refined choice for those seeking to infuse their interiors with a subtle nod to the past.

name: Menara White Arches Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the serene beauty of the ancient Menara Gardens in Marrakesh, the Menara White Arches Porcelain tiles evoke the spirit of Moroccan artistry. These tiles bring a sense of timeless elegance to any space, capturing the essence of traditional design with a modern twist.

The intricate pattern of classic stars and arches offers endless possibilities for creative arrangements. name: Kimmeridge Limestone Honed Finish
bodyHtml:
With a nod to the rugged beauty of Dorset's Isle of Purbeck, Kimmeridge Limestone Honed Finish tiles present a palette of deep grey and charcoal tones. Their surface, rich with natural fossils, evokes a sense of timelessness and strength.

The honed finish of these tiles enhances their tactile appeal, offering a smooth yet characterful surface that captures the eye. Once laid, they create a seamless expanse of understated elegance, perfect for both modern and traditional interiors.

Crafted from durable limestone, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited to areas like kitchens and hallways. It is important to note that they are prone to efflorescence; storing them in a dry area and using a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive, is recommended.

These tiles invite a sense of refined sophistication into any space, effortlessly complementing a variety of design schemes. Their natural tones and textures provide a versatile backdrop, whether paired with contemporary furnishings or classic decor.

In summary, Kimmeridge Limestone Honed Finish tiles offer a harmonious blend of design and practicality, bringing the enduring beauty of natural stone into your home with quiet confidence.

name: Fire-retardant Membrane
bodyHtml:
The Fire-retardant Membrane is a premium solution designed to safeguard your flooring during the crucial post-grouting phase. This loose-lay sheeting provides a practical layer of protection, allowing the floor to breathe as the tiling cures and dries.

Engineered for internal use, this membrane ensures that your newly tiled surfaces remain in optimal condition while they settle. Its breathable nature is key to maintaining the integrity of the grout, preventing any potential issues that can arise from trapped moisture.

Crafted with a focus on functionality, the Fire-retardant Membrane is a reliable choice for those seeking to protect their investment in quality tiling. Its thoughtful design facilitates an effective curing process, enhancing the longevity of your flooring.

Whether applied in residential or commercial settings, this membrane offers peace of mind, knowing that your floors are shielded from potential damage during the drying period. Its ease of use makes it a practical addition to any tiling project.

In summary, the Fire-retardant Membrane combines practicality with performance, ensuring that your flooring is well-protected and allowed to cure properly, resulting in a durable and lasting finish.

Whether enhancing a modern bathroom or adding a touch of tradition to a shower space, these tiles offer versatility in style. Their subtle green tones pair effortlessly with natural materials and soft neutrals, creating a harmonious environment.

Seaton Ceramic Rock Pool tiles embody a thoughtful blend of design and practicality, offering a timeless option for those seeking to infuse their spaces with a touch of coastal elegance.

name: Butler Porcelain Calacatta
bodyHtml:
Butler Porcelain Calacatta tiles bring a timeless elegance to any space, drawing on the classic appeal of monochrome floors. These tiles feature a striking marble graphic that captures the eye, making them a refined choice for both modern and traditional interiors.

Crafted from porcelain, the tiles showcase a crisp white Calacatta design alongside the opulent dark Marquina, offering a sophisticated contrast. The matt finish enhances their understated charm, while the square shape adds a structured aesthetic.

Designed for internal use, they are well suited to kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet, they provide a practical solution for areas prone to moisture, ensuring both style and safety.

To achieve the classic chequerboard effect, a 3mm grout joint is recommended due to the non-rectified edges of these tiles. This detail not only ensures a seamless installation but also highlights the intricate marble effect.

Whether used across an entire floor or as a feature area, Butler Porcelain Calacatta tiles offer a blend of design and functionality, creating spaces that feel both curated and inviting.

name: Maroc Ceramic Sage
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the time-honoured tradition of Moroccan Zellige tiles, Maroc Ceramic Sage brings a touch of artisanal elegance to any space. These tiles capture the essence of handcrafted beauty with their subtle tonal variations and deep, glossy pastel hues.

The slightly undulated surface of Maroc Ceramic Sage creates a dynamic play of light and shadow, enhancing its handmade appeal. The sage colour adds a serene and calming presence, making these tiles a refined choice for those seeking understated sophistication.

Crafted from durable ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, with a glossy finish that enhances their visual depth. They are well-suited for walls in bathrooms, kitchens, splashbacks, and shower or wet room settings.

Maroc Ceramic Sage tiles invite creative expression, effortlessly complementing both traditional and contemporary interiors. Their Zellige effect and square shape make them a versatile option for a variety of design schemes.

With no sealing required, these tiles offer a practical yet stylish solution for those looking to introduce a touch of Moroccan-inspired charm to their home. Their enduring appeal ensures they remain a timeless addition to any interior.

name: Wiltshire Hares Ceramic By Joanna May
bodyHtml:
Crafted with a touch of whimsy, the Wiltshire Hares Ceramic collection by Joanna May brings the charm of the countryside into your home. Each tile showcases one of eight delightful hare miniatures, capturing their playful spirit in various poses.

Hand-fired in our kiln, these tiles exude a traditional farmhouse aesthetic, enriched by a satin finish that adds a gentle sheen. The intricate designs evoke the serene beauty of rolling hills and grasslands, creating a natural connection to the hares' habitat.

Made from durable ceramic, these tiles are well-suited for internal use, making them an excellent choice for splashbacks and feature walls. The satin finish enhances their tactile appeal while ensuring easy maintenance.

For a cohesive look, consider pairing them with the Nuance field tile, allowing the hare designs to stand out as a focal point. Their versatility allows them to complement a range of interior styles, from rustic to contemporary.

Please note, these tiles are made to order in our studio, which may result in longer lead times. However, the wait ensures a bespoke touch that adds character and warmth to any space.

name: Lily Pad Porcelain Bubblegum
bodyHtml:
With a nod to modern design, the Lily Pad Porcelain Bubblegum tiles bring a playful yet sophisticated touch to any space. Their hexagonal shape and vibrant pink hue evoke a sense of fun and creativity, making them a standout choice for those looking to add a splash of colour.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their contemporary appeal. The hexagon pattern creates a dynamic visual effect, whether used on walls or floors, adding interest and depth to your interiors.

Designed for both indoor and outdoor use, these tiles are as practical as they are stylish. They boast a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet, providing peace of mind in wet areas like bathrooms and patios. Their machine-made quality ensures minimal maintenance, allowing you to enjoy their beauty without the fuss.

Perfectly suited for a variety of spaces, from kitchens and bathrooms to feature walls and splashbacks, these tiles offer versatility and charm. Their bold colour and pattern make them an excellent choice for creating a statement look.

Combining design-led aesthetics with practical functionality, the Lily Pad Porcelain Bubblegum tiles are a refined addition to any home. Their enduring appeal ensures they will remain a cherished feature for years to come.

name: Victorian Style™ Porcelain Chess Mono B
bodyHtml:
Evoking the charm of the Victorian era, the Victorian Style™ Porcelain Chess Mono B captures the essence of historical mosaic floors with a modern twist. These tiles offer a bold, patterned aesthetic that brings a sense of heritage to any space.

Crafted in a square format with a matt finish, they present a striking monochrome design. The pre-scored surface allows for a seamless installation, creating the illusion of intricate mosaic work without the complexity.

Made from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, offering versatility across a range of environments. With an R10 slip rating, they provide a medium slip resistance, making them a practical choice for various settings, though they should be kept clean to maintain this property.

Perfectly suited to bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios, these tiles can transform a space with their timeless appeal. To achieve the classic chequerboard effect, pair them with the Monochrome A variant.

While sealing is not required, we recommend using our Sarsen Home Porcelain Pre-Grout Barrier to prevent grout stains, ensuring the tiles maintain their pristine appearance.

Crafted with care, these pavers exhibit a brick-like shape that complements both contemporary and classic landscapes. The tumbled finish adds a tactile quality, enhancing their visual appeal and making them a characterful choice for any project.

These clay pavers are suitable for both internal and external use, making them a versatile option for various environments. Their durable nature ensures they withstand the elements, providing a reliable surface for patios and even swimming pool areas.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), these pavers are a testament to quality and design integrity. Their natural buff colour harmonises beautifully with outdoor greenery and indoor decor alike.

Flanders Buff Tumbled Clay Pavers offer a refined balance between aesthetic charm and practical functionality, making them a thoughtful addition to your design palette.

name: Aventuras Palma Olive Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Designed by the talented Zoe Glencross, the Aventuras Palma Olive Porcelain tiles are a vibrant celebration of pattern and colour. Drawing inspiration from traditional Portuguese tiles, these tiles offer a rich tapestry of intricate motifs that invite creativity and personal expression.

The matt finish of these square tiles enhances their tactile appeal, while the olive hue adds a subtle warmth to any setting. Whether used as a striking feature or a harmonious backdrop, they effortlessly adapt to both modern and traditional interiors.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both internal and external applications. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet, they offer practical peace of mind in bathrooms, kitchens, and even patios.

Imagine these tiles gracing a hallway or a shower room, where their intricate patterns can truly shine. The Aventuras collection encourages playful pattern layering, allowing for endless design possibilities.

With the Aventuras Palma Olive Porcelain tiles, you can create spaces that are as expressive as they are functional, all while enjoying the timeless charm of Portuguese-inspired design.

name: Victorian Style™ Porcelain Chess Mono A
bodyHtml:
Echoing the grandeur of the Victorian era, the Victorian Style™ Porcelain Chess Mono A tiles bring a touch of timeless elegance to any space. Their bold patterns capture the intricate charm of traditional mosaic floors.

Crafted in a prescored porcelain format, these tiles offer a matt finish that enhances their classic appeal while simplifying installation. The design is both striking and sophisticated, making it a refined choice for those seeking a heritage aesthetic.

With an R10 slip rating, these tiles are suitable for both internal and external use, though they should be kept clean to maintain slip resistance. They are not recommended for pool surrounds due to their medium slip risk.

Ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and patios, these tiles create a stunning chequerboard effect when paired with Monochrome B. This pairing is essential to achieve the full visual impact.

We recommend using our Sarsen Home Porcelain Pre-Grout Barrier to prevent grout stains, ensuring the tiles maintain their pristine appearance. No sealing is required, allowing for straightforward maintenance.

name: Lyndhurst Minérale Herringbone Click Tile
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the serene beauty of limewashed oak, the Lyndhurst Minérale Herringbone Click Tile brings a touch of Scandinavian charm to your interiors. Its pale beige tones, accented by dark knots and markings, create a natural, rustic contrast that evokes the warmth of organic wood.

The Lyndhurst Minérale Herringbone Click Tile seamlessly combines aesthetic appeal with easy maintenance, making it a refined addition to your home.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles feature a glossy finish that enhances their deep navy hue, creating a striking visual effect. The brick shape lends itself to creative layouts, offering endless possibilities for design expression.

Designed for indoor use, these tiles are well suited to both wall and floor applications. Their porcelain construction ensures longevity and resilience, making them a practical choice for high-traffic areas like kitchens and bathrooms.

Whether you're updating a splashback or designing a shower room, Foundry Novo Porcelain Navy tiles provide a rich backdrop that pairs beautifully with a range of materials and finishes. Their understated elegance complements a variety of interior styles.

With their combination of historical inspiration and modern performance, these tiles offer a refined solution for creating spaces that are both functional and visually captivating.

name: Cote Bourgogne Limestone Seasoned Finish
bodyHtml:
Sourced from a small, independent quarry in France, the Cote Bourgogne Limestone Seasoned Finish embodies a timeless charm with its antique-effect surface. This limestone reflects the traditional savoir-faire of its origins, offering a warm palette of beige and light grey tones.

The seasoned finish of these flagstones evokes a sense of history, making them an ideal choice for larger areas where their natural variation can truly shine. Their tactile quality and subtle colour shifts create a harmonious flow across spaces, enhancing the architectural character of any room.

Crafted from durable limestone, these tiles are well-suited for internal applications, particularly in kitchens and hallways. Their inherent strength and seasoned finish provide a practical yet elegant flooring solution.

These tiles invite a sense of warmth and rustic elegance into your home, seamlessly blending with both traditional and rustic interiors. Their understated presence allows them to complement a variety of design styles, adding depth and interest to your floors.

With a focus on quality and craftsmanship, the Cote Bourgogne Limestone Seasoned Finish is a refined choice for those seeking a balance between aesthetic appeal and practical functionality. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their beauty over time.

name: Osterley Porcelain White Brick
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the storied floors of Osterley Park, these Osterley Porcelain White Brick tiles capture the essence of aged limestone with a modern twist. Their textured, stone-effect finish echoes the timeless appeal of historic interiors.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles offer a practical solution for busy spaces. Their brick shape and subtle white tones provide a versatile canvas, allowing for creative installations that suit both traditional and contemporary settings.

Designed for both indoor and outdoor use, these tiles boast an R11 slip rating, ensuring safety in wet conditions. They are well-suited for areas like bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios, seamlessly connecting different parts of your home.

While these tiles are unrectified, lending them a more authentic look, it is important to note that size variations may occur, especially when mixing two colours. This characteristic adds to their charm, creating a unique and varied surface.

With no need for sealing, these tiles offer a low-maintenance option that retains their beauty over time. Their enduring design and practical benefits make them a thoughtful choice for any space.

Crafted from high-quality marble, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for both walls and floors in bathrooms, showers, and wet rooms. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their pristine condition and enhance durability.

Whether used to create a serene bathroom retreat or a stylish shower area, Domus Marble tiles offer a versatile foundation for contemporary design schemes. Their understated elegance makes them a timeless choice for those who appreciate subtle sophistication.

With their blend of aesthetic appeal and practical functionality, these tiles are a thoughtful addition to any modern interior, promising to enrich the space with their quiet charm and enduring quality.

With their square format and matt finish, these tiles present a modern take on classic patterns, creating visual interest and depth. The Algarve colour palette brings a refreshing burst of blue, reminiscent of clear skies and tranquil waters.

Whether adorning a bathroom wall or enhancing a patio floor, Cabana Porcelain Algarve tiles add character and charm. Their eclectic style complements both contemporary and traditional settings, allowing for creative expression in any project.

These tiles embody a balance of design and practicality, offering a refined solution for those seeking to infuse their spaces with colour and personality. Their enduring appeal ensures they remain a cherished feature in any setting.

Designed for internal use, these square tiles are well suited for walls in bathrooms, showers, and wet rooms, as well as splashbacks. Their durable ceramic construction ensures long-lasting performance, making them a practical choice for everyday living.

Whether used to create a full wall feature or as an elegant splashback, these tiles offer versatility in styling. Pair them with complementary mouldings or decorative borders to complete the Victorian look, or let them stand alone for a more understated effect.

Victorian Style™ Wall Ceramic Cotton White Square tiles embody a blend of tradition and modernity, providing a refined and enduring option for those who appreciate classic design with a contemporary twist.

name: Maroc Ceramic Wool
bodyHtml:

The slightly undulated surface of these tiles enhances their authentic handmade feel, creating a unique play of light and shadow. Their square shape and gloss finish make them a refined choice for those seeking to introduce a traditional yet timeless element to their spaces.

Crafted from durable ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for areas such as bathrooms, kitchens, and splashbacks. Their versatility is matched by practicality, as they require no sealing, ensuring ease of maintenance.

Imagine these tiles gracing the walls of a shower or wet room, where their glossy finish can reflect light beautifully, adding depth and interest. They harmonise effortlessly with both contemporary and traditional design schemes, offering endless styling possibilities.

Maroc Ceramic Wool tiles are a testament to thoughtful design, balancing aesthetic appeal with functional performance. Their enduring allure is sure to complement a variety of interiors with grace and subtlety.

name: Fez Porcelain Star White
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the intricate artistry of Moroccan design, Fez Porcelain Star White tiles bring a touch of traditional elegance to contemporary spaces. Their star-and-cross pattern creates a captivating visual effect that feels both timeless and fresh.

Crafted in a modern porcelain format, these tiles replicate the handmade look, offering a glossy finish that enhances their intricate design. The combination of star and cross shapes forms a unique pattern that draws the eye and adds a layer of sophistication to any room.

Made from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for areas like bathrooms, showers, and feature walls. Their glossy finish not only adds a touch of refinement but also ensures easy maintenance, making them a practical choice for busy spaces.

To achieve the full pattern effect, both the Star and Cross shapes must be ordered together. With 22.94 stars and 22.94 crosses required per square metre, these tiles offer a seamless blend of style and function.

Fez Porcelain Star White tiles are an exquisite choice for those looking to infuse their interiors with a sense of heritage and modern flair, all without the need for sealing.

name: Lake Garda Minérale Pure Gloss Click Tile
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the serene blue waters of Lake Garda, these tiles capture the essence of a tranquil lakeside vista. The crystalline-blue marble effect is reminiscent of a masterful painting, bringing a touch of artistry to any space.

The Pure Gloss finish enhances the tiles with a glistening sheen, creating a surface that reflects light and adds depth to the design. This finish not only highlights the marble effect but also contributes to a sophisticated, modern aesthetic.

Crafted as click tiles, they offer ease of installation while ensuring a seamless look. With an R9 slip rating, these tiles are suitable for internal use, providing a safe and stylish option for floors in bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways.

These tiles are well-suited to spaces that embrace modern design, yet their marble effect can also complement more traditional interiors. The versatility of their design allows them to blend seamlessly into various settings, adding character and elegance.

With no sealing required, these tiles offer both beauty and practicality, making them a refined choice for those seeking to bring a touch of Lake Garda's beauty into their home.

name: Portland Classic Limestone Honed Finish
bodyHtml:
The Portland Classic Limestone Honed Finish tiles bring a refined elegance to any modern home. Their smooth surface creates a clean, sharp look that enhances kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas with understated sophistication.

Crafted from limestone, these tiles are designed with a honed finish that highlights their natural beauty. The pink hue adds a subtle warmth, making them a versatile choice for a variety of interior styles.

These tiles are intended for internal use and require sealing to maintain their pristine condition. Be mindful of the potential for efflorescence; storing them in a dry area and using a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive, can help mitigate this.

Perfectly suited to traditional settings, the Portland Classic Limestone tiles can be paired with a range of design elements to create a cohesive and inviting space. Their timeless appeal ensures they remain a stylish choice for years to come.

With their balance of aesthetic appeal and practicality, these tiles offer a thoughtful choice for those seeking to enhance their interiors with a touch of elegance.

Crafted in a distinctive hexagon shape, these tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their modern, understated elegance. Their patterned design brings a subtle yet engaging visual texture to any surface.

With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, these tiles provide added safety in areas prone to moisture, such as bathrooms and wet rooms. Their robust construction means they can handle the demands of both wall and floor installations.

Whether used as a feature wall or a splashback, the Lily Pad Porcelain Eucalyptus tiles offer a refined way to introduce colour and pattern into your design scheme. Their timeless appeal ensures they remain a cherished part of your space for years to come.

Whether used in a chequerboard pattern or as a plain backdrop, these tiles bring a sense of warmth and tradition to shower and wet room walls. Their versatility allows them to complement both contemporary and traditional design schemes.

Maroc Ceramic Tomato tiles effortlessly blend design and functionality, offering a refined choice for those seeking to introduce an artisanal effect into their home. Their enduring appeal ensures they remain a timeless addition to any interior.

With their timeless appeal and understated elegance, these tiles effortlessly blend design with function, offering a sophisticated solution for those seeking to infuse their spaces with a touch of Moroccan artistry.

name: Victorian Style™ Wall Ceramic Olive Green Square Crackle Glaze
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless elegance of traditional Victorian bathrooms, the Victorian Style™ Wall Ceramic Olive Green tiles capture the essence of a bygone era. Their rich olive green hue brings a sense of heritage and depth to any space, echoing the classic tones that have been cherished for generations.

The square format of these tiles, combined with a distinctive crackle glaze finish, creates a surface that is both visually intriguing and tactile. This crackle effect adds a layer of character, evoking the charm of handcrafted ceramics and the subtle imperfections that make each tile unique.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed exclusively for interior walls, making them an excellent choice for bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks. Their suitability for wet areas is enhanced by the crackle glaze, although care should be taken as they may discolour over time if not properly sealed.

For those looking to recreate the layered detailing of Victorian interiors, these tiles offer a refined solution. They pair beautifully with decorative mouldings and borders, allowing for a cohesive and elegant design scheme that honours tradition while embracing contemporary sensibilities.

Please note, these tiles require sealing with a Crackle Glaze Protector to maintain their appearance and prevent discolouration in wet areas. This thoughtful detail ensures that their beauty endures, providing a lasting tribute to Victorian style.

bodyHtml:

Crafted in a satin porcelain finish, they replicate the look of marble mosaics with a wonderfully tactile 3D effect. The design cleverly mimics the appearance of grout joints between individual mosaic pieces, adding depth and interest to any surface.

Made from durable porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for indoor use across a variety of spaces. With an R10 slip rating, they offer a practical choice for areas that require both style and safety.

Whether adorning the walls and floors of a bathroom, kitchen, or hallway, these tiles bring a refined character to your interiors. Their versatile pattern complements both contemporary and traditional settings.

Byzantine Porcelain Lauro Sculpted tiles embody a balance of design and functionality, offering a timeless appeal that enhances the beauty of your home.

name: Victorian Style™ Porcelain Finchley Pattern Sandstone
bodyHtml:
Capturing the essence of Victorian elegance, the Victorian Style™ Porcelain Finchley Pattern Sandstone tiles bring a touch of historic charm to modern interiors. Their boldly-toned patterns echo the intricate mosaics of the past, offering a timeless aesthetic.

These tiles feature a prescored design, allowing for the intricate look of traditional mosaic floors without the complexity of installation. The matt finish adds a refined touch, enhancing the subtle sandstone hues.

Crafted from durable porcelain, they are suitable for both internal and external applications, including bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios. With an R10 slip rating, these tiles provide a medium level of slip resistance, making them versatile for various settings. However, they are not recommended for pool surrounds and should be kept clean to maintain their slip-resistant properties.

To preserve their pristine appearance, we recommend using our Sarsen Home Porcelain Pre-Grout Barrier to prevent grout stains on the tile surface. This ensures the tiles retain their authentic look over time.

Embrace the enduring appeal of Victorian design with these characterful tiles, offering both style and practicality for a range of spaces.

name: Stucco Porcelain Textured Red
bodyHtml:
Stucco Porcelain Textured Red tiles capture the enduring appeal of plaster-effect walls, bringing a touch of warmth and character to any interior space. Their rich red hue and textured surface evoke a sense of artisanal craftsmanship, making them a distinctive choice for those seeking a unique design statement.

Crafted from full-bodied porcelain, these tiles offer a velvety texture that enhances their visual depth. The square format allows for versatile installation patterns, whether you’re aiming for a seamless look or a bold chequerboard effect. Their warm tones provide a perfect backdrop for colour-blocking, adding a dynamic element to your design.

Designed for internal use, these tiles are well-suited for both wall and floor applications. With an R10 slip rating, they offer a practical choice for areas where safety is a consideration, such as bathrooms and kitchens. The textured finish not only adds aesthetic interest but also contributes to their slip-resistant properties.

Imagine these tiles gracing a feature wall, splashback, or even a wet room, where their tactile surface can be fully appreciated. Their versatility makes them an excellent option for creating cohesive and inviting spaces, whether in a contemporary setting or a more traditional scheme.

Stucco Porcelain Textured Red tiles combine thoughtful design with practical functionality, offering a refined solution for those looking to infuse their interiors with warmth and texture. Their enduring style ensures they remain a timeless addition to any home.

name: Fez Porcelain Cross Cotto
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the intricate artistry of Moroccan design, the Fez Porcelain Cross Cotto tiles bring a touch of the exotic to modern interiors. These tiles capture the essence of traditional craftsmanship in a contemporary porcelain format, offering a unique star-and-cross pattern that captivates the eye.

With a matt finish that echoes the look of handmade tiles, these tiles exude a sense of depth and authenticity. The interplay of shapes creates a dynamic visual effect, transforming floors into a canvas of geometric elegance.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for internal use, including bathrooms, showers, and wet rooms. The R10 slip rating ensures a practical choice for areas where safety is paramount, without compromising on style.

To achieve the full pattern, both the Star and the Cross shapes must be ordered together. Each square metre requires 22.94 Stars and 22.94 Crosses, ensuring a seamless and cohesive design.

Fez Porcelain Cross Cotto tiles offer a harmonious blend of tradition and modernity, making them a refined choice for those seeking to infuse their spaces with character and charm.

name: Byzantine Porcelain Seraph Sculpted
bodyHtml:
Byzantine Porcelain Seraph Sculpted tiles bring the ancient art of mosaic into contemporary spaces with ease. Inspired by the intricate designs of Greek mosaics, these tiles feature a harmonious blend of geometric, floral, and modern patterns.

Their satin finish and sculpted 3D surface create a tactile experience, mimicking the appearance of traditional grout joints between individual pieces. This thoughtful design detail adds depth and character to any room.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are suited for internal use, offering a practical yet stylish solution for both walls and floors. Their accessible format makes them an ideal choice for bathrooms, kitchens, and feature walls.

Whether used in a shower room or hallway, the subtle blue and white tones of the Seraph Sculpted tiles provide a refined backdrop that complements a variety of interior styles. Their understated elegance is designed to endure.

With no need for sealing, these tiles offer a low-maintenance option that combines aesthetic appeal with everyday practicality. A sophisticated addition to any design scheme.

name: Seaton Ceramic Sky
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the serene beauty of Devon's coastal town, Seaton Ceramic Sky tiles bring a touch of the seaside to your interiors. Their soft blue hue evokes the endless sky, offering a calming presence to any room.

These tiles feature a distinctive crackle glaze finish, adding a layer of texture and depth that catches the light beautifully. The subtle variations in the glaze create a unique, dappled effect reminiscent of gentle ocean waves.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them a refined choice for walls in bathrooms, shower rooms, and splashbacks. Their material ensures durability while maintaining an elegant appearance.

Perfectly suited to both modern and traditional settings, Seaton Ceramic Sky tiles seamlessly integrate into a variety of design schemes. Their understated charm complements a wide range of colour palettes and decor styles.

Please note, due to the crackle glaze finish, these tiles require sealing to maintain their beauty and longevity. This practical consideration ensures they remain a cherished feature in your home for years to come.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed to withstand the demands of everyday life while maintaining their refined appearance. They are suitable for both wall and floor installations, providing a cohesive look across different areas.

Whether adorning a minimalist kitchen or enhancing an outdoor patio, the Islington Porcelain White Textured tiles offer a sophisticated backdrop. Their understated elegance complements a variety of styles, from modern to more traditional settings.

As these are porcelain tiles, they do not require sealing, ensuring their longevity and preserving their beauty over time. With their blend of practicality and style, they are a considered choice for those seeking both form and function.

The hexagonal shape and random patterns within each pack create a dynamic layout that feels both structured and organic. The grey tones lend a subtle elegance, allowing the tiles to adapt seamlessly to various design schemes.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for both indoor and outdoor use, making them a versatile choice for bathrooms, kitchens, and patios. The matt finish enhances their understated charm, while the slip rating of PTV+36 when wet ensures safety underfoot.

Whether adorning a shower wall or a garden pathway, these tiles bring a sense of refined character to any setting. Their ability to complement both traditional and modern aesthetics makes them a thoughtful addition to your design palette.

Please note that due to production limitations, not all designs may be included within every order, adding an element of surprise to your installation.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for internal use, gracing both walls and floors with their presence. The R10 slip rating ensures a practical choice for areas where safety is paramount, such as bathrooms and kitchens.

Imagine these tiles adorning a kitchen splashback or creating a statement floor in a shower room. Their traditional yet rustic appeal allows them to blend seamlessly into a variety of interior styles, offering a touch of Italian charm.

With Sardinia Porcelain Gioia, you invite a piece of Italy into your home, where design meets functionality in perfect harmony.

Crafted with an exceptionally fine grain, these cobbles are designed to withstand the elements, making them a durable choice for external use. Their refined texture and subtle colour variation create a harmonious backdrop for both modern and traditional settings.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), this paving product is a testament to quality and craftsmanship. The cobbles are particularly well-suited for patios and swimming pool surrounds, offering both aesthetic appeal and practical performance.

These sandstone cobbles require sealing to maintain their appearance and durability over time. Their tactile surface and natural hues make them a versatile option for various outdoor applications, seamlessly blending with the surrounding landscape.

With their understated elegance and robust nature, the Trafalgar Sandstone Tumbled Cobbles provide a thoughtful choice for those seeking to enhance their outdoor environments with enduring style.

name: Rialto Terrazzo Foscari Honed
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the storied architecture of Venice, Rialto Terrazzo Foscari Honed tiles celebrate the timeless allure of terrazzo. These tiles, crafted from recycled and waste marble materials, offer a sustainable choice that echoes the vibrant history of their Italian origins.

The honed finish of these tiles reveals a subtle sheen that enhances their intricate pattern. With a palette that resonates with the natural beauty of marble, they bring a refined elegance to any space.

Made from authentic terrazzo, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an ideal choice for kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways. Please note, due to their technical characteristics, an S2 adhesive is recommended for installation, as our Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive is unsuitable.

Whether used on walls or floors, the Foscari tiles create a harmonious backdrop that complements both modern and traditional interiors. Their understated pattern and honed finish make them a versatile addition to any design scheme.

Rialto Terrazzo Foscari Honed tiles offer a perfect blend of sustainability and style, embodying the enduring charm of Venetian terrazzo with a contemporary twist.

These flagstones are crafted from durable limestone, offering a virtually indestructible surface. The natural riven face is subtly smoothed, resulting in a rugged texture that enhances grip, making it ideal for organic and characterful paving.

Designed for external use, Trusloe Limestone Paving is well-suited to areas such as patios and swimming pool surrounds. Its robust nature ensures longevity, even in high-traffic outdoor spaces.

The traditional and rustic style of these stones lends itself beautifully to both contemporary and classic landscapes. Their understated elegance allows for seamless integration into various design schemes.

While the stone's inherent toughness is a highlight, it is important to note that sealing is required to maintain its appearance and performance over time. This thoughtful consideration ensures that the paving remains a timeless feature in your outdoor environment.

bodyHtml:

Crafted from full-bodied porcelain, these tiles feature a textured finish that mimics the velvety nature of plaster. This tactile quality not only enhances their visual depth but also adds a layer of interest to any room.

With no sealing required, Stucco Porcelain Textured Blue tiles offer a blend of aesthetic appeal and practical performance, making them a thoughtful addition to any interior project.

bodyHtml:

These tiles feature a distinctive chequerboard pattern that pairs beautifully with coordinating border and corner pieces. The matt finish adds a subtle elegance, allowing the bold design to stand out without overwhelming a space.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both internal and external applications. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they offer practical performance alongside their aesthetic appeal.

Perfect for bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and even patios, the Aventuras collection encourages creativity in design. Whether you choose to layer patterns or opt for a more restrained approach, the possibilities are endless.

With a focus on both style and functionality, the Aventuras Ziggy Border Terracotta Porcelain tiles provide a refined yet playful touch to any project, embodying the spirit of artistic expression and thoughtful design.

name: Fez Porcelain Cross White
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the intricate artistry of Moroccan design, the Fez Porcelain Cross White tiles bring a touch of the exotic to contemporary interiors. Their star-and-cross pattern is both striking and memorable, making them an ideal choice for those looking to make a statement.

Crafted in a modern porcelain format, these tiles mimic the charm of handmade creations with their gloss finish, offering a subtle sheen that enhances their visual appeal. The interplay of shapes creates a dynamic pattern that draws the eye and adds depth to any space.

Made from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for bathrooms, showers, and feature walls. Their construction ensures they are both practical and beautiful, offering a seamless blend of form and function.

When considering installation, note that the complete pattern requires both the Star and Cross shapes. This thoughtful design consideration allows for a cohesive and captivating layout, transforming floors and walls alike.

Please be aware that 22.94 Stars and 22.94 Crosses are needed per square metre to achieve the full pattern. These tiles do not require sealing, ensuring ease of maintenance while maintaining their elegant appearance.
