Whether adorning walls or floors, the Sculpture Grande Porcelain Ceppo tiles lend themselves to a variety of settings, effortlessly complementing both contemporary and classic interiors. Their understated elegance makes them a versatile addition to your home.

With their combination of visual interest and practical suitability, these tiles offer a harmonious balance of design and functionality, elevating any space with their timeless appeal.

name: Tunstall Ceramic Square Deep White
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the Victorian era, Tunstall Ceramic Square Deep White tiles capture the essence of classic British ceramics with their rich puddle glaze effect. These tiles offer a nod to history while fitting seamlessly into modern design sensibilities.

The square format and deep white hue of these tiles create a versatile canvas that allows for a variety of installation patterns. Their glossy finish enhances the depth and character of the glaze, bringing a subtle yet striking elegance to any wall.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an excellent choice for bathrooms and splashbacks. Their gloss surface not only adds a touch of sophistication but also ensures easy maintenance.

Whether you're aiming to evoke a sense of nostalgia or to complement a contemporary aesthetic, these tiles offer the flexibility to do both. Their timeless appeal makes them well-suited to a range of interior styles, from traditional to modern.

With Tunstall Ceramic Square Deep White tiles, you can effortlessly achieve a balance of heritage and modernity, creating spaces that are both authentic and inviting.

name: Reform Composite Stone Tumbled Mint
bodyHtml:
Reform Composite Stone Tumbled Mint tiles are a testament to sustainable innovation, crafted from recycled stone materials in a carbon-neutral factory. These tiles bring a sense of modernity while honouring the natural world.

Their mint hue is rich and playful, softened by a tumbled finish that gives each tile a gently rounded edge and an irresistibly tactile feel. This combination of texture and colour invites a touch of whimsy into any space.

Made for both indoor and outdoor settings, these tiles are as practical as they are beautiful. With an R12 slip rating, they offer a secure footing in areas like bathrooms, kitchens, and patios, ensuring safety without compromising on style.

Envision these tiles gracing a kitchen floor or a patio, where their unique character can be appreciated up close. Their versatility allows them to complement a variety of design schemes, from rustic to modern.

Reform Composite Stone Tumbled Mint tiles are a forward-thinking choice, blending durability with a touch of elegance. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their beauty over time.

With their blend of style and practicality, these tiles offer a timeless solution for those seeking to infuse their spaces with a touch of coastal charm. Their enduring appeal ensures they remain a favourite for years to come.

name: Aventuras Linen Field Porcelain
bodyHtml:
The Aventuras Linen Field Porcelain tiles, designed by the talented Zoe Glencross, bring a touch of Portuguese flair to your interiors. With a nod to traditional tile artistry, these tiles celebrate pattern and colour, offering a canvas for creative expression.

Featuring a matt finish, these square tiles are crafted from durable porcelain, making them a refined choice for both walls and floors. Their subtle linen hue adds a layer of sophistication, allowing for seamless integration into a variety of design schemes.

These tiles are well-suited for both indoor and outdoor use, with a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and an R10 classification. This ensures they perform beautifully in bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and even patios, providing a versatile solution for your design needs.

Whether you're drawn to the intricate motifs or prefer a more understated approach, the Aventuras collection offers endless possibilities. Pair them with coordinating border and corner pieces to create a truly bespoke look tailored to your space.

Embrace the spirit of design with these characterful tiles, where traditional inspiration meets modern versatility, offering both aesthetic appeal and practical performance.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for both wall and floor applications in kitchens and bathrooms. Their robust nature ensures they withstand the demands of daily use while maintaining their distinctive appearance.

Whether you're aiming for a modern look or a more classic ambiance, these tiles offer a versatile foundation. Their rich tones and textured finish make them an ideal choice for creating a warm, inviting atmosphere.

With Sicilia Porcelain Brushed tiles, you can effortlessly blend style with practicality, bringing a touch of Mediterranean charm to your interiors.

name: Metropolitan Slate Parquet Riven Finish
bodyHtml:
Metropolitan Slate Parquet Riven Finish tiles bring a touch of urban sophistication to any interior space. Their naturally riven surface captures the essence of slate, offering a tactile experience that is both subtle and engaging.

Crafted with a calibrated thickness, these tiles display a harmonious blend of grey tones that evoke a modern aesthetic. The parquet format adds a layer of visual interest, creating a dynamic pattern that draws the eye across walls and floors alike.

Made from high-quality slate, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an ideal choice for kitchens, bathrooms, and wet rooms. Their inherent texture provides a gentle grip underfoot, enhancing the practical appeal of any space.

The versatility of the Metropolitan Slate Parquet Riven Finish tiles allows them to complement a variety of design schemes, from contemporary to more traditional settings. Their understated elegance makes them a refined choice for those seeking to add depth and character to their interiors.

Sealing is required to maintain the natural beauty and durability of these tiles, ensuring they continue to impress for years to come. With their distinctive style and practical benefits, these tiles offer a perfect balance of form and function.

name: Brooklyn Embossed Ceramic
bodyHtml:

Crafted in a pewter hue, these square ceramic tiles bring a sense of depth and character to any space. Their embossed finish adds a tactile quality, inviting touch and admiration, while the subtle sheen enhances their decorative appeal.

Made from durable ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well suited to both wall and floor applications. With an R9 slip rating, they provide a practical choice for areas where safety is a consideration.

Perfect for kitchens, bathrooms, and feature walls, Brooklyn Embossed Ceramic tiles lend a vintage aesthetic that complements both rustic and modern interiors. Their timeless design ensures they remain a stylish choice for years to come.

These tiles offer a harmonious blend of style and functionality, making them a refined addition to any home. Their enduring appeal lies in their ability to transform spaces with subtle sophistication and historical charm.

name: Illusion Daytona Porcelain Polished
bodyHtml:
Illusion Daytona offers a refined, contemporary choice for modern homes. With bold grey-gold veins flashing across a crisp white background, these have all the luxe look of Statuario marble in a durable porcelain format. 

With their highly polished surface, Daytona really captures and enhances light in a room, creating a sense of space and cleanliness. The finish accentuates the gentle veining and soft white tones.

Designed for internal use, these tiles are suitable for both wall and floor applications. Whilst the slipperiness needs to be taken into consideration, Daytona looks stunning in living spaces, and on walls in showers and wet rooms, where their polished surface can add a sense of space and light.

Pair Daytona with a grippier floor tile in wet areas for the best effect. Concrete, wood and stone effects all pair well with Daytona, to create a harmonious and inviting space.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for both wall and floor applications. With a textured finish, they offer a PTV+36 slip rating when wet, ensuring safety in areas like bathrooms and kitchens.

Ideal for adding character to bathrooms, shower rooms, kitchens, and hallways, these tiles offer a versatile option for those looking to incorporate a touch of historical charm into modern interiors. Their russet red hue adds warmth and a touch of nostalgia.

Pavilion Porcelain Russet Red tiles provide a thoughtful balance of design and practicality, offering a timeless appeal that complements both traditional and contemporary settings.

name: Reform Composite Stone Tumbled Salmon Pink
bodyHtml:

Their rich, playful salmon pink tones are beautifully complemented by a tumbled finish, which softens the edges and enhances their tactile appeal. This finish offers a sense of warmth and character, inviting touch and interaction.

Designed for versatility, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings, making them an excellent choice for bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios alike. Their robust composition ensures they withstand the demands of various environments.

With their ability to grace both walls and floors, these tiles provide endless styling possibilities. Whether creating a rustic chequerboard pattern or a modern minimalist look, they adapt effortlessly to diverse design visions.

While they bring a touch of the future with their sustainable credentials, these tiles also require sealing to maintain their beauty over time. A thoughtful choice for those who appreciate both style and substance.

bodyHtml:

The tumbled finish enhances their rustic appeal, creating a surface that feels both inviting and enduring. The warm russet tones bring a touch of natural elegance, making them a versatile choice for various design schemes.

Crafted for both internal and external use, these pavers are well-suited to a range of environments, from swimming pools to patios. Their robust nature ensures they withstand the elements while maintaining their beauty.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), these pavers are a testament to quality and durability. Their brick shape offers a classic look, perfect for creating defined pathways or zoned areas.

With no sealing required, the Flanders Warm Russet pavers offer a practical yet stylish solution for your flooring needs. Allow their understated elegance to enhance your space effortlessly.

name: Portland Limestone Honed Parquet
bodyHtml:
Portland Limestone Honed Parquet tiles bring a touch of British heritage to your interiors. Known for their creamy tones and fossil-rich texture, these tiles echo the grandeur of iconic buildings across the country.

The honed finish enhances the natural beauty of the limestone, while the parquet format introduces a classic pattern that adds visual interest to any space. Their compact size is a sustainable choice, making use of waste material without compromising on elegance.

Crafted from durable limestone, these tiles are designed for internal use, suitable for both walls and floors. They require sealing to maintain their pristine appearance and are well-suited for areas like kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways.

Imagine these tiles gracing your home, where their traditional style complements both contemporary and classic interiors. Their understated charm makes them a versatile choice for a variety of design schemes.

Please note, these tiles are prone to efflorescence. To prevent this, store them in a dry area and use a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive.

name: Byzantine Porcelain Elysium Sculpted
bodyHtml:
Byzantine Porcelain Elysium Sculpted tiles capture the essence of ancient Greek mosaic artistry, bringing a touch of historical elegance to modern interiors. Their design is a harmonious blend of geometric, floral, and contemporary patterns that evoke a sense of timeless beauty.

Crafted in a durable porcelain format, these tiles are designed with a satin finish that enhances their visual appeal. The tactile 3D surface cleverly mimics the intricate grout joints found in traditional mosaics, adding depth and texture to any space.

Made from porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for internal use, offering versatility across various rooms including bathrooms, kitchens, and feature walls. With an R10 slip rating, they provide a practical choice for both wall and floor applications.

These tiles are particularly effective in creating standout feature walls or adding subtle interest to hallways and wet rooms. Their understated white colour palette ensures they complement a wide range of interior styles without overwhelming the space.

Byzantine Porcelain Elysium Sculpted tiles are a refined choice for those seeking to incorporate the charm of mosaic art into their home, balancing aesthetic allure with practical functionality.

Maroc Ceramic Glicine tiles are well suited to both traditional and modern settings. They effortlessly complement a variety of design schemes, whether used as a feature wall or as part of a chequerboard pattern.

With their timeless appeal and practical application, these tiles offer a perfect blend of style and functionality, ensuring they remain a cherished element in your home for years to come.

bodyHtml:

Made from high-quality ceramic, these tiles are suited for internal use, making them an excellent choice for bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and feature walls. Their satin finish enhances their tactile appeal, offering a subtle sheen that catches the light beautifully.

Ideal for those who appreciate the nuances of handcrafted products, these tiles embrace natural variations, which are integral to their handmade effect. This characteristic adds depth and authenticity to any space they inhabit.

With no sealing required, these tiles offer a seamless blend of practicality and design, ensuring they remain a timeless addition to your interior projects. Please note, due to their artisanal nature, variations and misprints are to be expected, enhancing the handmade effect.

name: Rialto Terrazzo Castello Honed
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless elegance of Venice, the Rialto Terrazzo Castello Honed tiles bring a touch of Italian heritage to any interior. These tiles, named after iconic Venetian landmarks, capture the essence of terrazzo's enduring charm.

Crafted from recycled and waste marble materials, these tiles are as sustainable as they are beautiful. The honed finish provides a smooth surface that enhances the intricate pattern and subtle grey tones, creating a sophisticated backdrop for modern living spaces.

Designed for indoor use, these tiles are well-suited to kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways. With a slip rating of PTV 22 when wet, they offer peace of mind in areas where safety is a priority. Please note that sealing is required to maintain their pristine appearance.

Whether adorning walls or floors, the Rialto Terrazzo Castello Honed tiles add a refined touch to any room. Their understated elegance complements both contemporary and traditional interiors, allowing for versatile design possibilities.

Please be aware that due to the technical characteristics of this material, an S2 adhesive is recommended. Our Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive is not suitable for this product.

name: Aventuras Palma Blue Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Designed by the talented Zoe Glencross, Aventuras Palma Blue Porcelain tiles are a vibrant tribute to pattern and colour. Drawing inspiration from traditional Portuguese tiles, this collection embraces the spirit of maximalist design, inviting you to explore a world of intricate motifs and unique chequerboard patterns.

These square, matt-finished tiles offer a canvas for creativity, with coordinating border and corner pieces that allow for endless design possibilities. Whether you're drawn to the intricate Ziggy border or prefer a more restrained approach, Aventuras encourages you to become your own designer.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, making them a versatile choice for bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and even patios. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they provide peace of mind in wet areas.

Imagine these tiles gracing your floors or walls, adding a touch of character and sophistication to any space. Their bold patterns and rich blue tones create a striking visual impact, perfect for those who appreciate design with depth and personality.

With Aventuras Palma Blue, you can confidently blend practicality with artistic flair, creating spaces that are as functional as they are beautiful. Let these tiles inspire your next project, bringing a touch of Portuguese charm to your home.

name: Oasis Veloute Ceramic Sage Matt
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless elegance of Moroccan Bejmat tiles, Oasis Veloute Ceramic Sage Matt tiles offer a contemporary reinterpretation of this classic style. Their design captures the essence of traditional craftsmanship, reimagined in a gentle pastel palette.

These tiles feature a subtle, dappled texture that echoes the handcrafted quality of their Moroccan predecessors. The soft sage hue adds a touch of understated sophistication, making them a versatile choice for a range of interiors.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for indoor use, offering a matt finish that enhances their tactile appeal. They are well-suited for walls in bathrooms, showers, and wet rooms, where their calming tones can create a serene atmosphere.

Oasis Veloute tiles are perfect for splashbacks, where their gentle colour and texture can complement both modern and traditional design schemes. Their versatility allows them to blend seamlessly into various aesthetic contexts, adding character without overwhelming the space.

With no sealing required, these tiles offer a practical yet stylish solution for those seeking to infuse their interiors with a touch of Moroccan charm, updated for the modern home.

name: Lombok Porcelain Moss
bodyHtml:
Embrace the natural elegance of Lombok Porcelain Moss tiles, where rustic slate designs meet industrial style. These tiles are crafted to bring a touch of the outdoors inside, with a tactile, riven-effect surface that captures the essence of natural stone.

Designed in a moss green hue, these tiles offer a matt finish that enhances their organic appeal. The subtle variations in tone and texture create a dynamic visual experience, evoking the rugged beauty of slate while maintaining a refined, modern aesthetic.

Made from durable porcelain, Lombok tiles are well-suited for internal use, offering both strength and ease of maintenance. Their R11 slip rating ensures a practical choice for spaces where safety is paramount, such as bathrooms and kitchens.

Ideal for both walls and floors, these tiles effortlessly adapt to various settings, from feature walls to shower and wet room installations. Their versatile design complements both modern and traditional interiors, adding depth and character to any room.

With their combination of aesthetic appeal and practical benefits, Lombok Porcelain Moss tiles are a thoughtful choice for those seeking to infuse their spaces with a touch of nature's elegance.

Crafted from durable porcelain, Aventuras Porto Blue tiles are suitable for both internal and external applications, including bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they provide both style and safety underfoot.

Whether you're designing a striking feature wall or a patterned floor, these tiles invite creativity. Pair them with the Ziggy border for added flair, or let their intricate patterns stand alone for a more understated look.

Aventuras Porto Blue Porcelain tiles offer a perfect balance of design and practicality, allowing you to create spaces that are as functional as they are beautiful. Their enduring appeal ensures they will be a cherished element in your home for years to come.

name: Victorian Style™ Porcelain Finchley Pattern Soft Grey
bodyHtml:
Embrace the timeless elegance of the Victorian era with the Victorian Style™ Porcelain Finchley Pattern Soft Grey tiles. These tiles capture the intricate charm of traditional mosaic patterns, offering a sophisticated nod to the past with a modern twist.

Crafted in a soft grey hue, these tiles present a matt finish that enhances their understated appeal. The pre-scored design simplifies installation, allowing for a seamless mosaic effect without the complexity of individual pieces.

Made from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor spaces, including kitchens, bathrooms, and patios. With an R10 slip rating, they offer moderate slip resistance, though care should be taken to maintain their grip, especially in wet areas.

These tiles are well-suited for creating a classic aesthetic in hallways, splashbacks, and shower rooms. Pair them with complementary tones for a cohesive look that speaks to both heritage and contemporary design sensibilities.

Please note, to preserve the pristine surface of these tiles, we recommend using our Sarsen Home Porcelain Pre-Grout Barrier to prevent grout staining. No sealing is required, ensuring a low-maintenance yet stylish finish.

name: Matravers Sandstone Sawn
bodyHtml:
With its fine-grained texture and speckled grey hues, Matravers Sandstone Sawn brings a touch of European elegance to outdoor spaces. Its subtle tonal variations lend a refined character that enhances any setting.

Crafted from high-quality sandstone, these tiles are designed for external use, making them a thoughtful choice for patios and swimming pool surrounds. Their natural finish offers a modern yet rustic appeal, effortlessly bridging different style preferences.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), Matravers Sandstone Sawn is as practical as it is beautiful. Its natural properties make it well-suited for outdoor environments, where durability and style go hand in hand.

These tiles require sealing, ensuring their longevity and maintaining their understated elegance over time. This practical consideration is a small step towards preserving their natural beauty.

Whether gracing a garden patio or complementing a poolside retreat, Matravers Sandstone Sawn stands as a testament to considered design and enduring quality.

name: Silk Screen Ceramic Lantau Bamboo Smoke Green
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from beloved wallpaper designs, the Silk Screen Ceramic Lantau Bamboo Smoke Green tiles bring a touch of artisanal craftsmanship to your interiors. These tiles, crafted using a traditional silk screen process, offer a unique blend of character and subtlety.

The design features a satin finish that enhances the soft green tones, creating an understated yet impactful visual narrative. Their rectangular shape and patterned style evoke a Victorian charm, making them a refined choice for those seeking a timeless aesthetic.

Made from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, perfect for transforming bathrooms, showers, and feature walls into spaces of quiet elegance. The satin finish adds a gentle sheen, contributing to the overall sense of calm and sophistication.

These tiles come alive when used in spaces that embrace their handcrafted essence. Pair them with natural materials or contrasting textures to highlight their unique qualities. They are well-suited to settings that appreciate the beauty of traditional craftsmanship.

Please note, due to their artisanal nature, some misprints are to be expected and contribute to the handmade effect. These tiles do not require sealing, allowing for easy maintenance while preserving their authentic charm.

name: Seaton Ceramic Beach Hut
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the charming seaside town of Devon, the Seaton Ceramic Beach Hut tiles bring a touch of coastal elegance to your interiors. Their soothing blue hue evokes the tranquil essence of a beachside retreat.

These tiles boast a distinctive crackle glaze finish, offering a unique visual texture that captures the light beautifully. The crackle effect adds depth and interest, making each tile a subtle work of art.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for indoor use, specifically suited for walls in bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks. Their format and finish make them a practical choice for spaces where a touch of character is desired.

Seaton Ceramic Beach Hut tiles complement both modern and traditional settings, allowing for versatile styling possibilities. Whether used as a feature wall or a subtle backdrop, they bring a sense of calm and sophistication to any room.

Please note that due to their crackle glaze finish, these tiles require sealing with a Crackle Glaze Protector to maintain their beauty and performance over time.

The distinctive mercury hue of these glass tiles creates a reflective surface that plays with light, adding depth and dimension to walls. Their brick shape offers a classic format that complements a variety of design styles, from metro to rustic.

Crafted from glass, these tiles are designed for indoor use, making them a refined choice for feature walls, splashbacks, and other decorative applications. Please note, they are not suitable for use in shower areas.

Rococo Glass Mirror Mercury tiles are well suited to both modern and traditional interiors, offering a versatile option for those looking to introduce a touch of glamour. Their unique finish provides a striking backdrop that enhances any room's character.

With no sealing required, these tiles offer an accessible way to bring a touch of antique charm to your home. Their understated elegance and timeless appeal make them a thoughtful addition to any design scheme.

name: Buscot Limestone Tumbled Pietra Pazza
bodyHtml:
Our most popular limestone now comes in a 'Pietra Pazza' format- Italian for 'crazy stone'. With a gently eased tumbled edge, this warm creamy-beige stone suits a new generation of interiors that is rejecting hard lines and embracing more flowing, limitless styles. Soft and organic in feel, with each piece completely individual, give your space a contemporary yet timeless feel with all the character and elegance of natural stone. Requires an artistic flair when laying for best results.

Sold in project packs of 20 m² modules. Each crate contains randomly sized pieces that vary in dimensions, this natural variation means the stone is measured and packed by weight to calculate square meterage. Due to the organic, irregular nature of the Pietra Pazza format, purchases must be in complete 20 m² increments.

name: Earthenware Porcelain Plaster
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the charm of Italian pottery found in the vibrant streets of Amalfi Coast villages, Earthenware Porcelain Plaster tiles bring a touch of Mediterranean warmth to your interiors. These tiles showcase a subtle Plaster hue, offering a versatile canvas for creative expression.

The matt finish of these tiles beautifully echoes the texture of handcrafted pottery, adding a tactile quality to any space. Their slender rectangular form allows for a variety of installation patterns, from classic horizontal and vertical layouts to more inventive designs.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited to both walls and floors. Their practical nature ensures they are a reliable choice for high-traffic areas like kitchens and bathrooms.

Whether used in a bathroom, shower, wet room, or as a kitchen splashback, these tiles offer a refined aesthetic that complements a range of interior styles. Their understated elegance allows them to blend seamlessly with both contemporary and traditional décor.

With their roots in time-honoured craftsmanship and a design that prioritises both beauty and function, Earthenware Porcelain Plaster tiles are a thoughtful addition to any home. Their enduring appeal lies in their ability to quietly enhance a space without overwhelming it.

bodyHtml:
Long Island Marble Honed Finish Large Hexagon tiles bring a refined elegance to any interior space. Their classic white marble surface is adorned with subtle grey veining, creating a sophisticated crystalline structure that captures the eye.

Crafted in a large hexagonal format, these tiles offer a modern twist on traditional marble aesthetics. The honed finish provides a smooth, matte surface that enhances the natural beauty of the marble, making it a versatile choice for both contemporary and traditional design schemes.

Made from high-quality marble, these tiles are designed for internal use, suitable for walls and floors in bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways. Please note, these tiles require sealing to maintain their pristine appearance over time.

Whether used as a statement piece in a bathroom or as a chic backdrop in a kitchen, these tiles offer endless styling possibilities. Pair them with complementary mosaics and mouldings for a cohesive look that exudes timeless appeal.

name: Victorian Style™ Porcelain Anthracite Field
bodyHtml:
Evoking the timeless elegance of the Victorian era, the Victorian Style™ Porcelain Anthracite Field tiles capture the intricate charm of traditional mosaic patterns. These tiles offer a bold anthracite hue, bringing a touch of historic sophistication to any space.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their classic appeal. The prescored design simplifies installation, allowing you to achieve a seamless Victorian look with ease.

Designed for both internal and external applications, the tiles are well-suited to a variety of settings, from kitchens and bathrooms to hallways and patios. With an R10 slip rating, they provide a medium level of slip resistance, making them a practical choice for many environments.

To maintain their slip resistance, it's important to keep these tiles clean. We recommend using our Sarsen Home Porcelain Pre-Grout Barrier to prevent grout stains on the tile surface, ensuring they retain their pristine appearance.

These tiles require no sealing, offering a low-maintenance solution that combines aesthetic beauty with practical functionality. A refined choice for those seeking to infuse their spaces with a touch of Victorian grandeur.

Featuring a harmonious blend of intricate motifs and a warm terracotta hue, these tiles offer a distinctive aesthetic that captures the eye. The matt finish enhances their tactile appeal, making them a thoughtful choice for those who appreciate subtle texture.

Made from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, ensuring versatility across various settings. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet, they provide a practical solution for areas prone to moisture.

Whether adorning a bathroom, kitchen, hallway, or patio, Aventuras Palma Terracotta Porcelain tiles bring character and charm to your surroundings. Consider pairing them with coordinating borders or corner pieces for a cohesive design.

Embrace the endless possibilities of pattern layering and create a space that reflects your personal style. These tiles offer a refined balance of design and functionality, making them a timeless addition to any interior or exterior project.

name: Reform Composite Stone Tumbled Nero
bodyHtml:
Reform Composite Stone Tumbled Nero tiles offer a thoughtful fusion of recycled stone materials, crafted in a carbon-neutral environment. Their design speaks to a sustainable future, where durability meets natural aesthetics.

The tumbled finish of these tiles reveals a rich tapestry of playful tones, softened by lightly rounded edges. This creates a surface that is not only visually appealing but also irresistibly tactile, inviting touch and interaction.

Made from composite stone, these tiles are designed for resilience. With an R12 slip rating, they provide a secure footing, making them suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications. Their versatility extends to various settings, including bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios.

These tiles are well-suited to spaces where style and practicality converge. Their modern yet rustic charm complements a range of interior and exterior designs, offering a seamless transition between different areas of the home.

With a focus on enduring design and eco-conscious production, Reform Composite Stone Tumbled Nero tiles embody a balance of beauty and functionality. They require sealing to maintain their integrity, ensuring they remain a timeless feature in any setting.

bodyHtml:

Each tile showcases a honed finish that enhances its natural crystalline structure, creating a surface that is both smooth and tactile. The tear drop pattern adds a touch of sophistication, making these tiles a versatile choice for various design schemes.

Crafted from high-quality marble, these tiles are intended for internal use, suitable for both walls and floors. They are particularly well-suited to bathrooms, kitchens, and splashbacks, where their natural beauty can be fully appreciated.

When considering installation, it's important to note that these tiles are prone to efflorescence. To mitigate this, store them in a dry area and use a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive.

With their enduring appeal and refined aesthetic, Long Island Marble Honed Finish Tear Drop tiles bring a sense of understated luxury to any space. They require sealing to maintain their pristine condition over time.

name: Victorian Style™ Porcelain Finchley Pattern Sky Blue
bodyHtml:
Capturing the essence of the Victorian era, the Victorian Style™ Porcelain Finchley Pattern Sky Blue tiles bring a touch of historic charm to any setting. Their bold, sky blue tones and intricate patterns echo the elegance of traditional mosaic floors, reimagined in a contemporary format.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their visual depth while maintaining a subtle, understated elegance. The prescored design simplifies installation, offering the aesthetic of classic mosaics with modern convenience.

These tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications, making them a versatile choice for a variety of spaces. With an R10 slip rating, they provide a medium level of slip resistance, though care should be taken to keep them clean, especially in wet areas.

Ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios, they effortlessly complement both contemporary and traditional interiors. To prevent grout stains, we recommend using our Sarsen Home Porcelain Pre-Grout Barrier during installation.

With no sealing required, these tiles offer a practical yet stylish solution for those seeking to infuse their space with a touch of Victorian elegance and modern functionality.

name: Kimmeridge Limestone Tumbled & Etched Parquet
bodyHtml:
The Kimmeridge Limestone Tumbled & Etched Parquet brings a harmonious blend of modern style and rustic charm to your space. Its unique finish offers a tactile experience, evoking the timeless appeal of natural stone with a contemporary twist.

Crafted from limestone, these tiles feature a tumbled and etched surface that adds depth and character to floors. The brick shape and grey tones create a visually appealing pattern, perfect for those seeking a design with both texture and subtlety.

Suitable for both indoor and outdoor settings, these tiles provide additional grip, making them an ideal choice for kitchens, hallways, and patios. Please note that sealing is required to maintain their appearance and performance over time.

These tiles are prone to efflorescence, a natural occurrence in limestone. To mitigate this, store them in a dry area and use a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive, during installation.

With their enduring appeal and practical benefits, the Kimmeridge Limestone Tumbled & Etched Parquet offers a refined solution for those looking to enhance their living spaces with a touch of natural elegance.

Made from high-quality ceramic, Tunstall tiles are designed for indoor use, making them a refined choice for bathrooms and splashback areas. Their durable nature ensures they stand up to the demands of everyday life, while their aesthetic appeal remains undiminished.

These tiles are well-suited to both modern and traditional interiors, offering a seamless blend of old-world charm and modern sophistication. Whether used to create a feature wall or as a subtle backdrop, they bring character and style to any setting.

With their rich glaze and enduring appeal, Tunstall Ceramic Brick Fern tiles provide a sophisticated solution for those seeking to infuse their spaces with a touch of historical elegance and contemporary flair.

name: Aventuras Terracotta Field Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Designed by pattern designer Zoe Glencross, the Aventuras Terracotta Field Porcelain tiles are a vibrant celebration of pattern and colour. Drawing inspiration from traditional Portuguese tiles, they invite a touch of heritage into modern spaces.

These tiles feature a matt finish in warm terracotta tones, creating a subtle backdrop that complements both intricate motifs and bold chequerboard designs. Their square format allows for creative pattern layering, whether paired with coordinating borders or used alone for a more understated look.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are as practical as they are beautiful. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they are well-suited for both internal and external applications, seamlessly transitioning from kitchens and bathrooms to patios and hallways.

Envision these tiles enhancing the character of a kitchen or adding warmth to an outdoor patio. Their versatility allows for endless design possibilities, whether you choose to embrace maximalist patterns or a more restrained aesthetic.

With the Aventuras collection, you have the freedom to design a space that reflects your personal style, all while enjoying the enduring appeal of quality porcelain craftsmanship.

name: Aventuras Rose Field Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Designed by pattern designer Zoe Glencross, Aventuras Rose Field Porcelain tiles are a vibrant celebration of pattern and colour, drawing inspiration from traditional Portuguese tiles. These tiles embrace the trend for maximalist designs and pattern layering, offering a rich tapestry of intricate motifs and unique chequerboard options.

The Aventuras collection invites creativity, allowing you to mix and match patterns with coordinating border and corner pieces. Whether you choose to pair them with the intricate Ziggy border or opt for a more restrained look, the possibilities are endless, making these tiles a versatile choice for any design vision.

Crafted from durable porcelain with a matt finish, these tiles are suitable for both internal and external use. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they provide a practical solution for areas prone to moisture, such as bathrooms, kitchens, and patios.

Imagining these tiles in your space is a breeze; their pink hue and modern yet traditional style make them well-suited to a variety of settings. From a statement bathroom floor to a charming kitchen backsplash, they bring character and warmth to any environment.

Embrace the artistry and practicality of Aventuras Rose Field Porcelain tiles, where design meets functionality with effortless elegance. Their enduring appeal ensures they remain a cherished element in any home.

name: Parterre Porcelain Plank
bodyHtml:
Parterre Porcelain Plank tiles bring a sophisticated wood effect to any interior. Their design captures the grandeur of traditional parquet flooring, reimagined in a durable porcelain format.

The matt finish of these planks enhances their authentic wood-like appearance, offering a tactile surface that adds depth and character to your space. With a classic plank shape, they are designed to create a seamless flow across walls and floors, making them a versatile choice for various settings.

Crafted from high-quality porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for indoor use, providing a practical yet stylish solution for kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways. The R9 slip rating ensures a safe and secure surface underfoot, without compromising on style.

Whether used alone or paired with other elements from the Parterre collection, these tiles offer endless possibilities for creative expression. Their understated elegance complements both traditional and contemporary interiors, allowing for a harmonious blend of old-world charm and modern design.

With Parterre Porcelain Plank tiles, you can effortlessly introduce a touch of refined luxury into your home, enjoying the beauty of wood with the benefits of porcelain.

name: Oasis Veloute Ceramic Sand Matt
bodyHtml:
Oasis Veloute Ceramic Sand Matt tiles capture the essence of traditional Moroccan Bejmat tiles, reimagined for contemporary interiors. These tiles offer a tactile experience with their dappled, textured surface, reminiscent of time-honoured craftsmanship.

The soft sand hue of these ceramic tiles creates a gentle, pastel palette that adds warmth and subtlety to any wall. Their matt finish enhances the understated elegance, making them a refined choice for those seeking a touch of the exotic in their home.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, bringing a sense of depth and character to bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks. Their Zellige effect offers a modern twist on a classic style, suitable for both metro and traditional settings.

Oasis Veloute tiles are well-suited to wall applications, where their unique texture and colour can be fully appreciated. They effortlessly complement a variety of design schemes, from minimalist to more eclectic aesthetics.

With no sealing required, these tiles offer a practical yet stylish solution for those looking to infuse their space with a sense of artisanal charm and modern sophistication.

With their charming shape and inviting colour, Gelato Porcelain Mosaic Mint tiles are a refined choice for those looking to infuse their spaces with a dash of personality and elegance.

name: Athens Rosso Travertine Mosaic
bodyHtml:
The Athens Rosso Travertine Mosaic captures the essence of tactile beauty with its intricate mini herringbone pattern. These mosaics, with their vibrant red tones, bring a touch of warmth and character to any space.

Crafted from travertine, the tiles boast a satiny, brushed and tumbled finish that enhances their natural appeal. The subtle texture adds depth, inviting a closer look and a gentle touch.

Designed for internal use, these mosaics are well suited to both wall and floor applications. Whether in a kitchen, bathroom, or as a striking splashback, they create a refined backdrop that is both modern and timeless.

Sealing is required to maintain the beauty and durability of the travertine, ensuring it remains a cherished feature in your home. The natural stone's resilience makes it a practical choice for high-traffic areas.

With their harmonious blend of colour and texture, the Athens Rosso Travertine Mosaic tiles offer a sophisticated solution for those seeking to infuse their interiors with elegance and charm.

name: Clover Cabochon Nero Slate Honed
bodyHtml:
The Clover Cabochon Nero Slate Honed offers a refined touch to traditional flooring designs. Crafted with precision from Italian slate, these cabochons introduce a subtle yet distinctive element to your space.

Designed to complement tiles clipped into octagons, hexagons, or pentagons, these cabochons are intended for use with tiles prepared for 75mm cabochons. Their unique clover shape adds an unexpected twist to classic floor patterns.

Made from durable limestone and finished with a honed surface, these cabochons are well-suited for internal use, particularly in kitchens and hallways. The honed finish provides a smooth, elegant texture underfoot.

These cabochons are perfect for those looking to add a subtle design detail to their floor without overpowering the existing décor. Their understated elegance makes them a versatile choice for various traditional settings.

Sealing is required to maintain the integrity and appearance of the slate, ensuring these cabochons continue to enhance your space with their timeless appeal.

name: Victorian Style™ Wall Ceramic Emerald Green Metro
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless elegance of Victorian bathrooms, the Victorian Style™ Wall Ceramic Emerald Green Metro tiles capture the essence of a bygone era. Their rich, emerald green hue brings a sense of depth and sophistication to any space.

These tiles feature a classic metro brick shape with a glossy finish that reflects light beautifully, adding a subtle sheen to your walls. Their traditional design is perfect for creating a striking feature wall or a full room of vintage charm.

Crafted from quality ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an ideal choice for bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks. Their glossy surface enhances the colour, creating a vibrant focal point in any setting.

While these tiles are a stunning addition to wet areas, it's important to note that they may discolour if not properly protected. We recommend using a Crackle Glaze Protector to maintain their beauty over time.

The Victorian Style™ Wall Ceramic Emerald Green Metro tiles offer a refined balance of historic allure and modern practicality, making them a thoughtful choice for those seeking to infuse their interiors with character and elegance.

Crafted from durable limestone, Romaine is perfectly suited to both classic and contemporary interiors. Whether used across kitchen floors, hallways, or living areas, it offers a versatile foundation that pairs effortlessly with a range of materials and styles.

Practical as well as beautiful, this stone is designed for everyday living, with a robust composition that performs well in busy areas of the home. Like all natural limestone, sealing is recommended to protect its surface and preserve its character for years to come.

With its understated elegance and enduring style, Romaine Limestone Tumbled Finish is an ideal choice for creating spaces that feel both refined and welcoming.

The honed finish of these marble bricks enhances their natural beauty, allowing the intricate patterns to subtly reveal themselves. The brick format provides a classic yet contemporary edge, making them a versatile choice for various design aesthetics.

Crafted from premium marble, these tiles are designed for indoor use, perfect for both wall and floor applications. They require sealing to maintain their pristine appearance and ensure longevity, making them a thoughtful addition to any design scheme.

Ideal for bathrooms, splashbacks, and feature walls, the East Java Hummingbird tiles bring a sense of depth and character to spaces. Their vibrant colour and refined finish make them a striking choice for those looking to add a touch of the extraordinary to their interiors.

With a nod to both nature and luxury, these tiles offer a harmonious blend of aesthetic appeal and practical function, ensuring they remain a cherished element in any room they grace.

name: Tunstall Ceramic Square Coral
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the Victorian era's love for richly toned ceramics, Tunstall Ceramic Square Coral tiles bring a touch of historical elegance to modern interiors. These tiles capture the essence of the puddle glaze effect, a hallmark of British craftsmanship from the past.

The square format and glossy finish of these tiles enhance their vibrant coral hue, offering a dynamic visual experience. Their smooth surface reflects light beautifully, adding depth and interest to any wall they adorn.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an ideal choice for bathrooms and splashbacks. Their gloss finish not only highlights their colour but also makes them easy to clean and maintain.

Whether you're aiming for a contemporary look or a nod to tradition, these tiles fit seamlessly into various design schemes. Their bold colour and classic form allow for creative installations that can transform a space into a statement of style.

With Tunstall Ceramic Square Coral tiles, you can effortlessly blend the old with the new, creating a space that is both timeless and expressive.

name: Matravers Sandstone Tumbled Cobbles
bodyHtml:
The Matravers Sandstone Tumbled Cobbles bring a touch of European charm to outdoor spaces with their fine-grained, speckled grey surface. Each cobble showcases subtle tonal variations that add a layer of character and depth, making them a distinctive choice for any landscape design.

These cobbles are crafted from sandstone, a material known for its durability and timeless appeal. The tumbled finish enhances their rustic allure, softening edges and creating a weathered look that complements both modern and traditional settings.

Designed for external use, the Matravers Sandstone Tumbled Cobbles are well-suited to patios and pool areas, providing a natural, cohesive look to outdoor environments. Their robust nature ensures they withstand the elements while maintaining their visual appeal.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), these cobbles are a testament to quality and thoughtful design. Their grey tones blend seamlessly with natural surroundings, offering a refined yet understated aesthetic.

While they require sealing to preserve their beauty, these cobbles are a considered choice for those seeking to enhance their outdoor spaces with a touch of European elegance.

These klinkers can be effortlessly paired with Trafalgar paving or used as a contrasting element with other colours, allowing for endless layout possibilities. Their understated elegance complements a variety of outdoor styles.

With their combination of practicality and aesthetic appeal, Trafalgar Sandstone Tumbled Klinkers offer a refined solution for those seeking to enhance their outdoor spaces with natural beauty.

name: Byzantine Porcelain Palation Sculpted
bodyHtml:
The Byzantine Porcelain Palation Sculpted tiles are a tribute to the ancient art of mosaic, capturing the essence of Greek heritage in a modern porcelain format. Their design is a harmonious blend of geometric, floral, and contemporary patterns, creating a visual tapestry that speaks of history and innovation.

Crafted with a satin finish, these tiles feature a wonderfully tactile 3D surface that mimics the intricate look of marble mosaics. The design cleverly replicates the appearance of grout joints, adding depth and authenticity to each piece.

Made from durable porcelain, these tiles are suited for indoor use across a variety of spaces. With an R10 slip rating, they provide a practical choice for areas such as bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways, ensuring both style and safety.

These tiles effortlessly enhance feature walls and floors, bringing a touch of classic elegance to modern interiors. Their grey and white palette offers a versatile backdrop that complements a range of design schemes.

Byzantine Porcelain Palation Sculpted combines artistic expression with practical design, offering a refined solution for those seeking to infuse their spaces with timeless character and charm.

name: Aventuras Olive Field Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Designed by the talented pattern designer Zoe Glencross, Aventuras Olive Field Porcelain tiles capture the spirit of traditional Portuguese tiles through a modern lens. This collection is a celebration of bold patterns and vibrant colour, inviting creativity into your space.

These tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their intricate design, offering a tactile experience that is both visually and physically engaging. The Olive Field colourway adds a warm, earthy tone that complements a variety of interiors.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications, including bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they provide a practical solution without compromising on style.

Whether used as a statement floor or a feature wall, Aventuras Olive Field tiles seamlessly blend into both modern and traditional settings. Their versatility allows for endless design possibilities, whether paired with coordinating borders or used alone for a more understated look.

This collection embodies a balance of design and functionality, offering a refined choice for those looking to infuse their spaces with character and charm. No sealing is required, making them a convenient and stylish option for any project.

The warm beige tones of these tiles create a welcoming atmosphere, seamlessly integrating with natural surroundings. Their understated charm allows them to pair beautifully with a variety of outdoor furnishings and plantings, enhancing the overall design narrative of your space.

Whether you're looking to enhance a traditional garden or add character to a modern patio, Pierre Paving Porcelain Beige offers a thoughtful blend of design and durability, ensuring your outdoor space remains inviting and timeless.

bodyHtml:
Byzantine Porcelain Forum Sculpted tiles draw inspiration from the intricate art of ancient Greek mosaics. These tiles capture the essence of classical design with a modern twist, offering a harmonious blend of geometric, floral, and contemporary patterns.

Crafted in a satin finish, these porcelain tiles feature a wonderfully tactile 3D surface that mimics the appearance of individual mosaic pieces, complete with the look of grout joints. This thoughtful design adds depth and character to any space.

Made from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them suitable for a variety of settings including bathrooms, kitchens, and feature walls. The R10 slip rating ensures a practical choice for both wall and floor installations.

Perfectly suited to spaces that appreciate both form and function, these tiles can transform a hallway or a shower room into a statement of refined elegance. Their white hue provides a versatile backdrop that complements a range of interior styles.

Byzantine Porcelain Forum Sculpted tiles offer a seamless blend of artistry and practicality, bringing a touch of historical charm to modern interiors with ease.

name: Menara White Star Porcelain

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles feature a combination of matt and gloss finishes, adding depth and interest to any surface. Their square shape and intricate patterns invite endless creative arrangements, allowing for a truly bespoke installation.

Designed for versatility, the Menara White Star is suitable for both indoor use as well as on outdoor walls, making it an ideal choice for spaces that flow from the interior to the exterior. Whether in a bathroom, kitchen, or hallway, these tiles bring a touch of Moroccan flair to any setting.

Their Zellige effect style blends seamlessly with both modern and traditional interiors, offering a timeless appeal. These tiles are well-suited for interior walls and floors, creating a cohesive look throughout your home.

With no sealing required, the Menara White Star Porcelain tiles provide a practical yet stylish solution, embodying a perfect blend of creativity and enduring design.

Whether you're creating a welcoming terrace or a serene garden path, the Castilan Limestone Tumbled Klinkers offer a refined balance between natural beauty and practical performance. Their enduring appeal ensures they remain a cherished feature in your outdoor space for years to come.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles feature a textured finish that evokes the natural beauty of stone. The gentle interplay of grey tones adds depth and character, making them a refined choice for those who appreciate understated sophistication.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), Pierre Paving is well-suited for external applications. With an R11 slip rating, they provide a practical solution for areas where safety is paramount, such as patios and swimming pool surrounds.

These tiles effortlessly blend with a variety of outdoor settings, offering a timeless appeal that harmonises with both contemporary and traditional landscapes. Their versatile design invites creativity, allowing for a personalised touch in your exterior design.

Balancing aesthetic allure with practical functionality, Pierre Paving Porcelain Gris stands as a testament to thoughtful design. Its enduring style and robust performance make it a wise choice for transforming outdoor spaces.

Whether adorning a bathroom, kitchen, or patio, Cabana Porcelain Le Marais tiles add a burst of character and colour. Their versatility allows them to complement a variety of design schemes, from modern to eclectic.

Embrace the enduring appeal of these tiles as they transform your space into a vibrant canvas, balancing design with functionality. Their Caribbean-inspired patterns promise to bring a little sunshine into every corner.

name: Reform Composite Stone Tumbled Khaki
bodyHtml:

These tiles reveal rich, playful tones that are beautifully softened by a tumbled finish. The lightly rounded edges and tactile surface invite touch, adding a layer of sensory intrigue to any space.

Made from composite stone, these tiles are as durable as they are visually appealing. Suitable for both internal and external applications, they offer versatility across a range of environments, from bathrooms to patios.

The khaki hue complements both modern and rustic styles, making these tiles a refined choice for kitchens, hallways, and shower areas. Their adaptability allows them to harmonise with various design schemes effortlessly.

Reform Composite Stone Tumbled Khaki tiles are a testament to future-forward design, balancing durability with an inviting aesthetic. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their pristine appearance.

name: Hoxton Porcelain Amber Linear Décor Matt
bodyHtml:
A refined interpretation of natural quartzite, Hoxton Porcelain Amber Linear Decor captures the essence of the original stone in a format designed for modern living. It brings together artisanal character and everyday practicality, offering a surface that feels both elevated and easy to live with.

A delicate crystalline lattice pattern runs through each piece, introducing gentle movement and texture. Set against warm, creamy tones, the linear design adds a sense of rhythm, drawing the eye and creating a quietly confident statement within a space.

Thoughtfully designed for layering, these tiles work beautifully alongside the Linen & Four Seasons colourways, where pattern and plain can be combined to build depth and contrast. For a more seamless material story, they can also be paired with the natural version of this quartzite, crafted from slab in our bespoke workshop, allowing for a harmonious flow across surfaces.

Suitable for interior walls, and with no sealing required, these tiles offer a considered balance of design and durability, bringing warmth, texture and a touch of quiet drama to any setting.

bodyHtml:

These tiles feature a matt finish that beautifully replicates the tactile quality of handmade pottery. The rectangular format offers endless design possibilities, allowing for creative expression through vertical, horizontal, or unique pattern installations.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for internal use, bringing a touch of Italian artistry to bathrooms, kitchens, and splashbacks. Their practical design ensures they can be seamlessly integrated into a variety of settings.

Whether adorning a kitchen wall or enhancing a bathroom floor, these tiles offer a timeless appeal that complements both traditional and contemporary interiors. Their understated elegance makes them a versatile choice for any design vision.

With Earthenware Porcelain Red Clay tiles, you can enjoy the beauty of Italian-inspired design, thoughtfully crafted for modern living. Their blend of style and practicality ensures they remain a cherished element in your home.

name: Byzantine Porcelain Palmette Sculpted
bodyHtml:
Byzantine Porcelain Palmette Sculpted tiles capture the essence of ancient Greek mosaic art, presenting a harmonious blend of geometric, floral, and modern motifs. These tiles are crafted in a porcelain format that beautifully replicates the intricate allure of marble mosaics.

Featuring a tactile 3D finish, these tiles bring depth and dimension to any space, mimicking the appearance of grout joints between individual mosaic pieces. Their satin finish adds a subtle sheen, enhancing their refined character.

Made from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use across various spaces. With an R10 slip rating, they provide a practical choice for areas like bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways, offering both style and safety.

These versatile tiles can be applied to both walls and floors, making them well-suited for creating feature walls or adding interest to shower and wet rooms. Their green and white palette adds a fresh and timeless touch to any setting.

Byzantine Porcelain Palmette Sculpted tiles offer a thoughtful balance of design and functionality, bringing an artisanal touch to modern interiors without the need for sealing.

name: Silk Screen Ceramic Willow Cottage Tobacco
bodyHtml:

The satin finish and warm brown tones of Willow Cottage Tobacco create a refined backdrop, reminiscent of Victorian patterns. These tiles offer a tactile experience that adds depth and character to your space.

Made from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited to feature walls in bathrooms, showers, and wet rooms. Their handcrafted nature means each tile is unique, with some misprints contributing to their charm.

These tiles are a thoughtful choice for those seeking to infuse a space with warmth and personality. Their patterned design complements both contemporary and traditional interiors, offering versatility in styling.

Please note, due to their artisanal nature, variations and misprints are to be expected, enhancing the handmade effect. These tiles do not require sealing, ensuring ease of maintenance.

name: Plastercraft Calco Porcelain Cipria Textured
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the rough plastering techniques of the 1970s, Plastercraft Calco Porcelain Cipria Textured tiles offer a nod to mid-century design with a modern twist. Their textured surface adds a tactile dimension that captures the essence of the era while remaining thoroughly contemporary.

These rectangular tiles, crafted from durable porcelain, showcase a Cipria hue that infuses spaces with a warm, understated elegance. The stone effect finish enhances their visual depth, creating a feature wall that is both expressive and refined.

Designed for versatility, these tiles are suitable for both internal and external applications, making them an excellent choice for bathrooms, kitchens, and even outdoor spaces. The textured finish offers a subtle grip, enhancing their practicality without compromising on style.

Whether used in a shower, wet room, or as a splashback, Plastercraft Calco tiles bring a sense of crafted artistry to any setting. Their ability to transform a wall into a focal point is matched by their functional resilience.

With no need for sealing, these tiles provide a low-maintenance solution that balances aesthetic appeal with everyday practicality. Embrace the charm of mid-century design with the enduring quality of modern materials.

name: Stone Glaze Ceramic Linen Gloss Brick
bodyHtml:
The Stone Glaze Ceramic Linen Gloss Brick tiles are a testament to the beauty of traditional craftsmanship. These tiles, with their hand-applied glaze, capture the subtle nuances and vibrant tones that make this ancient ceramic technique so enduring.

Each tile offers natural variations in size and colour, inviting you to create spaces that are as unique as they are captivating. The gloss finish enhances the rich linen hue, adding a touch of elegance to any wall.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks. While sealing is not required, we recommend using a pre-grout barrier to prevent grout residue from affecting the glaze, especially with dark or contrasting grout colours.

Imagine these tiles gracing the walls of a serene bathroom or a vibrant kitchen splashback, where their characterful presence can truly shine. Their rustic charm complements both modern and traditional settings, offering a versatile choice for varied design schemes.

Stone Glaze Ceramic Linen Gloss Brick tiles bring together design and practicality, offering a timeless option for those who appreciate the artistry of handcrafted ceramics.

name: Silk Screen Ceramic Willow Cottage Teal
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from beloved wallpaper designs, the Silk Screen Ceramic Willow Cottage Teal tiles are a testament to traditional craftsmanship. These tiles are created using the silk screen process, resulting in a collection that exudes both vibrancy and a natural feel.

With a satin finish and a Victorian-inspired pattern, these ceramic tiles offer a refined touch to any space. Their rectangular shape complements the intricate design, making them a distinctive choice for those seeking character and depth.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for indoor use, making them well-suited to bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and feature walls. The satin finish enhances their tactile quality, adding a subtle sheen that catches the eye.

Perfect for creating a statement, these tiles bring a sense of artisanal charm to your interiors. Their bold yet natural appearance allows them to stand out while harmonizing with various design schemes.

Please note, due to their handcrafted nature, some misprints are to be expected and are part of the unique handmade effect. These tiles do not require sealing, ensuring ease of maintenance and enduring appeal.

name: Victorian Style™ Porcelain Frame
bodyHtml:
Evoking the grandeur of the Victorian era, the Victorian Style™ Porcelain Frame tiles bring a touch of historical elegance to modern spaces. Their bold patterns capture the essence of traditional mosaic floors, offering a timeless appeal.

Crafted in a prescored format, these porcelain tiles are designed for ease of installation, allowing you to achieve intricate designs without the complexity. The matt finish enhances their classic charm while maintaining a contemporary edge.

Constructed from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, making them a versatile choice for various settings. With a medium slip risk, they are best kept clean to preserve their slip resistance and are not recommended for pool surrounds.

Ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, hallways, and patios, these tiles add character and depth to any environment. Their black Grand Finchley Grid colourway complements a range of design schemes, from traditional to contemporary.

Please note, to prevent grout stains on the tile surface, we recommend using the Sarsen Home Porcelain Pre-Grout Barrier. These tiles do not require sealing, ensuring a low-maintenance yet stylish solution for your space.

name: Aventuras Malla Blue Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Designed by the talented Zoe Glencross, Aventuras Malla Blue Porcelain tiles are a vivid celebration of pattern and colour. Drawing inspiration from traditional Portuguese tiles, these pieces embrace the maximalist trend with their intricate motifs and striking designs.

The Malla Blue tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their rich blue hue, offering a subtle yet captivating surface. Their square shape and patterned style make them a versatile choice for both modern and traditional interiors, allowing for creative expression in any setting.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, including bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios. Their anti-slip properties, rated PTV+36 when wet, ensure safety in wet areas, making them a practical choice for showers and wet rooms.

Whether you're looking to create a bold statement floor or a feature wall, Aventuras Malla Blue tiles can be paired with coordinating borders and corner pieces for a cohesive look. Their versatility allows for endless design possibilities, inviting you to explore your creative side.

With a focus on both aesthetic appeal and functionality, these tiles offer a harmonious blend of design and practicality, making them a refined addition to any space.

bodyHtml:

The tumbled and etched finish of these flagstones offers a textured yet smooth surface, complemented by soft, rounded edges that invite a touch of refinement to any outdoor setting.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), these stones are a testament to quality and style, suitable for both modern and traditional landscapes.

To avoid efflorescence, it is recommended to store these stones in a dry area and use a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive.

name: Stone Glaze Ceramic Menthol Gloss Brick
bodyHtml:

Crafted from traditional stoneware, these tiles are adorned with a thick, hand-applied glaze that captures the essence of ancient ceramic techniques. The Stone Glaze tiles' versatility allows them to complement both modern and traditional settings, making them a thoughtful choice for those seeking a blend of contemporary style and rustic charm. Their brick shape adds a timeless appeal, ensuring they remain a cherished feature in your home.

With their expressive design and practical suitability, Stone Glaze Ceramic Menthol Gloss Brick tiles offer a refined balance of aesthetics and functionality. Their enduring appeal ensures they will be a captivating element in any interior space.

name: Kimmeridge Limestone Etched Bullnose Coping
bodyHtml:
The Kimmeridge Limestone Etched Bullnose Coping captures the essence of refined design with its unique etching process. This treatment subtly bleaches the underlying grey tones of Corfe limestone, creating a distinctive appearance that sets it apart from other finishes.

Designed with both form and function in mind, the etched surface provides an excellent grip, making it well-suited for wet and exterior environments. Its tactile quality also lends itself beautifully to contemporary interiors, offering a seamless blend of style and practicality.

Crafted from durable limestone, this coping is intended for both internal and external applications, including kitchens, swimming pools, and patios. Its suitability for diverse settings is further endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), highlighting its versatility and quality.

To maintain its pristine condition, it is important to store this product in a dry area. The use of rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive, is recommended to minimize the risk of efflorescence.

With its etched finish and thoughtful design, the Kimmeridge Limestone Etched Bullnose Coping is a considered choice for those seeking both aesthetic appeal and reliable performance in their design projects.

The 60 x Random x 2.0cm format enhances the natural rhythm of the stone underfoot, lending itself effortlessly to relaxed kitchen floors and welcoming living spaces. The tumbled finish brings a mellow softness while retaining the strength and integrity expected of limestone.

Suitable for internal floors and compatible with underfloor heating, Lacock Limestone Tumbled requires sealing to protect and preserve its beauty. With the right care, these stones will settle gracefully into their surroundings, growing richer with time and use.

name: Blandford Limestone Rustic Honed Finish
bodyHtml:

An elegantly honed surface enhances the stone’s natural softness, allowing subtle movement and tonal variation to come through once installed. This particular batch displays more clouding than is typically expected for this product, creating a floor with greater visual depth and a more organic, character led appearance.

Well suited to interior floors, these limestones feel at home in spaces where a relaxed, understated finish is key, from kitchens and living areas to hallways that benefit from natural warmth and texture.

As a natural limestone, sealing is required. This helps protect the surface while allowing the stone to age gracefully, ensuring its distinctive character continues to develop over time.

The Artisan Aged finish imparts a gentle, time-worn appearance, adding character without sacrificing sophistication. These tiles are designed to create a seamless flow of understated luxury within your interior spaces.

Crafted from high-quality limestone, these tiles are intended for indoor use, offering a durable yet elegant solution for your flooring needs. Please note that sealing is required to maintain their pristine condition.

Marlborough Terracotta Diamond tiles are perfect for adding a warm, earthy touch to bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways. Their natural finish and unique shape make them a striking choice for both walls and floors.

Oasis Veloute tiles are well suited to spaces where a touch of traditional charm meets modern design. Whether used as a splashback or to create a feature wall, they bring a subtle sophistication to any setting.

With their blend of historical inspiration and contemporary design, these tiles offer a thoughtful balance of aesthetic appeal and practical functionality, ensuring they remain a cherished part of your home for years to come.

name: Flanders Charcoal Tumbled Clay Pavers
bodyHtml:
Embrace the timeless appeal of Flanders Charcoal Tumbled Clay Pavers, a product that brings European craftsmanship to your spaces. With their traditional design, these pavers offer a sense of history and durability, making them a refined choice for both indoor and outdoor environments.

The tumbled finish of these clay pavers adds a touch of rustic charm, creating a surface that's both tactile and visually engaging. Their charcoal hue provides a versatile foundation, complementing a variety of design schemes with understated elegance.

Crafted for resilience, these pavers are suitable for use in a range of settings, from swimming pools to patios, offering a practical solution that doesn't compromise on style. Their endorsement by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS) further attests to their quality and suitability for garden pathways and zoning.

Whether you're paving a garden path or creating a seamless transition from indoor to outdoor living spaces, Flanders Charcoal Pavers lend a sense of cohesion and character. Their ability to withstand the elements makes them an enduring choice for any project.

With no sealing required, these pavers are as easy to maintain as they are to admire, ensuring that their beauty and practicality are enjoyed for years to come.

With their thoughtful design and practical durability, Marlborough Terracotta Octagons & Cabochons balance aesthetics and functionality, creating spaces that are both inviting and enduring.

name: Victorian Style™ Porcelain Cotton White Field
bodyHtml:
Echoing the elegance of the Victorian era, the Victorian Style™ Porcelain Cotton White Field tiles bring a touch of historical charm to modern spaces. Their design captures the intricate beauty of traditional mosaic patterns, offering a timeless aesthetic in a practical format.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their classic appeal. The prescored design simplifies installation, allowing you to achieve a sophisticated look with ease. Their cotton white hue adds a soft, inviting touch to any room.

These tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications, making them a versatile choice for kitchens, bathrooms, hallways, and patios. With an R10 slip rating, they provide a medium level of slip resistance, though care should be taken to keep them clean, especially in wet areas.

For best results, we recommend using our Sarsen Home Porcelain Pre-Grout Barrier to prevent grout stains on the tile surface. This precaution ensures the tiles maintain their pristine appearance over time.

Whether adorning a bathroom floor or a kitchen backsplash, the Victorian Style™ Porcelain Cotton White Field tiles offer a refined balance of style and practicality, enhancing spaces with their understated elegance.

name: Tapestry Porcelain Paving Textured Arabic
bodyHtml:
Pattern, reimagined for the outdoors. Tapestry Porcelain Paving Textured Arabic brings a sense of artistry underfoot, where soft, muted tones meet a gently timeworn, vintage effect. The result is a surface that feels both considered and quietly expressive, adding depth and character to terraces and garden spaces alike.

Crafted in durable porcelain with a grippy R11 textured finish, these tiles are designed to handle the rhythm of outdoor living while maintaining their refined appearance. They sit beautifully within the landscape, offering a balance of practicality and decorative charm.

For those looking to shape their space with intention, these tiles lend themselves perfectly to zoned designs. Think of them as an outdoor rug, anchoring seating or dining areas with pattern and personality, while the surrounding space remains calm and complementary.

Pattern, reimagined for the outdoors. Tapestry Porcelain Paving Textured Geometric introduces a more structured rhythm, where softened lines and muted tones come together in a beautifully faded, vintage-inspired design. It is a look that feels both graphic and gentle, bringing a quiet sense of order to open-air spaces.

Made from durable porcelain and finished with a grippy R11 texture, these tiles are designed to perform as well as they impress. Built for life outside, they offer reassurance underfoot while retaining their refined, decorative appeal through the seasons.

Perfect for defining areas within the garden, these tiles work effortlessly as a patterned ‘rug’. Use them to frame a dining set or seating area, creating moments of focus and personality, while the rest of the space flows calmly around them.
