name: Galway Limestone Seasoned Bullnose Coping
bodyHtml:
Embodying a rustic charm, the Galway Limestone Seasoned Bullnose Coping offers a robust solution for both indoor and outdoor settings. Its seasoned finish and grey hue make it a versatile choice for those seeking a touch of traditional elegance.

Crafted from durable limestone, these pieces are designed to withstand the elements, making them suitable for a variety of applications, from chic country kitchens to serene al fresco dining areas. The bullnose edge adds a refined touch, enhancing the tactile experience.

Well-suited for use around swimming pools and patios, these copings offer a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor spaces. Their inherent strength and seasoned surface ensure they are as practical as they are aesthetically pleasing.

While they require sealing to maintain their beauty and longevity, this simple step ensures that the Galway Limestone copings retain their character and resilience over time. Their ability to complement both traditional and rustic styles makes them a timeless addition to any project.

Whether enhancing a poolside retreat or framing a garden path, the Galway Limestone Seasoned Bullnose Coping combines design and durability, offering a thoughtful solution for your architectural needs.

name: Oasis Veloute Ceramic Cotto Matt
bodyHtml:
Oasis Veloute Ceramic Cotto Matt tiles draw inspiration from the time-honoured tradition of Moroccan Bejmat tiles, reimagining their charm for contemporary spaces. These tiles capture the essence of artisanal craftsmanship with a nod to history, offering a modern twist on a classic design.

The dappled, textured surface of these tiles evokes the tactile quality of traditional Bejmat, enhanced by a soft pastel colour palette that adds a gentle warmth to any setting. Their brick shape and matt finish contribute to a subtle yet expressive look, perfect for creating a feature wall with depth and character.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an excellent choice for bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks. Their matt finish offers a refined, understated elegance that complements a variety of interior styles, from modern to traditional.

Envision these tiles gracing the walls of a serene bathroom or a stylish shower room, where their Zellige effect brings a touch of the exotic to everyday spaces. The Cotto hue provides a warm, inviting backdrop that pairs beautifully with both muted and vibrant accents.

Oasis Veloute Ceramic Cotto Matt tiles merge design and practicality, offering a timeless appeal that enhances the ambiance of any room. With no sealing required, they promise ease of maintenance and enduring style.

name: Stone Glaze Ceramic Chalkstone Matt Square
bodyHtml:
Stone Glaze Ceramic Chalkstone Matt Square tiles draw inspiration from the ancient art of ceramic craftsmanship. Each tile is a testament to traditional stoneware techniques, enriched by a thick, hand-applied glaze that brings out the subtle nuances and variegated tones inherent in this classic method.

These tiles embrace natural variations in size and colour, inviting a sense of organic imperfection that adds character and depth to any interior. The matt finish enhances their tactile quality, making them a refined choice for those who appreciate understated elegance.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, specifically on walls. They are well suited to bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks, where their unique glaze can be fully appreciated. While sealing is not required, the application of a pre-grout barrier is recommended to prevent grout residue from affecting the glaze, particularly when using darker grout shades.

Imagine these tiles gracing the walls of a bathroom or shower, where their characterful presence can transform the space into a haven of calm sophistication. Their neutral chalkstone hue complements a range of interior styles, from modern to traditional.

With Stone Glaze Ceramic Chalkstone Matt Square tiles, you can create spaces that are both timeless and intriguing, where design and practicality meet in perfect harmony.

name: Enso Cobble Mosaic Cube Sand
bodyHtml:
Our Enso Mosaics are irresistibly tactile, with softly undulating surfaces designed to be experienced as much by touch as by sight. Crafted from tumbled limestone, they carry a gentle, time-worn quality that feels instinctively calm and considered.

Named after the Zen Buddhist concept of Ensō, a symbol of wholeness found within imperfection, these mosaics embrace organic irregularity. Their surfaces echo the look of crystal-clear streams flowing over pebbles, each piece subtly rounded, each edge softened, each detail becoming more characterful with time.

When lit thoughtfully, Enso Mosaics reveal their true depth. Light dances across the curves, casting dappled shadows and drawing out an organic texture that shifts throughout the day.

Suitable for interior walls and floors as well as exterior walls, they bring quiet movement and natural elegance to bathrooms, kitchens and living spaces alike. As a natural limestone product, sealing is required to protect and preserve their beauty. Variations in tone, texture and size are to be expected and celebrated, adding to the unique charm of every installation.

name: Fontenay Porcelain Pleated
bodyHtml:
Fontenay Porcelain Pleated tiles present an understated elegance with their creamy off-white tone, creating a serene backdrop for any interior space. Their subtle colour palette is complemented by a refined design that speaks to both modern and classic sensibilities.

The hallmark of these tiles is their gently pleated surface, which adds depth and visual interest without overwhelming the senses. This textured finish is enhanced by a gloss that captures and reflects light, bringing a dynamic quality to walls.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them a practical choice for kitchens, bathrooms, and feature walls. Their stone effect finish offers the look of natural materials with the ease of maintenance that porcelain provides.

Whether used as a splashback in the kitchen or as a feature wall in a bathroom, these tiles offer versatility and style. Their modern appeal is matched by their timeless quality, ensuring they remain a cherished element of your design scheme.

Fontenay Porcelain Pleated tiles are a refined choice for those seeking a balance of texture and simplicity, providing a sophisticated yet understated addition to any room.

Crafted from porcelain, these tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their tactile appeal. The square shape and intricate design details come together to form a visually captivating surface that feels both modern and timeless.

Designed for internal use, Indirah Porcelain Cotto tiles are well-suited for walls and floors. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they offer practical performance in areas like bathrooms, showers, and wet rooms.

These tiles are equally at home in contemporary settings or more traditional schemes, making them a versatile choice for various applications. Their warm tones and patterning can complement a range of interior styles, adding depth and character.

Indirah Porcelain Cotto tiles are a refined choice for those seeking to blend design with practicality, offering both aesthetic appeal and functional benefits. Their enduring charm makes them a thoughtful addition to any design project.

These tiles invite you to explore creative possibilities in your interior design, whether you're aiming for a modern aesthetic or a more rustic charm. Pair them with contrasting grout to highlight their distinctive edges and enhance their visual impact.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications, including bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios. Their PTV+36 slip rating when wet ensures safety underfoot, making them a practical choice for areas prone to moisture.

Imagine these tiles gracing a shower room floor or forming a striking kitchen backsplash. Their ability to blend seamlessly into both modern and traditional schemes makes them an ideal choice for those looking to infuse character into their spaces.

Embrace the art of design with Aventuras Blue Field Porcelain tiles, where elegance meets practicality, offering a refined yet expressive touch to your home.

name: Tunstall Ceramic Fluted Brick Deep White
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless elegance of the Victorian era, Tunstall Ceramic Fluted Brick Deep White tiles capture the essence of traditional British ceramics. Their design pays homage to the rich puddle glaze effect, a hallmark of the period, bringing a touch of historical charm to modern interiors.

These tiles feature a distinctive fluted brick format, offering a glossy finish that enhances their deep white hue. The fluted surface adds texture and depth, creating a play of light and shadow that brings walls to life. Once installed, they evoke a sense of understated sophistication, perfect for those who appreciate classic design.

Crafted from high-quality ceramic, Tunstall tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for bathroom and splashback applications. Their glossy finish not only adds a touch of elegance but also ensures easy maintenance, making them a practical choice for busy spaces.

Whether used to create a feature wall or as part of a larger design scheme, these tiles lend themselves to a variety of styles. Their deep white colour and fluted texture complement both contemporary and traditional settings, allowing for creative expression in any space.

With a nod to the past and an eye on the present, Tunstall Ceramic Fluted Brick Deep White tiles offer a refined balance of design and functionality, inviting you to explore the beauty of classic ceramic craftsmanship.

name: Stone Glaze Ceramic Mink Gloss Brick
bodyHtml:
Stone Glaze Ceramic Mink Gloss Brick tiles are a testament to the beauty of traditional craftsmanship. Each tile is meticulously handcrafted, combining traditional stoneware with a thick, hand-applied glaze. This process captures the subtle nuances and vibrant, variegated tones that are emblematic of ancient ceramic techniques.

These tiles exhibit natural variations in size and colour, inviting you to embrace their inherent imperfections. The result is an organic and characterful surface that sparks curiosity and admiration, making them a distinctive choice for any interior.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, perfect for adding a touch of elegance to bathroom walls, showers, and splashbacks. The glossy finish enhances their rich mink hue, creating a reflective surface that adds depth and interest to your space.

While not essential, we recommend applying a pre-grout barrier to prevent grout residue from affecting the glaze, especially when using dark or contrasting grout colours. This simple step ensures the tiles maintain their pristine appearance.

Stone Glaze Ceramic Mink Gloss Brick tiles offer a refined yet expressive option for those seeking to create interiors with a sense of history and craftsmanship. Their timeless appeal and unique character make them a cherished addition to any design scheme.

name: Enso Cobble Mosaic Strip Chalk
bodyHtml:
Our Enso Mosaics are irresistibly tactile, with softly undulating surfaces designed to be experienced as much by touch as by sight. Crafted from tumbled limestone, they carry a gentle, time-worn quality that feels instinctively calm and considered.

Named after the Zen Buddhist concept of Ensō, a symbol of wholeness found within imperfection, these mosaics embrace organic irregularity. Their surfaces echo the look of crystal-clear streams flowing over pebbles, each piece subtly rounded, each edge softened, each detail becoming more characterful with time.

When lit thoughtfully, Enso Mosaics reveal their true depth. Light dances across the curves, casting dappled shadows and drawing out an organic texture that shifts throughout the day.

Suitable for interior walls and floors as well as exterior walls, they bring quiet movement and natural elegance to bathrooms, kitchens and living spaces alike. As a natural limestone product, sealing is required to protect and preserve their beauty. Variations in tone, texture and size are to be expected and celebrated, adding to the unique charm of every installation.

name: Tapestry Porcelain Paving Textured Geometric
bodyHtml:
Pattern, reimagined for the outdoors. Tapestry Porcelain Paving Textured Geometric brings a sense of artistry underfoot, where soft, muted tones meet a gently timeworn, vintage effect. The result is a surface that feels both considered and quietly expressive, adding depth and character to terraces and garden spaces alike.

Crafted in durable porcelain with a grippy R11 textured finish, these tiles are designed to handle the rhythm of outdoor living while maintaining their refined appearance. They sit beautifully within the landscape, offering a balance of practicality and decorative charm.

For those looking to shape their space with intention, these tiles lend themselves perfectly to zoned designs. Think of them as an outdoor rug, anchoring seating or dining areas with pattern and personality, while the surrounding space remains calm and complementary.

Pattern, reimagined for the outdoors. Tapestry Porcelain Paving Textured Geometric introduces a more structured rhythm, where softened lines and muted tones come together in a beautifully faded, vintage-inspired design. It is a look that feels both graphic and gentle, bringing a quiet sense of order to open-air spaces.

Made from durable porcelain and finished with a grippy R11 texture, these tiles are designed to perform as well as they impress. Built for life outside, they offer reassurance underfoot while retaining their refined, decorative appeal through the seasons.

Perfect for defining areas within the garden, these tiles work effortlessly as a patterned ‘rug’. Use them to frame a dining set or seating area, creating moments of focus and personality, while the rest of the space flows calmly around them.

name: Rialto Terrazzo San Michele Honed
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the rich heritage of Venice, the Rialto Terrazzo San Michele Honed tiles celebrate the timeless allure of terrazzo, a material first popularised during the Renaissance. These tiles embody a harmonious blend of history and modernity, with their subtle cream tones and honed finish.

Crafted from recycled and waste marble materials, these tiles not only exude elegance but also champion sustainability. Their honed surface offers a refined, smooth texture that enhances the intricate patterning, making them a sophisticated choice for contemporary and traditional spaces alike.

Designed for internal use, these tiles are well-suited for both wall and floor applications, particularly in bathrooms. With a slip rating of PTV 22 when wet, they provide a practical solution without compromising on style.

Whether adorning a bathroom or creating a statement floor, these tiles bring a touch of Venetian charm to any interior. Their understated pattern and creamy hue make them a versatile choice for various design schemes.

Please note, due to the technical characteristics of this material, we recommend using an S2 adhesive. Our Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive is not suitable for this product.

name: Lacock Limestone Heritage Finish Octagons & Hazlebury Cabochons
bodyHtml:
Echoing the timeless allure of Lacock Abbey's historic flooring, the Lacock Limestone Heritage Finish Octagons & Hazlebury Cabochons offer a journey into the past. These tiles capture the essence of centuries-old limestone, marked by the gentle wear of time.

The octagonal design paired with Hazlebury cabochons creates a distinctive pattern that adds character to any interior space. Their heritage finish reveals a tactile surface, reminiscent of stone that has gracefully aged over the years.

Crafted from limestone, these tiles are intended for internal use, making them ideal for floors in kitchens and hallways. The natural variation in each piece ensures a unique installation that speaks to the organic beauty of stone.

These tiles complement traditional and rustic styles, offering a versatile foundation for various design schemes. Their understated elegance allows them to blend seamlessly into both contemporary and classic settings.

With a nod to history and a commitment to quality, the Lacock Limestone tiles provide an accessible way to bring the charm of reclaimed stone into your home. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their beauty over time.

name: Menagerie Ceramic by Michael Angove
bodyHtml:
In an exclusive collaboration with British designer Michael Angove, the Menagerie Ceramic tiles bring a touch of artistic flair to your interiors. Their unique pattern and glossy finish create a captivating visual impact, making them an ideal choice for those seeking to infuse character into their spaces.

Designed with versatility in mind, these tiles can be laid in random formations to enhance the dynamic feel of a kitchen splashback or to add a statement behind a freestanding bath. The intricate patterns invite a sense of movement and depth, transforming walls into canvases of design.

Crafted from high-quality ceramic, these tiles are suited for internal use, offering a durable and stylish solution for splashbacks and feature walls. The gloss finish not only adds a touch of elegance but also ensures easy maintenance, making them a practical choice for busy areas.

Whether you're revamping a modern kitchen or adding a traditional touch to a bathroom, these patterned tiles seamlessly blend with various design styles. Their white colour palette provides a timeless backdrop, allowing the pattern to take centre stage.

Please note, these tiles are made to order in our studio, so do expect longer lead times. This bespoke approach ensures each tile meets our high standards of craftsmanship and design.

name: Savoy Novo Porcelain Matt Arch Mosaic
bodyHtml:
The Savoy Novo Porcelain Matt Arch Mosaic captures the timeless elegance of Italianate design. With its soft matt finish and striking wine-purple veining, these tiles echo the luxurious essence of Calacatta Viola marble, offering a refined aesthetic in an accessible porcelain format.

Featuring a creamy-white background, the Savoy Novo tiles are designed to harmonise beautifully with both metal and wood finishes. This thoughtful colour palette allows the tiles to stand out while remaining versatile enough to complement a variety of interior styles.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are well-suited for internal use, making them an ideal choice for bathrooms, showers, and wet rooms. The R9 slip rating ensures a practical balance of style and safety, particularly in spaces where moisture is a consideration.

Whether used on walls or floors, the mosaic pattern of Savoy Novo adds a layer of visual interest, creating a feature that is both subtle and sophisticated. These tiles invite creativity, offering a canvas for personal expression in any room they grace.

Embrace the union of design and function with Savoy Novo, where the enduring appeal of marble meets the practicality of porcelain, resulting in a product that is as beautiful as it is functional.

name: Bamboo Porcelain Mosaic Vintage White
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the natural elegance of bamboo, the Bamboo Porcelain Mosaic Vintage White tiles bring a touch of organic charm to interior spaces. Their stick-like form captures the essence of bamboo, creating a unique visual texture that is both serene and sophisticated.

These mosaics feature a gloss finish, enhanced by vibrant, aged metallic glazes that catch the light beautifully. The soft colour palette of Vintage White adds a gentle warmth, making them a versatile choice for various design styles, from modern to traditional.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for areas like bathrooms, showers, and wet rooms. Their glossy surface not only adds a touch of elegance but also reflects light, enhancing the sense of space in smaller rooms.

Whether used as a feature wall, splashback, or in a shower area, these mosaics offer endless design possibilities. Their subtle pattern and gentle sheen provide a refined backdrop that complements a variety of fixtures and fittings.

With their combination of style and practicality, the Bamboo Porcelain Mosaic Vintage White tiles are a thoughtful choice for those looking to add a touch of nature-inspired design to their home.

name: Oasis Veloute Ceramic Powder Blue Matt
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the time-honoured Moroccan Bejmat tiles, the Oasis Veloute Ceramic Powder Blue Matt tiles bring a touch of heritage into contemporary spaces. Their design reimagines the classic unglazed look with a modern twist, offering a serene pastel blue that evokes a sense of calm.

These tiles feature a dappled, textured surface that captures the essence of traditional craftsmanship, while their matt finish adds a layer of understated elegance. The brick shape further enhances their versatility, making them a fitting choice for both modern and traditional interiors.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, specifically on walls. They are particularly well-suited for bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks, where their subtle texture can be appreciated up close.

Incorporating these tiles into your design scheme can effortlessly elevate the aesthetic of a space, adding a touch of artisanal charm. Their powder blue hue pairs beautifully with both neutral and bold accents, offering endless styling possibilities.

With no sealing required, the Oasis Veloute tiles provide a practical yet stylish solution for those seeking to blend classic influences with contemporary design sensibilities.

Ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, and splashbacks, they offer versatility in application. Whether used in a shower room or as a kitchen splashback, these tiles provide a timeless backdrop.

With no sealing required, Fontenay Porcelain Metro tiles offer a practical yet stylish solution for modern interiors. Their quiet character and refined finish make them a lasting choice.

name: Aventuras Ochre Field Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Designed by the talented pattern designer Zoe Glencross, the Aventuras Ochre Field Porcelain tiles are a vibrant celebration of pattern and colour. Drawing inspiration from traditional Portuguese tiles, these tiles invite a sense of artistic expression into your space.

The Aventuras collection embraces maximalist design, offering a variety of intricate motifs and unique chequerboard patterns. The ochre hue adds warmth and character, while the matt finish ensures a refined aesthetic. Each tile is a canvas for creativity, allowing for endless combinations with coordinating borders and corners.

Crafted from porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, making them a versatile choice for any project. With a reassuring slip rating of PTV+36 when wet, they offer practicality without compromising on style.

Imagine these tiles gracing the floors of your kitchen, bathroom, or hallway, or creating a striking patio feature. Their timeless appeal complements both modern and traditional interiors, offering a seamless transition between spaces.

With Aventuras Ochre Field, you have the freedom to design a space that reflects your unique style, blending bold patterns with subtle elegance. These tiles are more than just a surface; they're an invitation to explore the art of design.

These tiles are well suited to spaces that embrace both modern and traditional styles, offering versatility in design applications. Their warm palette and detailed pattern make them a thoughtful addition to any interior.

With no sealing required, Indirah Porcelain Azure tiles offer a refined and low-maintenance option for those seeking to introduce a touch of cultural elegance to their home.

name: Kimmeridge Limestone Paving Etched Finish
bodyHtml:
With its etched finish, Kimmeridge Limestone Paving presents a refined aesthetic that is both modern and timeless. The etching process subtly bleaches the underlying grey tones, creating a clean and uniform appearance that sets it apart from other finishes.

This paving is crafted from durable limestone, making it an excellent choice for exterior spaces. The etched surface not only enhances its visual appeal but also provides a good grip, ideal for wet areas such as patios and swimming pools, especially in our rainy climate.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), this paving is a testament to quality and design excellence. It is well-suited for outdoor applications, where both aesthetics and functionality are paramount.

When using Kimmeridge Limestone Paving, it's important to note that it is prone to efflorescence. To minimize this, store the tiles in a dry area and use rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive.

For those seeking a paving solution that combines elegance with practicality, Kimmeridge Limestone offers a sophisticated choice that complements a variety of outdoor settings.

name: Stone Glaze Ceramic Olive Leaf Gloss Brick
bodyHtml:
Stone Glaze Ceramic Olive Leaf Gloss Brick tiles capture the essence of traditional craftsmanship with their thick, hand-applied glaze. These tiles exude a vibrant green hue, reminiscent of lush olive leaves, bringing a touch of nature into your space.

Each tile showcases subtle nuances and variegated tones, a hallmark of ancient ceramic techniques. The natural variations in size and colour invite a sense of organic imperfection, making every installation unique and full of character.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, perfect for adding a touch of elegance to bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and splashbacks. Their gloss finish enhances the rich colour, creating a reflective surface that plays with light.

While sealing is not required, we recommend using a pre-grout barrier to prevent grout residue from affecting the glaze, especially when using dark or contrasting grout. This simple step helps maintain the tiles' pristine appearance.

Embrace the beauty of imperfection with Stone Glaze tiles, where each piece tells a story of artisanal craftsmanship and thoughtful design, inviting admiration and curiosity in equal measure.

name: Versailles Marble Creme Honed
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the grandeur of French Baroque interiors, Versailles Creme brings a softer expression to this richly coloured collection. A beautifully balanced mid-cream marble, it is enlivened by occasional ochre veining and hazy patches of white. Its gentle warmth makes it wonderfully easy to live with, lending interiors a sense of softness and permanence without ever feeling overly polished or formal.

Ideal for indoor walls and floors, Creme is especially beautiful when used as the lighter note in a chequerboard, allowing the richer colours of the Versailles collection to take centre stage. Pair with other Versailles shades, or with Elixir and Taj Mahal, to create everything from classic chequerboards to more intricate, decorative patterns. For wet room floors and shower trays, additional anti-slip measures are required. Versailles marble requires sealing.

All Versailles marbles are honed to a smooth, dependable finish with a soft, understated sheen that allows the natural character of the stone to take centre stage. Each tile measures 45.7 × 45.7cm, a beautifully considered and wonderfully versatile format: substantial enough to give a floor presence, yet modest enough to sit comfortably within smaller spaces and more intricate patterns – a perfect middle ground.

Complementary slabs are also available for bespoke applications including showers, vanity units, step treads and worktops. Other tile formats can also be produced to order; please contact us to discuss any particular requirements you may have.

name: Folio Marble Honed Slab Extra
bodyHtml:
Folio in slab form is the same stone as our Folio Marble Honed Finish tiles, so floors, walls and bespoke pieces can all be cut from one marble. It is a bone marble, cream bone, with lighter bone highlights, calcite grey veining and fine gold spider veins running across some of the material. The honed finish gives it a soft, low sheen rather than a polish.

Slabs are held in 2cm and 3cm, and are used for worktops, vanity tops, shower trays, window sills, thresholds, step treads and fireplace surrounds. Our Projects Division handles the templating, fabrication, edge detailing and finishing, and will work with you on how the veining runs across a piece and where the joints fall.

Folio is quarried rather than manufactured, so every slab is different. Tone shifts from one to the next, the grey calcite runs heavier in some than others, and the gold veining appears in some more than others. That movement is what gives Folio its depth, and where a job takes more than one slab we will talk you through how they work together before anything is cut. A finished piece should be judged sealed and installed, not as a raw slab on a rack.

Folio is supplied unsealed and will need sealing to keep it looking its best. It is for internal use.

name: Aventuras Ziggy Corner Olive Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Designed by the talented pattern designer Zoe Glencross, the Aventuras collection is a vibrant tribute to the art of pattern and colour. Drawing inspiration from traditional Portuguese tiles, these designs embrace the current trend for maximalist interiors, offering a rich tapestry of intricate motifs and unique chequerboard options.

The Aventuras Ziggy Corner Olive Porcelain tiles stand out with their bold patterns and matt finish, creating a striking visual in any setting. Their square shape and olive hue bring a touch of modern elegance while paying homage to timeless design traditions.

Crafted from durable porcelain, these tiles are suitable for both internal and external use, making them a versatile choice for spaces like bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and even patios. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet, they offer practical safety without compromising on style.

Whether you're looking to create a statement floor in your kitchen or add a decorative touch to your patio, these tiles offer endless possibilities. Pair them with coordinating borders or mix them with other patterns from the collection to craft a bespoke design that reflects your personal style.

With the Aventuras collection, you can explore the art of pattern layering and design a space that's uniquely yours. These tiles effortlessly blend practicality with artistic expression, ensuring your interiors are both functional and visually captivating.

Ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, and feature walls, the Zahara Porcelain Arch Mosaic invites creativity in design. Pair them with complementary textures or use them as a standalone statement piece.

With their blend of practicality and style, these tiles offer a timeless solution for those seeking a modern yet natural look. They effortlessly combine beauty with function, making them a thoughtful addition to any interior.

name: Stone Glaze Ceramic Petal Gloss Brick
bodyHtml:
The Stone Glaze Ceramic Petal Gloss Brick tiles draw inspiration from ancient ceramic techniques, offering a handcrafted appeal that is both timeless and expressive. These tiles are crafted by expertly combining traditional stoneware with a thick, hand-applied glaze, resulting in a surface that captures subtle nuances and vibrant, variegated tones.

Each tile showcases natural variations in size and colour, embracing the beauty of imperfection. This organic character allows these tiles to create interiors that are both unique and full of personality, sparking curiosity and admiration in any setting.

Made from ceramic, these tiles are designed for indoor use, specifically suited for walls in bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and splashbacks. The glossy finish enhances their visual appeal, adding a touch of elegance to any space.

While sealing is not required, we recommend applying a pre-grout barrier to prevent grout residue from affecting the glaze, especially when using dark or contrasting grout colours. This ensures the tiles maintain their pristine appearance over time.

Stone Glaze Ceramic Petal Gloss Brick tiles offer a perfect blend of traditional craftsmanship and modern design, making them a refined choice for those looking to add character and warmth to their interiors.

name: Tunstall Ceramic Fluted Brick Coral
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless charm of the Victorian era, Tunstall Ceramic Fluted Brick Coral tiles bring a touch of historical elegance to modern interiors. Their design draws from the rich puddle glaze effect that was a hallmark of British ceramics, offering a nod to heritage while embracing contemporary style.

These tiles are crafted in a distinctive brick shape, with a fluted surface that adds depth and texture. The coral hue is both vibrant and warm, creating a striking visual impact that is further enhanced by a glossy finish. This combination of colour and texture ensures that they stand out, yet remain versatile enough to complement various design schemes.

Made from durable ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an excellent choice for bathroom walls and splashbacks. Their gloss finish not only enhances their aesthetic appeal but also makes them easy to clean and maintain, adding practicality to their list of attributes.

Incorporate these tiles into your space to create a dramatic and authentic interior. Whether used as a feature wall or a subtle backdrop, they offer endless possibilities for creative expression. Their Victorian roots make them equally suited to both traditional and contemporary settings.

Tunstall Ceramic Fluted Brick Coral tiles are a refined choice, balancing historical inspiration with modern practicality. Their enduring appeal lies in their ability to transform spaces with a quiet confidence and understated elegance.

Crafted from high-quality marble, these slabs are designed for internal use, offering versatility across both wall and floor applications. They are particularly well-suited to spaces like bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and hallways, where their natural beauty can be fully appreciated.

When considering styling, the Long Island Marble Honed Slab pairs beautifully with both modern and traditional design schemes. Its neutral palette and subtle pattern provide a perfect backdrop for a range of decorative elements.

While these slabs bring an air of sophistication to any space, it's important to note that they require sealing to maintain their pristine appearance. This ensures their enduring appeal, allowing the natural beauty of the marble to shine through.

name: Riverlands Scales Ceramic Watercress
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the serene hues of nature, the Riverlands Scales Ceramic Watercress tiles bring a sense of calm to any interior space. Their scallop shape echoes the gentle curves found in the natural world, creating a harmonious visual flow.

These tiles are crafted from ceramic and finished with a glossy sheen, enhancing the rich, watercress green colour. The distinctive scallop design offers a playful yet refined aesthetic, making them a versatile choice for various design styles.

Designed for indoor use, these tiles are perfect for adding character to bathrooms, splashbacks, and feature walls. It is important to note that in wet areas, these tiles may discolour, and they require sealing with a Crackle Glaze Protector to maintain their beauty.

The Riverlands Scales tiles invite creativity in their application, whether used to create a striking feature wall or as a subtle accent in a more understated scheme. Their unique shape and colour allow for endless design possibilities.

With their blend of artistry and practicality, these tiles offer a thoughtful choice for those looking to infuse their space with a touch of elegance and nature-inspired charm.

The grey sandstone, with its natural finish, exudes a rustic charm that enhances its traditional appeal. Each piece tells its own story, contributing to a unique and characterful surface when laid in a random rectangular pattern.

Crafted from durable sandstone, these flagstones are suitable for both internal and external applications, making them a versatile choice for patios and other floor spaces. Their natural texture provides a tactile experience underfoot, adding depth and interest to any environment.

These stones are particularly well-suited to projects that aim to preserve or replicate historical aesthetics. Their reclaimed nature ensures that each piece is unique, offering a bespoke element to your design.

Endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), these flagstones are not only a testament to enduring design but also to quality and authenticity. They seamlessly blend practicality with a timeless aesthetic, making them a thoughtful addition to any space.

name: Versailles Marble Ecru Honed
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the grandeur of French Baroque interiors, Versailles Ecru celebrates the quieter beauty of natural marble. Spangled heavily with fine veins of light tan, Ecru is a creamy-brown marble with an extraordinary sense of natural movement. Its surface has a wonderfully organic quality, with layer upon layer of subtle variation that rewards a closer look. Neither too light nor too dark, Ecru is an exceptionally versatile mid-tone, lending itself beautifully to both restrained schemes and more decorative compositions.

Ideal for indoor walls and floors, Ecru makes a beautiful foundation for a three-colour Versailles pattern, or a softer counterpoint to the richer tones within the collection. It can also be combined with Elixir and Taj Mahal to create chequerboards and more intricate arrangements. For wet room floors and shower trays, additional anti-slip measures are required. Versailles marble requires sealing.

All Versailles marbles are honed to a smooth, dependable finish with a soft, understated sheen that allows the natural character of the stone to take centre stage. Each tile measures 45.7 × 45.7cm, a beautifully considered and wonderfully versatile format: substantial enough to give a floor presence, yet modest enough to sit comfortably within smaller spaces and more intricate patterns – a perfect middle ground.

Other tile formats can also be produced to order; please contact us to discuss any particular requirements you may have.

name: Aventuras Ziggy Corner Terracotta Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Designed by pattern designer Zoe Glencross, the Aventuras Ziggy Corner Terracotta Porcelain tiles are a vibrant tribute to traditional Portuguese tile artistry. This collection embraces the spirit of maximalism, offering a rich tapestry of patterns and colours that invite creativity and personal expression.

These tiles feature intricate motifs and unique chequerboard options, complemented by coordinating border and corner pieces. The Ziggy Corner design adds a playful yet refined touch, allowing for endless combinations that can transform any space into a work of art.

Crafted from durable porcelain with a matt finish, these tiles are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. They offer a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet, ensuring safety in areas like bathrooms, kitchens, and even patios.

Whether adorning a bathroom, kitchen, hallway, or patio, the Aventuras collection provides a versatile canvas for your design vision. Pair these tiles with other patterns from the collection or let them stand alone as a statement piece.

With the Aventuras Ziggy Corner Terracotta Porcelain tiles, you can create a space that is both functional and visually captivating, embodying a perfect blend of tradition and modernity.

Whether you’re looking to complement traditional interiors or bring a touch of vintage charm to a modern setting, these tiles offer a versatile solution. The hand-painted effect and rich colour palette make them an ideal choice for creating a distinctive border.

name: Stone Glaze Ceramic Lemongrass Gloss Brick
bodyHtml:
Stone Glaze Ceramic Lemongrass Gloss Brick tiles bring a touch of artisanal charm to your interiors. These handcrafted tiles combine traditional stoneware with a thick, hand-applied glaze, capturing the essence of an ancient ceramic technique.

The tiles showcase a vibrant, variegated palette of lemongrass tones, each piece offering unique natural variations in size and colour. This inherent irregularity invites the creation of organic, characterful spaces that are both intriguing and inviting.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them a refined choice for bathroom walls, shower areas, and splashbacks. Their glossy finish adds a touch of elegance, enhancing the play of light across their surface.

While sealing is not required, we recommend applying a pre-grout barrier to prevent grout residue from affecting the glaze, particularly when using dark or contrasting grout colours. This precaution helps maintain the tiles' pristine appearance over time.

Stone Glaze tiles are a testament to the beauty of imperfection, offering a timeless appeal that complements both modern and traditional settings. Their handcrafted nature ensures each installation is as unique as the space it adorns.

name: Sloane Porcelain Honed White
bodyHtml:
Sloane Porcelain represents the height of contemporary porcelain technology, carefully developed to replicate the refined beauty of our honed Sloane limestone with remarkable accuracy.

Designed for internal use, it captures the subtle complexity of natural stone, from delicate veining to fine fossil markings, delivering a surface that is strikingly close to the original once installed.

Available in two classic tones—soft white and warm cream—Sloane is stocked in elegant 60x60cm and 90x90cm formats, lending itself to composed, high-end interiors with a distinctly restrained, traditional British sensibility. Its understated palette and finely detailed surface make it particularly well suited to period properties, where authenticity of material and tone is essential.

The finish replicates a genuinely honed limestone surface, with a soft, natural sheen that enhances the depth of the design without appearing glossy or artificial. The result is a tile that balances technical precision with the quiet irregularity of natural stone, preserving the character and nuance of the original material.

For projects requiring additional variation, Sloane can also be specified in alternative formats and finishes, including a textured surface for enhanced underfoot grip, an exterior paving option, and a bush-hammered finish that introduces subtle tactile texture while maintaining tonal consistency.

Refined, versatile, and exceptionally realistic, Sloane Porcelain offers the timeless appeal of natural limestone with the durability and consistency of advanced porcelain engineering.

name: Stone Glaze Ceramic Chambray Gloss Brick
bodyHtml:
Stone Glaze Ceramic Chambray Gloss Brick tiles are a celebration of traditional craftsmanship, merging the timeless appeal of stoneware with a rich, hand-applied glaze. These tiles capture the essence of ancient ceramic techniques, offering a canvas of subtle nuances and vibrant, variegated tones.

Each tile is unique, with natural variations in size and colour that invite you to embrace their inherent imperfections. This organic character adds depth and intrigue, making them a captivating choice for those who appreciate the beauty of handcrafted materials.

Made from durable ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, perfect for creating striking feature walls in bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks. Their glossy finish enhances the chambray hue, adding a touch of elegance to any space.

While sealing is not required, we recommend applying a pre-grout barrier to prevent grout residue from affecting the glaze, especially when using dark or contrasting grout colours. This extra step ensures the tiles maintain their pristine appearance.

Stone Glaze tiles offer a harmonious blend of artistry and practicality, making them a versatile addition to both modern and traditional interiors. Their characterful presence is sure to inspire and delight.

name: Versailles Marble Marron Honed
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the grandeur of French Baroque interiors, Versailles Marron brings depth, warmth and a sense of drama to the collection. Rich, deep and wonderfully expressive, Marron is a sumptuous brown marble scattered with fine cream and tan veining. Its depth of colour gives it real presence, while the naturally spangled surface keeps it feeling organic and full of movement. Brown marble has an enduring elegance that never quite goes out of fashion, and Marron captures that quality beautifully.

Used alone, Marron creates a warm and atmospheric interior; paired with Brun, Ecru or Creme, it forms the basis of a wonderfully timeless chequerboard. Combine with the wider Versailles collection, or with Elixir and Taj Mahal, to create more elaborate patterns and compositions. Suitable for indoor walls and floors, with additional anti-slip measures required for wet room floors and shower trays. Versailles marble requires sealing.

All Versailles marbles are honed to a smooth, dependable finish with a soft, understated sheen that allows the natural character of the stone to take centre stage. Each tile measures 45.7 × 45.7cm, a beautifully considered and wonderfully versatile format: substantial enough to give a floor presence, yet modest enough to sit comfortably within smaller spaces and more intricate patterns – a perfect middle ground.

Complementary slabs are also available for bespoke applications including showers, vanity units, step treads and worktops. Other tile formats can also be produced to order; please contact us to discuss any particular requirements you may have.

All Versailles marbles are honed to a smooth, dependable finish with a soft, understated sheen that allows the natural character of the stone to take centre stage. Each tile measures 45.7 × 45.7cm, a beautifully considered and wonderfully versatile format: substantial enough to give a floor presence, yet modest enough to sit comfortably within smaller spaces and more intricate patterns – a perfect middle ground.

Complementary slabs are also available for bespoke applications including showers, vanity units, step treads and worktops. Other tile formats can also be produced to order; please contact us to discuss any particular requirements you may have.

name: Enso Cobble Mosaic Sand & Chalk Chess
bodyHtml:
Our Enso Mosaics are irresistibly tactile, with softly undulating surfaces designed to be experienced as much by touch as by sight. Crafted from tumbled limestone, they carry a gentle, time-worn quality that feels instinctively calm and considered.

Named after the Zen Buddhist concept of Ensō, a symbol of wholeness found within imperfection, these mosaics embrace organic irregularity. Their surfaces echo the look of crystal-clear streams flowing over pebbles, each piece subtly rounded, each edge softened, each detail becoming more characterful with time.

When lit thoughtfully, Enso Mosaics reveal their true depth. Light dances across the curves, casting dappled shadows and drawing out an organic texture that shifts throughout the day.

Suitable for interior walls and floors as well as exterior walls, they bring quiet movement and natural elegance to bathrooms, kitchens and living spaces alike. As a natural limestone product, sealing is required to protect and preserve their beauty. Variations in tone, texture and size are to be expected and celebrated, adding to the unique charm of every installation.

name: STUDIO Bobbin Ceramic Holly
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the graceful contours of a 3D bobbin, the STUDIO Bobbin Ceramic Holly tiles bring a touch of British craftsmanship to any space. Their softly scalloped borders echo the undulating profile of their muse, creating a subtle yet captivating detail.

Finished in a glossy holly green, these tiles exude a refined elegance. Each piece is crafted in Stoke-on-Trent, a city renowned for its ceramic heritage, ensuring a product that is both beautiful and enduring.

Made from quality ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an ideal choice for bathroom walls, splashbacks, and feature walls. The glossy finish adds a touch of sophistication, enhancing the light and space in any room.

Whether used in a traditional or rustic setting, these tiles offer a versatile design solution. Their understated charm allows them to complement a variety of interior styles, bringing a timeless appeal to your home.

Please note: these tiles are specially made to order and typically have a lead time of 5-6 weeks. For orders over 5m², please confirm lead times with us prior to ordering. As they are custom-made, they are non-returnable.

name: Plastercraft Calco Porcelain Sabbia Textured
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the rough plastering style of the 1970s, Plastercraft Calco Porcelain Sabbia Textured tiles bring a touch of mid-century chic to modern spaces. Their design echoes the artisanal craftsmanship of the past, offering a unique visual texture that adds character to any setting.

These tiles are crafted from porcelain, providing a robust and durable surface that can be used both indoors and outdoors. The textured finish captures light beautifully, creating subtle shifts in tone that enhance the overall aesthetic.

With their creamy Sabbia hue, these tiles are well-suited for a variety of applications, from feature walls to splashbacks. Their stone effect design lends an organic touch, making them a versatile choice for both contemporary and traditional interiors.

Ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, and even shower and wet room areas, these tiles offer a practical solution without compromising on style. Their ability to be used in both internal and external environments further extends their versatility.

Plastercraft Calco Porcelain Sabbia Textured tiles are a refined choice for those seeking to introduce a textured feature wall with enduring appeal. Their understated elegance and practical benefits make them a thoughtful addition to any design scheme.

name: Victorian Style™ Wall Ceramic Decor Carnation Border Rose
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless elegance of Victorian design, the Victorian Style™ Wall Ceramic Decor Carnation Border Rose brings a touch of historical charm to your interiors. Its delicate carnation motif, a beloved symbol of the era, is beautifully captured in a hand-painted effect that exudes artisanal craftsmanship.

These ceramic tiles, finished with a gloss sheen, are crafted in a classic brick shape. The rose hue adds warmth and character, making them a refined choice for creating feature walls that draw the eye and invite admiration.

Designed for internal use, these tiles are well suited to bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks, where their decorative appeal can truly shine. Their glossy finish enhances the light in a room, creating a sense of space and openness.

Pair these tiles with the broader Victorian Wall collection for a cohesive look that nods to the past while fitting seamlessly into contemporary settings. The subtle interplay of colour and pattern offers endless styling possibilities.

Please note, this product has a lead time of six weeks from order, ensuring each piece is prepared with the utmost care and attention to detail.

bodyHtml:

These tiles, finished in a rich Cabbage Green Gloss, exude a subtle yet striking presence. The gloss finish enhances their intricate pattern, reflecting light to create a dynamic visual effect that shifts with your perspective.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited to enhancing the walls of bathrooms, showers, and splashbacks. Their durability and resistance to moisture make them a practical choice for spaces where style meets function.

Whether adorning a classic bathroom or adding a touch of heritage to a modern setting, these tiles offer a versatile application. Their traditional roots are balanced by a contemporary finish, allowing them to harmonize with a variety of interior styles.

The Victorian Style™ Wall Ceramic tiles in Cabbage Green Gloss are a refined choice for those seeking to infuse their spaces with character and history, while benefiting from the practical advantages of modern ceramic craftsmanship.

name: Versailles Marble Rouge Honed
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the grandeur of French Baroque interiors, Versailles Rouge is a collection of richly coloured marbles chosen for their expressive natural beauty. Versailles Rouge is a wonderfully distinctive marble in a soft terracotta-red, alive with irregular veins of chalky white and smoky grey, scattered naturally across its surface. Its gentle red tone gives this statement stone a surprising versatility, bringing warmth and character without overwhelming a scheme. Pair with dark timber, rich browns and creamy neutrals, or lean into its Mediterranean character with terracotta tones.

Ideal for indoor walls and floors, Rouge makes a particularly striking choice for larger areas where its expressive veining can be appreciated. For wet room floors and shower trays, additional anti-slip measures are required. Combine with other Versailles colours, or with our Elixir and Taj Mahal ranges, to create elegant chequerboards and more elaborate patterns. Versailles marble requires sealing.

All Versailles marbles are honed to a smooth, dependable finish with a soft, understated sheen that allows the natural character of the stone to take centre stage. Each tile measures 45.7 × 45.7cm, a beautifully considered and wonderfully versatile format: substantial enough to give a floor presence, yet modest enough to sit comfortably within smaller spaces and more intricate patterns – a perfect middle ground.

Complementary slabs are also available for bespoke applications including showers, vanity units, step treads and worktops. Other tile formats can also be produced to order; please contact us to discuss any particular requirements you may have.

name: Hazlebury Limestone Tumbled & Etched
bodyHtml:
Hazlebury Limestone Tumbled & Etched brings together gentle ageing and practical performance in one beautifully balanced stone. The soft grey tones feel calm and composed, while the tumbled edges lend a relaxed, timeworn character that sits effortlessly in both classic and contemporary spaces.

The etched finish enhances grip and subtly lightens the overall appearance, allowing the natural variation of the limestone to shine through. Fine fossil markings and delicate shifts in tone move across the surface, giving each installation depth and quiet individuality.

Cut to a generous 60 x 60cm format with a 2.0cm thickness, these stones create a confident, considered layout underfoot. Ideal for bathrooms, wet rooms, kitchens, hallways and patios, they transition seamlessly from inside to out, offering continuity throughout the home.

Suitable for internal and external floors and compatible with underfloor heating, Hazlebury Limestone Tumbled & Etched requires sealing to protect and preserve its character. With the right care, these limestones will weather beautifully, growing softer and richer over time.

name: Silk Screen Ceramic Lantau Bamboo Chocolate
bodyHtml:
Inspired by beloved wallpaper designs, the Silk Screen Ceramic Lantau Bamboo Chocolate tiles bring an artisanal charm to interiors. Crafted using the traditional silk screen process, they offer a rich, tactile experience.

These rectangular tiles, finished with a satin sheen, showcase a pattern that evokes a sense of Victorian elegance. The warm chocolate tones lend a natural yet striking presence to any space.

Made from ceramic, these tiles are designed for indoor use, making them well-suited for bathrooms, showers, and feature walls. Their handmade nature means each tile carries unique variations, adding to their character.

Ideal for creating a statement, these tiles can transform a simple wall into a focal point. Whether used in a bathroom or a wet room, they bring a touch of crafted sophistication.

Please note that due to their artisanal production, some misprints are to be expected, enhancing the handmade effect. No sealing is required, ensuring ease of maintenance.

name: Rural Ceramic Buttermilk
bodyHtml:
A beautifully understated ceramic wall tile in a soft, warming cream, Rural Buttermilk brings timeless character and handcrafted charm to traditional interiors. Its gently undulating surface and irregular edges create a beautifully tactile finish, allowing light to softly play across each tile and reveal its subtle variations.

A true warm neutral, this versatile shade is perfect for creating calm, inviting spaces — from classic farmhouse kitchens and Shaker-style cabinetry to cosy boot rooms and characterful bathrooms. We use this tile as the base tile for our Sanderson Studio collection, and Rural Buttermilk provides a beautifully considered base for pairing with Sanderson’s expressive patterns and heritage designs.

For a more decorative look, combine with Rural Shell to create a soft, tonal chequerboard effect that feels both timeless and effortlessly elegant.

Suitable for internal walls only.

name: Enso Cobble Mosaic Cube Charcoal
bodyHtml:
Our Enso Mosaics are irresistibly tactile, with softly undulating surfaces designed to be experienced as much by touch as by sight. Crafted from tumbled limestone, they carry a gentle, time-worn quality that feels instinctively calm and considered.

Named after the Zen Buddhist concept of Ensō, a symbol of wholeness found within imperfection, these mosaics embrace organic irregularity. Their surfaces echo the look of crystal-clear streams flowing over pebbles, each piece subtly rounded, each edge softened, each detail becoming more characterful with time.

When lit thoughtfully, Enso Mosaics reveal their true depth. Light dances across the curves, casting dappled shadows and drawing out an organic texture that shifts throughout the day.

Suitable for interior walls and floors as well as exterior walls, they bring quiet movement and natural elegance to bathrooms, kitchens and living spaces alike. As a natural limestone product, sealing is required to protect and preserve their beauty. Variations in tone, texture and size are to be expected and celebrated, adding to the unique charm of every installation.

name: Sloane Porcelain Honed Cream
bodyHtml:
Sloane Porcelain represents the height of contemporary porcelain technology, carefully developed to replicate the refined beauty of our honed Sloane limestone with remarkable accuracy.

Designed for internal use, it captures the subtle complexity of natural stone, from delicate veining to fine fossil markings, delivering a surface that is strikingly close to the original once installed.

Available in two classic tones—soft white and warm cream—Sloane is stocked in elegant 60x60cm and 90x90cm formats, lending itself to composed, high-end interiors with a distinctly restrained, traditional British sensibility. Its understated palette and finely detailed surface make it particularly well suited to period properties, where authenticity of material and tone is essential.

The finish replicates a genuinely honed limestone surface, with a soft, natural sheen that enhances the depth of the design without appearing glossy or artificial. The result is a tile that balances technical precision with the quiet irregularity of natural stone, preserving the character and nuance of the original material.

For projects requiring additional variation, Sloane can also be specified in alternative formats and finishes, including a textured surface for enhanced underfoot grip, an exterior paving option, and a bush-hammered finish that introduces subtle tactile texture while maintaining tonal consistency.

Refined, versatile, and exceptionally realistic, Sloane Porcelain offers the timeless appeal of natural limestone with the durability and consistency of advanced porcelain engineering.

name: Versailles Marble Noir Honed
bodyHtml:
Drawing inspiration from the grandeur of French Baroque interiors, Versailles Noir offers a more dramatic interpretation of classic marble. A beautifully deep charcoal marble, it is softened by scattered white veining and delicate tonal movement within its dark ground. The effect is sophisticated rather than stark, giving Noir an atmospheric quality that works equally well in traditional and contemporary interiors. Laid across a floor, its natural variation adds depth and intrigue; used in a chequerboard, it brings a more nuanced alternative to classic black and white.

Suitable for indoor walls and floors, Noir is a particularly elegant choice for creating dramatic, enveloping spaces. For wet room floors and shower trays, additional anti-slip measures are required. Combine with the Versailles collection, or with Elixir and Taj Mahal, for chequerboards and more intricate patterns. Versailles marble requires sealing.

All Versailles marbles are honed to a smooth, dependable finish with a soft, understated sheen that allows the natural character of the stone to take centre stage. Each tile measures 45.7 × 45.7cm, a beautifully considered and wonderfully versatile format: substantial enough to give a floor presence, yet modest enough to sit comfortably within smaller spaces and more intricate patterns – a perfect middle ground.

Complementary slabs are also available for bespoke applications including showers, vanity units, step treads and worktops. Other tile formats can also be produced to order; please contact us to discuss any particular requirements you may have.

name: Aventuras Malla Terracotta Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Designed by pattern designer Zoe Glencross, the Aventuras Malla Terracotta Porcelain tiles are a vibrant celebration of pattern and colour. Drawing inspiration from traditional Portuguese tiles, these tiles embrace a maximalist approach, ideal for those who appreciate intricate motifs and bold design.

The Aventuras collection offers a captivating mix of designs, including unique chequerboard patterns and coordinating border and corner pieces. These tiles invite you to become your own designer, allowing endless combinations with the intricate Ziggy border or more restrained options, depending on your style preference.

Crafted from porcelain, these tiles feature a matt finish that enhances their tactile appeal. With a slip rating of PTV+36 when wet and R10, they are suitable for both internal and external applications, offering versatility across various spaces.

Well suited to bathrooms, kitchens, hallways, and patios, the Aventuras Malla Terracotta tiles add character and depth to any setting. Their adaptability makes them a perfect choice for creating a cohesive look throughout your home.

Whether you choose to layer patterns or keep it simple, these tiles promise a blend of design and practicality, ensuring your space remains both stylish and functional.

name: Matravers Sandstone Sawn Bullnosed Coping
bodyHtml:
The Matravers Sandstone Sawn Bullnosed Coping brings an understated elegance to outdoor spaces. Its fine-grained texture and speckled grey hues create a canvas that is both refined and characterful.

This European sandstone is celebrated for its subtle tonal variations, which add depth and interest to any exterior setting. The bullnosed edge provides a smooth, rounded finish, enhancing its tactile appeal.

Crafted from natural sandstone, this coping is designed for external use, making it a suitable choice for patios and swimming pool surrounds. It is endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), reflecting its quality and enduring appeal.

While these copings are well-suited to modern and rustic styles, their versatility allows them to complement a range of design schemes. They require sealing to maintain their natural beauty and durability over time.

With its thoughtful design and practical attributes, the Matravers Sandstone Sawn Bullnosed Coping offers a harmonious blend of form and function, bringing a touch of sophistication to outdoor environments.

name: Calacatta Oceana Fantasy Leathered & Aged
bodyHtml:
Calacatta Oceana Fantasy Leathered & Aged is a marble that speaks in contrasts. A crisp, milk white backdrop sets the stage for green gold veining that moves with quiet drama across the surface, creating a look that feels both classic and unexpectedly rich.

The leathered and aged finish softens the marble’s natural luminosity, introducing a gentle texture and a timeworn elegance underfoot. There is depth here, character too, the kind that brings warmth to expansive floors and refinement to statement walls.

Cut to a generous 61 x 61 x 2cm format, these tiles lend a sense of balance and proportion to interior spaces. While the delicate veining suggests delicacy, marble is wonderfully strong and enduring, making it a material that pairs beauty with lasting performance.

Suitable for interior walls and floors, this marble requires sealing to protect and preserve its surface. As with all natural stone, variation in tone and veining is to be expected, each tile entirely unique, adding to the ageless impact of the finished scheme.

This outlet edition features a different finish to our standard Calacatta Oceana Fantasy, offering the same striking palette in a more tactile, characterful expression.

name: STUDIO Nonna's Kitchen Floreale Ceramic
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless elegance of traditional Italian kitchens, the STUDIO Nonna's Kitchen Floreale Ceramic tiles bring a touch of Mediterranean warmth to your interiors. These tiles capture the essence of classic Italiana with their bright pops of colour and intricate detailing.

Crafted in a square format with a glossy finish, they offer a playful yet refined aesthetic. The Floreale design stands out with its vibrant green hues, creating a lively yet sophisticated atmosphere.

Made from durable ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an excellent choice for bathroom walls, splashbacks, and feature walls. Their gloss finish adds a layer of depth and light reflection, enhancing any space they adorn.

Whether you're revamping a shower area or creating a statement feature wall, these tiles are well-suited to a variety of applications. Their traditional yet versatile design complements both rustic and classic interiors.

name: Sanderson - Robin's Wood Madder Mural Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Created in collaboration with Sanderson, a heritage British design house with over 165 years of history, this collection translates iconic textile and wallpaper motifs into beautifully crafted porcelain tiles. The result is a richly layered range that brings timeless pattern and colour into new spatial contexts, from kitchens and bathrooms to considered outdoor settings.

The collection celebrates the signature Sanderson aesthetic—botanical forms, flowing patterns, and classic English decoration—reimagined across a versatile porcelain format. Designs range from expressive tile murals and vibrant colour accents to softer, more intricate repeats, all unified by a carefully balanced palette of reds, greens, ochres, and blues.

Alongside the decorative pieces, a considered selection of plain tiles allows for more structured layouts, including elegant chequerboard schemes or quieter, complementary backdrops. Organic hexagon blends introduce a more contemporary, design-led feel, offering further scope for creative expression.

Made for both internal and domestic external use, these tiles combine visual richness with durability. With an R10 and PTV +36 slip rating, they are suitable for floors and walls across a variety of environments, delivering both aesthetic impact and everyday practicality. Bringing together heritage design and modern performance, the Sanderson collection allows classic patterns to evolve—extending their presence beyond soft furnishings into architectural surfaces.

name: Galway Limestone Cobble Seasoned Finish
bodyHtml:
Galway Limestone Cobble, with its seasoned finish, brings a touch of rustic charm to any environment. Its robust nature and textured surface evoke the timeless appeal of traditional cobblestones, making it a distinguished choice for those seeking authenticity.

These cobbles, shaped from durable limestone, present a grey hue that complements a variety of design schemes. The seasoned finish enhances their natural texture, offering an inviting surface that feels both organic and crafted.

Suitable for both internal and external applications, Galway Limestone Cobble is versatile enough to grace a country kitchen or provide a sturdy foundation for al fresco dining areas. Their strength and durability ensure they withstand the demands of various settings.

These cobbles are well-suited to traditional and rustic styles, seamlessly integrating into spaces that celebrate heritage and character. Their presence lends a sense of history and permanence, inviting a connection to the past.

While their aesthetic speaks of time-honoured elegance, it's important to note that sealing is required to maintain their beauty and resilience. Galway Limestone Cobble offers a harmonious blend of design and practicality, making it a refined choice for discerning spaces.

Crafted from ceramic with a glossy finish, these square tiles exhibit a handmade style that adds depth and character to any wall. The chequered twist in their pattern offers a playful yet refined aesthetic, making them a captivating choice for feature walls.

Designed for indoor use, these tiles are well-suited to bathrooms, splashbacks, and shower walls. With no sealing required, they offer both beauty and practicality, ensuring your spaces remain effortlessly stylish.

name: Enso Cobble Mosaic Strip Charcoal
bodyHtml:
Our Enso Mosaics are irresistibly tactile, with softly undulating surfaces designed to be experienced as much by touch as by sight. Crafted from tumbled limestone, they carry a gentle, time-worn quality that feels instinctively calm and considered.

Named after the Zen Buddhist concept of Ensō, a symbol of wholeness found within imperfection, these mosaics embrace organic irregularity. Their surfaces echo the look of crystal-clear streams flowing over pebbles, each piece subtly rounded, each edge softened, each detail becoming more characterful with time.

When lit thoughtfully, Enso Mosaics reveal their true depth. Light dances across the curves, casting dappled shadows and drawing out an organic texture that shifts throughout the day.

Suitable for interior walls and floors as well as exterior walls, they bring quiet movement and natural elegance to bathrooms, kitchens and living spaces alike. As a natural limestone product, sealing is required to protect and preserve their beauty. Variations in tone, texture and size are to be expected and celebrated, adding to the unique charm of every installation.

name: Elixir Marble Oud Rose Honed
bodyHtml:
Elixir Marble Oud Rose Honed tiles invite you into a world of captivating colour and natural beauty. With their peachy-pink hues, these tiles offer a unique blend of soft cream and vibrant coral, bringing a sense of warmth and character to any space.

Crafted from marble, their honed finish adds a refined touch, while the square shape provides a classic canvas for creative expression. The natural variation in each tile ensures that no two installations are the same, making them a truly distinctive choice for your home.

Designed for internal use, these tiles are well suited to both wall and floor applications. They are perfect for areas like bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways, where their expressive nature can truly shine. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their beauty over time.

Pair these tiles with the Cashmere or Versailles collection to create striking chequerboard designs that are both bold and timeless. Their versatility allows them to fit seamlessly into both modern and traditional settings, offering endless possibilities for style and design.

Elixir Marble Oud Rose Honed tiles are a testament to the power of natural materials, combining elegance with practicality. They promise to be a cherished feature in your home, adding depth and interest wherever they are laid.

name: Sanderson - Plain Dove Blue Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Created in collaboration with Sanderson, a heritage British design house with over 165 years of history, this collection translates iconic textile and wallpaper motifs into beautifully crafted porcelain tiles. The result is a richly layered range that brings timeless pattern and colour into new spatial contexts, from kitchens and bathrooms to considered outdoor settings.

The collection celebrates the signature Sanderson aesthetic—botanical forms, flowing patterns, and classic English decoration—reimagined across a versatile porcelain format. Designs range from expressive tile murals and vibrant colour accents to softer, more intricate repeats, all unified by a carefully balanced palette of reds, greens, ochres, and blues.

Alongside the decorative pieces, a considered selection of plain tiles allows for more structured layouts, including elegant chequerboard schemes or quieter, complementary backdrops. Organic hexagon blends introduce a more contemporary, design-led feel, offering further scope for creative expression.

Made for both internal and domestic external use, these tiles combine visual richness with durability. With an R10 and PTV +36 slip rating, they are suitable for floors and walls across a variety of environments, delivering both aesthetic impact and everyday practicality. Bringing together heritage design and modern performance, the Sanderson collection allows classic patterns to evolve—extending their presence beyond soft furnishings into architectural surfaces.

name: Sanderson - Plain Ochre Porcelain
bodyHtml:
Created in collaboration with Sanderson, a heritage British design house with over 165 years of history, this collection translates iconic textile and wallpaper motifs into beautifully crafted porcelain tiles. The result is a richly layered range that brings timeless pattern and colour into new spatial contexts, from kitchens and bathrooms to considered outdoor settings.

The collection celebrates the signature Sanderson aesthetic—botanical forms, flowing patterns, and classic English decoration—reimagined across a versatile porcelain format. Designs range from expressive tile murals and vibrant colour accents to softer, more intricate repeats, all unified by a carefully balanced palette of reds, greens, ochres, and blues.

Alongside the decorative pieces, a considered selection of plain tiles allows for more structured layouts, including elegant chequerboard schemes or quieter, complementary backdrops. Organic hexagon blends introduce a more contemporary, design-led feel, offering further scope for creative expression.

Made for both internal and domestic external use, these tiles combine visual richness with durability. With an R10 and PTV +36 slip rating, they are suitable for floors and walls across a variety of environments, delivering both aesthetic impact and everyday practicality. Bringing together heritage design and modern performance, the Sanderson collection allows classic patterns to evolve—extending their presence beyond soft furnishings into architectural surfaces.

name: Kimmeridge Limestone Honed Slab
bodyHtml:
The Kimmeridge Limestone Slab captures the essence of the rugged Dorset coast with its deep, moody hues of grey and charcoal. Infused with natural fossils, these slabs echo the timeless beauty of the Isle of Purbeck’s renowned limestone formations.

Crafted with a honed finish, these slabs present a tactile surface that invites touch and interaction. The subtle variations in tone and texture create a dynamic visual experience, enhancing the character of any space they inhabit.

Made from durable limestone, these slabs are designed for both internal and external applications. They are well-suited to areas such as bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and hallways, offering both aesthetic appeal and practical performance.

With their versatile grey palette, these slabs complement a range of styles, from modern to traditional. They provide a refined backdrop that allows other design elements to shine, while still holding their own distinctive presence.

Please note that sealing is required to maintain the natural beauty and longevity of the Kimmeridge Limestone Slab. This ensures that the slabs continue to perform and captivate in any setting.

The result is a richly layered range that brings timeless pattern and colour into new spatial contexts, from kitchens and bathrooms to considered outdoor settings.

The collection celebrates the signature Sanderson aesthetic—botanical forms, flowing patterns, and classic English decoration—reimagined across a versatile porcelain format. Designs range from expressive tile murals and vibrant colour accents to softer, more intricate repeats, all unified by a carefully balanced palette of reds, greens, ochres, and blues.

Alongside the decorative pieces, a considered selection of plain tiles allows for more structured layouts, including elegant chequerboard schemes or quieter, complementary backdrops. Organic hexagon blends introduce a more contemporary, design-led feel, offering further scope for creative expression.

Made for both internal and domestic external use, these tiles combine visual richness with durability. With an R10 and PTV +36 slip rating, they are suitable for floors and walls across a variety of environments, delivering both aesthetic impact and everyday practicality. Bringing together heritage design and modern performance, the Sanderson collection allows classic patterns to evolve—extending their presence beyond soft furnishings into architectural surfaces.

name: STUDIO Minaret Green Dot Ceramic
bodyHtml:
Infuse your space with a touch of Moroccan charm through the STUDIO Minaret Green Dot Ceramic tiles. These tiles, with their distinctive arabesque stepped arches, offer a bold yet soft style that captures the essence of traditional craftsmanship.

The Minaret tiles feature a glossy finish that enhances their vibrant green hue, creating a striking visual effect on walls. Their handmade undulating surface adds a tactile quality, inviting a closer look and touch.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited for bathrooms, splashbacks, feature walls, and shower or wet room walls. Their gloss finish further elevates the aesthetic, reflecting light beautifully across surfaces.

These tiles seamlessly integrate into both contemporary and traditional interiors, offering a versatile option for various design schemes. Their characterful design makes them an ideal choice for creating standout borders or accent features.

Please note, the STUDIO Minaret Green Dot Ceramic tiles are specially made to order and are non-returnable. Typically, there is a 5-6 week lead time from order. For orders exceeding 5m², please confirm lead times with us prior to placing your order.
