name: Vienne Limestone Tumbled
bodyHtml:
Bring timeless elegance into your space with Vienne Limestone Tumbled tiles, a beautifully natural stone defined by its soft tonal variation and gently aged finish. Featuring a harmonious palette of warm creams, subtle greys, and delicate fossil markings, this limestone offers a characterful yet understated foundation for both classic and contemporary interiors.

The tumbled finish lends each tile a softly worn appearance, with rounded edges and a textured surface that enhances its rustic charm. This process creates a relaxed, lived-in aesthetic, perfect for spaces that embrace natural materials and effortless style.

Crafted from durable limestone, Vienne is suitable for a variety of applications including kitchens, hallways, and living areas. Its robust composition ensures it can withstand the demands of everyday life while maintaining its timeless appeal.

Ideal for pairing with wood, natural fabrics, and neutral colour palettes, these tiles create a cohesive and inviting environment. Whether used across large open-plan spaces or smaller rooms, Vienne Limestone Tumbled provides a versatile and enduring backdrop.

bodyHtml:

These ceramic tiles feature a hand-painted effect that softens the bold geometric design, while the rustic base adds a touch of artisanal charm. The gloss finish enhances their lively character, reflecting light and adding depth to walls.

Crafted from ceramic, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them an excellent choice for bathrooms, splashbacks, and feature walls. Their traditional style and vibrant pattern make them a standout choice for those looking to infuse a space with personality.

Well suited to shower and wet room walls, these tiles bring a sense of warmth and playfulness to any setting. The pink star motif is both decorative and functional, adding a layer of interest without overwhelming the space.

Please note, these tiles are specially made to order and are non-returnable. Typical lead time is 5-6 weeks from order, and for quantities over 5m², we recommend checking lead times with us before placing your order.

name: Hazlebury Limestone Weathered Finish
bodyHtml:
Hazlebury Weathered offers a softer take on one of our most popular limestones. This particular batch was ordered in error in a bespoke format and finish, resulting in a finish that feels gently worn rather than heavily aged, while still holding onto the warmth and depth that define Hazlebury.

The weathered edge treatment is subtly restrained when compared with our Seasoned finish, giving the stone a calmer outline and a slightly more understated presence. Across the surface, rich, dark tones move naturally through the limestone, creating a sense of continuity and quiet character once installed.

Designed for interior floors, Hazlebury Weathered brings an inviting, grounded feel to kitchens, hallways and living spaces where natural materials set the tone. It balances refinement with a relaxed sensibility, making it easy to live with and visually rewarding over time.

This outlet product is available due to being ordered in error and is defined by its unique format and finish. As with all natural limestone, sealing is required to protect the surface and support long term performance, allowing the stone’s warmth and character to be enjoyed for years to come.

name: Hampledon Buff York Sandstone Riven
bodyHtml:
Quarried in the heart of Yorkshire, Hampledon Buff York Sandstone Riven is a testament to time-honoured craftsmanship. These flagstones, available in a warm buff hue, are meticulously hand-worked by skilled stonemasons to achieve their distinctive riven finish.

The process involves splitting roughly hewn blocks of stone to reveal a naturally textured surface. This technique not only highlights the stone's inherent beauty but also enhances its practical qualities, offering high anti-slip properties ideal for outdoor use.

Crafted from durable sandstone, these tiles are well-suited for external applications such as patios and swimming pool surrounds. The natural undulations and pitting in the surface create a tactile experience that is both rustic and refined.

Each order of Hampledon Buff York Sandstone Riven is produced individually, ensuring a bespoke approach to your project. Please be aware that lead times may vary depending on quarry conditions, so we recommend contacting our team for further details.

This paving product is proudly endorsed by the Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), further attesting to its quality and suitability for enhancing outdoor spaces.

name: STUDIO Sanderson - Anaar Ochre
bodyHtml:
Our Sanderson STUDIO collection offers a more artisanal interpretation of the brand's design legacy, bringing archive patterns into a handcrafted ceramic format. Made to order in the UK, this collection reflects a slower, more traditional approach to tilemaking, where character and detail are central to the finished piece.

Drawing directly from the Sanderson wallpaper archive, the designs include classic delft-inspired motifs, structured patterns with coordinating borders and corners, and a range of decorative compositions that feel both nostalgic and enduring. Each design is thoughtfully scaled and arranged to suit interior wall applications, allowing for complete, cohesive schemes.

The tiles themselves feature a rustic, handmade aesthetic, with a gently undulating surface and a soft ivory base that adds warmth and depth beneath the glossy glaze. This subtle irregularity enhances the authenticity of the designs, giving each installation a crafted, individual feel.

Intended for interior walls, Sanderson STUDIO is particularly suited to spaces where detail and atmosphere matter-kitchens, bathrooms, and feature areas that benefit from a more decorative, heritage-led approach. Combining archival design with traditional production methods, the STUDIO collection captures the essence of classic English interiors in a refined ceramic form..

name: STUDIO Sanderson - Oxbow Check Pottery Blue Pattern
bodyHtml:
Our Sanderson STUDIO collection offers a more artisanal interpretation of the brand's design legacy, bringing archive patterns into a handcrafted ceramic format. Made to order in the UK, this collection reflects a slower, more traditional approach to tilemaking, where character and detail are central to the finished piece.

Drawing directly from the Sanderson wallpaper archive, the designs include classic delft-inspired motifs, structured patterns with coordinating borders and corners, and a range of decorative compositions that feel both nostalgic and enduring. Each design is thoughtfully scaled and arranged to suit interior wall applications, allowing for complete, cohesive schemes.

The tiles themselves feature a rustic, handmade aesthetic, with a gently undulating surface and a soft ivory base that adds warmth and depth beneath the glossy glaze. This subtle irregularity enhances the authenticity of the designs, giving each installation a crafted, individual feel.

Intended for interior walls, Sanderson STUDIO is particularly suited to spaces where detail and atmosphere matter-kitchens, bathrooms, and feature areas that benefit from a more decorative, heritage-led approach. Combining archival design with traditional production methods, the STUDIO collection captures the essence of classic English interiors in a refined ceramic form..

name: STUDIO Étoile Brown Star Ceramic
bodyHtml:
Studio Étoile Brown Star Ceramic tiles bring a touch of whimsy to any space with their tessellating pattern of diamonds and stars. The design strikes a balance between playful and elegant, creating a distinctive visual effect that draws the eye.

Crafted from ceramic with a gloss finish, these tiles offer a refined surface that enhances their intricate pattern. The brown star motif adds warmth and character, making them a unique choice for those looking to introduce a touch of artistry to their interiors.

Designed for indoor use, these tiles are well suited for feature walls, splashbacks, and bathroom settings. Their ceramic composition ensures durability and ease of maintenance, making them a practical choice for everyday living.

Envision these tiles gracing the walls of your bathroom or creating a statement splashback in your kitchen. Their traditional yet rustic style complements a variety of design schemes, offering versatility without compromising on character.

Please note, Studio Étoile Brown Star Ceramic tiles are specially made to order and are non-returnable. Typically, there is a 5-6 week lead time from order. For orders over 5m², please confirm lead times with us prior to purchasing.

name: Verde Guatemala Marble Slab
bodyHtml:
Verde Guatemala Marble Slab is a striking choice, with its cool mint tones bringing a refreshing elegance to any space. This marble's unique character is both timeless and versatile, making it a refined choice for those seeking a touch of sophistication.

The honed or polished finishes offer a tactile surface that enhances the natural beauty of the stone. Its subtle variations in colour and texture create a dynamic visual effect, whether used as a statement wall or a luxurious floor covering.

Crafted from high-quality marble, these slabs are designed for internal use, suitable for walls and floors in bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and hallways. The inherent strength and durability of marble ensure long-lasting performance.

Verde Guatemala's cool green hues complement both modern and traditional interiors, allowing for creative expression in design. Its presence in a room adds depth and interest without overpowering the overall aesthetic.

For those considering this marble, it is important to note that sealing is required to maintain its pristine appearance. This detail ensures that the slab remains as captivating as the day it was installed.

Designed for internal use, these marble slabs are well-suited for walls and floors in bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and hallways. Their honed and polished surfaces provide a refined touch, while the inherent strength of marble ensures durability.

Versailles Marron slabs lend themselves beautifully to a variety of design contexts, whether you're aiming for a traditional aesthetic or a more contemporary look. Pair them with complementary materials to create a cohesive and inviting environment.

With a need for sealing, these marble slabs promise to maintain their striking appearance over time. Their combination of visual appeal and practical functionality makes them a considered choice for those seeking to elevate their interior spaces.

name: Structured Decoupling Matting
bodyHtml:
The Structured Decoupling Matting is a versatile solution designed to enhance tile and natural stone installations. With its innovative polyethylene membrane, it features a grid structure of square cavities, each crafted in a dovetail configuration for secure anchoring.

This matting is well-suited for use over new subfloors, providing a stable foundation that accommodates movement and reduces the risk of cracking. The anchoring fleece laminated to its underside ensures a reliable bond to the substrate, making it an essential component for successful installations.

Particularly beneficial for projects involving underfloor heating, this matting allows for efficient heat distribution while maintaining the integrity of the tile or stone surface. Its internal use specification makes it ideal for wall and floor applications within residential and commercial spaces.

Whether you're working on a contemporary renovation or a traditional setting, the Structured Decoupling Matting offers a practical and dependable solution. Its thoughtful design supports a seamless installation process, enhancing both the performance and longevity of your chosen materials.

With a focus on functionality and durability, this matting is an invaluable addition to any tiling project, ensuring a professional finish that stands the test of time.

name: Sarsen Home Surface Sanitize & Clean
bodyHtml:
Introducing the Sarsen Home Surface Sanitize & Clean, a versatile solution for maintaining hygiene across a variety of surfaces within your home. This multi-surface cleaner is designed to effectively sanitize everything from door handles and kitchen worktops to computer screens and touch screens.

Crafted with a 75% alcohol ethanol formula, this cleaner ensures thorough disinfection, making it ideal for fabrics, upholstery, tile, and stone surfaces. Please note, it is not suitable for surfaces polished with natural or acrylic wax.

For optimal results, always test on an inconspicuous area first. When cleaning walls, worktops, taps, and door handles, simply spray and wipe with a microfiber cloth. For fabrics and upholstery, a fine spray and air drying are recommended.

When it comes to floors, spray the surface and spread evenly using a flat microfiber mop. Allow approximately five minutes for drying, and avoid walking on the wet solution during this time to ensure the best finish.

Tested to meet BS EN 1276 and BS EN 13697 standards, this cleaner provides reliable bactericidal and fungicidal activity, making it a trusted choice for maintaining a clean and healthy environment.

Embodying a sense of time-honoured tradition, the Marlborough Terracotta Hexagon tiles offer a classic yet contemporary aesthetic. Their hexagonal shape brings a modern twist to the enduring appeal of terracotta, creating a surface that feels both familiar and fresh.

Crafted with a handmade finish, these tiles present a tactile quality that enhances their rustic charm. The warm red tones of the terracotta infuse spaces with an inviting earthiness, making them a characterful addition to any interior.

Made from durable terracotta, these tiles are designed to withstand the demands of high-traffic areas. Their robust nature makes them particularly well-suited for kitchens, hallways, and bathrooms, where their hardwearing properties can be fully appreciated.

Perfect for both wall and floor applications, the Marlborough Terracotta Hexagon tiles lend themselves to a variety of design schemes. Their versatility allows them to complement both traditional and rustic settings, adding depth and warmth to any room.

These tiles require sealing to maintain their beauty and durability. With their blend of practicality and aesthetic appeal, they offer a timeless choice for those seeking to create a welcoming and enduring space.

Crafted from durable terracotta, these tiles are well-suited for high-traffic areas. They are designed for indoor use, making them an excellent choice for kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways where their hardwearing nature can truly shine.

With their rich red hue and authentic texture, Marlborough Terracotta Picket tiles complement both traditional and rustic interiors. Consider pairing them with natural wood elements or neutral tones for a harmonious look.

These tiles are not only a design statement but also a practical choice, offering both beauty and functionality. Their enduring appeal ensures they will remain a cherished feature in your home for years to come.

bodyHtml:

The honed finish of these marble tiles enhances their natural beauty, creating a smooth, tactile surface that feels as good as it looks. The interplay of colours and veining patterns adds depth and character, making each tile unique.

Consider using them to create a traditional marble bathroom or to introduce elegant drama with uniquely shaped mosaics. Their versatility allows for a range of styling possibilities, whether in modern or traditional settings.

Please note, these tiles have a microbevel edge and require sealing to maintain their pristine condition over time.

Whether used as a splashback or a feature wall, the Maroc Ceramic Aquamarine tiles effortlessly introduce a sense of elegance and character. They are well suited to spaces that appreciate a blend of traditional craftsmanship and contemporary design.

With their enduring appeal and expressive character, these tiles offer a sophisticated solution for those seeking to infuse their interiors with a touch of artisanal flair.

Whether used in a traditional marble bathroom or as a striking feature wall, the Palazzo Oro mosaics bring a touch of elegant drama to any setting. Their unique pattern and rich tones make them a standout choice for those seeking a distinctive design element.

With a balance of aesthetic appeal and practical durability, the Palazzo Oro Honed Herringbone Mosaic is a considered choice for those looking to infuse their spaces with a sense of timeless luxury.

name: Long Island Marble Fan Mosaic
bodyHtml:
The Long Island Marble Fan Mosaic captures the serene beauty of classic white marble, enriched with subtle grey veining that lends an air of sophistication to any space. Its crystalline structure adds a touch of elegance, making it a refined choice for those seeking both tradition and modernity.

These mosaics are thoughtfully crafted in a fan pattern, offering a unique visual rhythm that draws the eye. The natural finish enhances the marble's inherent beauty, allowing the gentle variations in tone and texture to shine through, creating a harmonious backdrop for a variety of interiors.

Made from high-quality marble, these tiles are designed for internal use, suitable for both walls and floors. Please note, sealing is required to maintain their pristine condition. They are particularly well-suited to bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways, where their timeless appeal can be fully appreciated.

With their versatile design, these mosaics can effortlessly complement both traditional and contemporary settings. Whether adorning a splashback or enhancing a shower area, they bring an understated elegance to your home.

It's important to store these tiles in a dry area to prevent efflorescence. For installation, we recommend using a rapid or semi-rapid set adhesive, such as our Sarsen Home Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive, to ensure a secure fit.

name: Rialto Porcelain Satin Blanc
bodyHtml:
Inspired by the timeless beauty of Venice, the Rialto Terrazzo Veneta Honed tiles capture the essence of this historic city. Crafted from recycled and waste marble materials, they offer a sustainable choice that doesn't compromise on style.

The honed finish of these tiles provides a smooth, matte surface that enhances their understated elegance. With a colour palette rooted in classic white, the Veneta design subtly echoes the traditional terrazzo patterns found throughout Venetian architecture.

Made from terrazzo, these tiles are designed for internal use, making them well-suited to a variety of spaces including bathrooms, kitchens, and hallways. Their PTV 22 slip rating when wet ensures a practical choice for areas where safety is a priority.

These tiles effortlessly blend into both modern and patterned settings, offering versatility in design. Whether used on walls or floors, they bring a touch of Italian sophistication to any room.

Please note, due to the technical characteristics of this material, sealing is required. For installation, we recommend using an S2 adhesive, as our Premium Semi-Rapid Adhesive is not suitable for this product.

name: Kimmeridge Limestone Acid Etched Slab
bodyHtml:
The Kimmeridge Limestone Slab captures the essence of the rugged Dorset coast with its deep, moody hues of grey and charcoal. Infused with natural fossils, these slabs echo the timeless beauty of the Isle of Purbeck’s renowned limestone formations.

Crafted with an acid etched finish, these slabs present a tactile surface that invites touch and interaction. The subtle variations in tone and texture create a dynamic visual experience, enhancing the character of any space they inhabit.

Made from durable limestone, these slabs are designed for both internal and external applications. They are well-suited to areas such as bathrooms, showers, wet rooms, and hallways, offering both aesthetic appeal and practical performance.

With their versatile grey palette, these slabs complement a range of styles, from modern to traditional. They provide a refined backdrop that allows other design elements to shine, while still holding their own distinctive presence.

Please note that sealing is required to maintain the natural beauty and longevity of the Kimmeridge Limestone Slab. This ensures that the slabs continue to perform and captivate in any setting.

name: Buscot Limestone Dry Etched Slab
bodyHtml:
Reminiscent of the classic English stone found in Cotswold villages, the Buscot Limestone Etched Slab exudes a timeless charm. Its hard-wearing nature makes it a steadfast choice for both modern and traditional settings.

These slabs boast a etched finish, enhancing their natural beige tones with subtle sophistication. The surface texture invites a tactile experience, creating an understated elegance in any space.

name: STUDIO Sanderson - Anaar Pink Clay Border & Corner
bodyHtml:
Our Sanderson STUDIO collection offers a more artisanal interpretation of the brand's design legacy, bringing archive patterns into a handcrafted ceramic format. Made to order in the UK, this collection reflects a slower, more traditional approach to tilemaking, where character and detail are central to the finished piece.

Drawing directly from the Sanderson wallpaper archive, the designs include classic delft-inspired motifs, structured patterns with coordinating borders and corners, and a range of decorative compositions that feel both nostalgic and enduring. Each design is thoughtfully scaled and arranged to suit interior wall applications, allowing for complete, cohesive schemes.

The tiles themselves feature a rustic, handmade aesthetic, with a gently undulating surface and a soft ivory base that adds warmth and depth beneath the glossy glaze. This subtle irregularity enhances the authenticity of the designs, giving each installation a crafted, individual feel.

Intended for interior walls, Sanderson STUDIO is particularly suited to spaces where detail and atmosphere matter-kitchens, bathrooms, and feature areas that benefit from a more decorative, heritage-led approach. Combining archival design with traditional production methods, the STUDIO collection captures the essence of classic English interiors in a refined ceramic form..

name: Resin-Cement Grout Limestone (no.20)
bodyHtml:
When it comes to completing your tiling project, the choice of grout can subtly transform the overall aesthetic. Resin-Cement Grout Limestone offers a versatile solution, whether you're aiming for seamless cohesion or a striking contrast.

This grout is designed for both interior and exterior applications, making it suitable for a wide range of materials including porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, marble, and mosaics. Its unique formulation combines the durability of cement with the high performance of epoxy, ensuring a low-porous, resilient finish.

With its matt finish, Resin-Cement Grout Limestone provides clean lines and a smooth appearance, while its water-resistant properties ensure longevity. It is particularly well-suited to joints ranging from 0 to 20mm, maintaining its integrity across various tile sizes.

For natural stone installations, lighter grout tones are recommended to prevent staining, and sealing the stone before grouting is advised. When working with textured porcelain or low-slip tiles, applying a Pre-Grout Barrier can simplify the cleaning process.

Please note: To determine the appropriate grout quantity for your project, refer to the product page of your selected tile. If eligible, our grout calculator will assist in providing an accurate estimate based on the tile size and grout joint width.

name: Resin-Cement Grout Warm Jasmine (no.22)
bodyHtml:

It pairs well with porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, marble, mosaics, and even ultra-thin tiles. name: Resin-Cement Grout Sage (no.18)
bodyHtml:
Resin-Cement Grout in Sage is the quiet achiever in your tiling project, bringing a refined finish to both interior and exterior spaces. Its sage hue offers a subtle touch that can either harmonise with or gently contrast against your chosen tiles.

This grout is crafted to suit a variety of materials, from porcelain and ceramic to natural stone and mosaics, even accommodating ultra-thin tiles. Its composition merges the resilience of cement with the enduring performance of epoxy, ensuring clean lines and a smooth, lasting finish.

Designed for joints ranging from 0 to 20mm, this grout is low-porous and water-resistant, making it a practical choice for diverse applications. For textured porcelain or low-slip tiles, consider using a pre-grout barrier to simplify post-grouting cleanup.

Please note: For precise grout quantities, refer to the product page of your selected tile. If applicable, our grout calculator will help determine the exact amount needed based on tile size and grout joint width.

bodyHtml:
Kerakoll Silicone Colour Limestone, in a 310ml format, is designed to enhance the finish of your tile installations with its subtle, natural hue. This silicone is a practical choice for those seeking a cohesive look in both indoor and outdoor settings.

Known for its colourfast properties, this silicone maintains its appearance even in challenging conditions. It is resistant to frost, ensuring durability in colder climates, and is suitable for use in swimming pools, making it versatile for various environments.

While it effectively seals porcelain and ceramic tiles, it's important to note that this silicone is not suitable for natural materials. This ensures optimal performance and longevity when used with the appropriate tile types.

Whether you're working on a bathroom, kitchen, or poolside project, Kerakoll Silicone Colour Limestone provides a reliable seal that complements your chosen tiles. Its application ensures a professional finish that withstands the test of time.

For those who appreciate both function and form, this silicone offers a practical solution that aligns with your design vision, adding a refined touch to any tiling project.

name: Resin-Cement Grout Cream (no.23)
bodyHtml:
Introducing Resin-Cement Grout Cream (no.23), a versatile choice for those seeking a cohesive finish for their tiling projects. This grout is designed to complement a wide range of materials, including porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, and mosaics, both indoors and out.

Combining the strength of cement with the enhanced performance of epoxy, this grout offers a low-porous, resilient finish. It ensures clean lines and a smooth, water-resistant surface, making it ideal for areas exposed to moisture.

Suitable for joints ranging from 0 to 20mm, Resin-Cement Grout Cream provides flexibility in design, whether you're working with ultra-thin tiles or more substantial formats. Its creamy hue offers a subtle contrast or seamless blend, depending on your tile selection.

For natural stone installations, it's advisable to avoid darker grout tones to prevent staining, especially on lighter shades. Sealing the stone before grouting with a product like our Stain Block treatment is recommended for added protection.

Please note: For precise grout quantity calculations, refer to the specific product page of your chosen tiles. If eligible, our grout calculator can assist in determining the exact amount needed based on the tile size and joint width.

name: Resin-Cement Grout Iron Grey (no.09)
bodyHtml:
When it comes to finishing your tile project, grout is the subtle hero that ties everything together. Whether you're aiming for seamless cohesion or a striking contrast, grout plays a crucial role in the aesthetic outcome.

Resin-Cement Grout in Iron Grey (no.09) is designed for both interior and exterior applications, making it versatile for a range of materials including porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, and even ultra-thin tiles. Its blend of cement durability and epoxy performance ensures a low-porous, resilient finish.

name: Resin-Cement Grout Clay (no.34)
bodyHtml:
When it comes to completing your tiling project, the choice of grout can make all the difference. Resin-Cement Grout Clay offers a harmonious blend of durability and aesthetic appeal, ensuring a refined finish for your tiles.

This grout is designed for both indoor and outdoor applications, making it versatile for a range of surfaces including porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, and even mosaics. Its matt finish provides a subtle backdrop that complements your tile choice without overshadowing it.

Combining the strength of cement with the enhanced performance of epoxy, this grout is low-porous and resilient. It provides clean lines and a smooth finish, with water-resistant properties that ensure longevity.

Resin-Cement Grout Clay is well-suited for joints ranging from 0–20mm, offering flexibility in your design choices. For textured porcelain or low-slip tiles, using a Pre-Grout Barrier can simplify post-grouting cleanup.

Please note: To determine the correct amount of grout needed for your project, refer to the product page of your chosen tiles. If applicable, use the grout calculator for precise measurements based on tile size and grout joint width.

name: Resin-Cement Grout Blue Grey (no.14)
bodyHtml:
Resin-Cement Grout Blue Grey is an understated choice for those seeking a seamless finish in their tiling projects. Its blue-grey hue offers subtle sophistication, whether you're aiming for cohesion or contrast.

Combining the resilience of cement with the advanced performance of epoxy, this grout is designed for both interior and exterior applications. It is compatible with a variety of materials, including porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, marble, and mosaics, even accommodating ultra-thin tiles.

With its low-porous nature, this grout ensures clean lines and a smooth finish, while its water-resistant properties promise durability over time. It is particularly well-suited for joints ranging from 0 to 20mm.

For textured porcelain or low-slip tiles, consider using a Pre-Grout Barrier to simplify post-grouting cleanup. Additionally, our range of colour-matched silicone sealants can provide a seamless finish across tiled surfaces.

Please note: To accurately calculate the amount of grout needed for your project, use our grout calculator available on the product page of your selected tiles. This tool helps determine the precise quantity based on tile size and joint width.

bodyHtml:

name: Resin-Cement Grout Terracotta (no.35)
bodyHtml:
In the world of tiling, grout is the unsung hero, providing the finishing touch that can subtly unify or boldly contrast. Resin-Cement Grout Terracotta (no.35) is designed to enhance your chosen tiles with its warm, earthy hue.

This versatile grout is suitable for both interior and exterior applications, making it a reliable choice for a variety of settings. Its composition blends the enduring strength of cement with the advanced performance of epoxy, ensuring a low-porous, resilient finish.

Ideal for use with porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, marble, mosaics, and even ultra-thin tiles, this grout ensures clean lines and a smooth, water-resistant finish. It is well-suited to grout joints ranging from 0–20mm, providing flexibility for different tile formats.

For natural stone installations, we recommend avoiding darker grout tones to prevent staining, especially on lighter shades. Sealing the stone before grouting is advisable, ideally with our Stain Block treatment for added protection.

Please note: To determine the right amount of grout for your project, use our grout calculator available on the product page for your chosen tile. This tool provides an accurate estimate based on tile size and your selected joint width.

name: Resin-Cement Grout Russet (no.41)
bodyHtml:
Resin-Cement Grout Russet (no.41) is the finishing touch that completes your tiling project with understated elegance. Its russet hue brings a subtle warmth, whether you're seeking cohesion or contrast in your design.

Blending the durability of cement with the refined performance of epoxy, this grout is designed for both interior and exterior applications. It works seamlessly with porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, marble, mosaics, and even ultra-thin tiles, ensuring versatility across a range of materials.

With low porosity and resilience, Resin-Cement Grout offers clean lines and a smooth finish, providing water resistance that stands the test of time. It suits joints from 0–20mm, making it adaptable to various tile layouts and designs.

For natural stone tiles, we advise against darker grout tones to prevent staining, especially on lighter shades. Sealing stone before grouting, ideally with our Stain Block treatment, adds an extra layer of protection.

Please note: To determine the right amount of grout for your project, visit the product page of your chosen tile. If applicable, use our grout calculator for an accurate estimate based on your specific tile size and grout joint width.

name: Resin-Cement Grout Tuscan Beige (no.40)
bodyHtml:
When it comes to completing your tiling project, the choice of grout is as crucial as the tiles themselves. Resin-Cement Grout Tuscan Beige provides a subtle yet sophisticated finish, designed to enhance the overall aesthetic of your space.

This grout is engineered for versatility, suitable for both interior and exterior applications. It pairs seamlessly with porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, marble, mosaics, and even ultra-thin tiles, offering a cohesive look across various surfaces.

Combining the durability of cement with the advanced performance of epoxy, this grout is low-porous and resilient. Its matt finish ensures clean lines and a smooth, water-resistant surface that stands the test of time.

Ideal for grout joints ranging from 0 to 20mm, Resin-Cement Grout Tuscan Beige is a practical choice for a wide range of projects. For textured porcelain or low-slip tiles, consider using a pre-grout barrier for easier cleanup.

Please note: To determine the correct amount of grout needed, use our grout calculator available on the product page for your chosen tiles. This tool provides an accurate estimate based on tile size and grout joint width.

bodyHtml:
Kerakoll Silicone Colour Cement (no. 08) in a 310ml format offers a reliable solution for sealing your tile installations. With a subtle cement hue, it provides a seamless finish to both porcelain and ceramic surfaces.

This silicone is designed to be colourfast and resistant to frost, ensuring long-lasting performance in various environments. It is particularly well-suited for areas in permanent contact with water, such as swimming pools.

Ideal for both internal and external applications, this silicone ensures a robust seal that withstands the elements, making it a practical choice for diverse projects.

With Kerakoll Silicone Colour Cement, you can trust in a product that combines functionality with a refined appearance, enhancing the integrity of your tile installations.

name: Resin-Cement Grout Hot Chocolate (no.33)
bodyHtml:
Resin-Cement Grout in Hot Chocolate provides the perfect finishing touch to your tiling project, offering a warm, inviting hue that complements a variety of materials. Its matt finish adds a subtle elegance, making it a versatile choice for both indoor and outdoor applications.

This grout is designed to work seamlessly with porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, marble, mosaics, and even ultra-thin tiles. Blending the durability of cement with the performance of epoxy, it ensures a resilient and low-porous finish that stands the test of time.

With its water-resistant properties, Resin-Cement Grout is well-suited for joints ranging from 0 to 20mm, providing clean lines and a smooth finish. It's an ideal choice for those seeking a balance between aesthetic appeal and practical performance.

For textured porcelain or low-slip tiles, consider using our Pre-Grout Barrier to simplify the cleaning process post-grouting. Additionally, we offer colour-matched silicone sealants for a cohesive look across tiled surfaces.

Please note: To calculate the right amount of grout for your project, refer to the product page of your chosen tile. If eligible, our grout calculator will help determine the required quantity based on the tile size and grout joint width.

Ideal for use in swimming pools and areas in permanent contact with water, Kerakoll Silicone Colour offers reliable sealing performance where it's needed most.

name: Resin-Cement Grout Mustard (no.27)
bodyHtml:
When it comes to finishing your tile project, the choice of grout can subtly transform the entire look. Resin-Cement Grout in Mustard provides a vibrant option for those seeking a touch of warmth and character.

This grout is designed for both interior and exterior applications, making it versatile across a range of materials including porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, marble, and mosaics. Its matt finish complements various surfaces, offering a refined and cohesive appearance.

Combining the durability of cement with the enhanced performance of epoxy, this grout is low-porous and resilient. It ensures clean lines and a smooth finish, with water-resistance that stands the test of time.

Ideal for grout joints ranging from 0 to 20mm, it’s a practical choice for both wall and floor installations. For textured or low-slip tiles, consider using a Pre-Grout Barrier for easier cleanup post-application.

Please note: For accurate grout quantity calculations, refer to the grout calculator available on the product page of your chosen tile. This ensures you purchase just the right amount for your specific project.

name: Kerakoll Silicone Colour Russet (no. 41) 310ml
bodyHtml:
Kerakoll Silicone Colour Russet (no. 41) offers a refined finish for your tiling projects, bringing a warm, earthy tone to any space. This silicone is designed to complement both porcelain and ceramic tiles, providing a seamless and cohesive look.

With its colourfast properties, this silicone ensures that the rich russet hue remains vibrant over time, even when exposed to the elements. Its resilience against frost makes it a reliable choice for both internal and external applications.

Perfectly suited for areas in constant contact with water, Kerakoll Silicone is an excellent choice for swimming pools and other wet environments. Its sealing capabilities are robust, ensuring long-lasting performance and peace of mind.

While selecting your grout and silicone, consider the overall design scheme. Whether you seek a complementary or contrasting effect, this silicone provides the flexibility to achieve your desired aesthetic.

Please note, however, that this silicone is not suitable for use with natural materials. Its specialised formulation is crafted to enhance the beauty and durability of porcelain and ceramic installations.

name: Tora Blue Honed Limestone Slab
bodyHtml:
Embodying a sense of timeless elegance, the Tora Blue Honed Limestone Slab captivates with its deep inky-black hue, subtly animated by the presence of minute off-white fossils. This natural stone offers a glimpse into the earth's history, bringing a touch of the ancient world into modern design.

The honed finish of these slabs provides a smooth, matte surface that enhances the stone's inherent character. Each slab tells its own story, with the fossil details adding a unique texture that plays with light and shadow in any setting.

Crafted from European limestone, these slabs are suitable for both internal and external applications, making them a versatile choice for various environments. Their durability and natural beauty make them well-suited for spaces such as bathrooms, hallways, and even shower and wet rooms.

Whether used on walls or floors, the Tora Blue slabs bring a refined sophistication to any space. Their understated elegance complements both modern and traditional styles, offering a versatile backdrop that enhances the surrounding decor.

With a requirement for sealing, these slabs promise longevity and resilience, ensuring that their beauty endures over time. A thoughtful choice for those who appreciate the quiet allure of natural stone.

name: Coral Reef Quartzite Slab
bodyHtml:
Some stones quietly complement a space. Others transform it entirely. Coral Reef Quartzite sits firmly in the latter.

A richly expressive natural quartzite, its surface is alive with movement. A soft green grey backdrop is swept through with painterly veining in cream, mossy green, warm brown, inky blue, flashes of white and the occasional flicker of red. No two pieces are ever the same, each one a composition in its own right, shaped over time and impossible to replicate.

This is a material chosen not to blend in, but to be remembered. Across kitchen worktops, statement bathrooms, striking wall cladding or sculptural staircases, it brings depth, drama and a quiet sense of artistry that feels entirely individual.

Beyond its beauty, Coral Reef Quartzite offers the resilience that defines this remarkable stone. Exceptionally hardwearing and naturally resistant to staining, it is well suited to spaces that call for both performance and presence. Sealing is recommended to ensure it continues to look its best over time.
